It treats each latent as representing a span or step of the teacher CoT, aggregates the embeddings of the tokens in that span, and trains the model with a multi-token prediction objective over the compressed tokens. The model therefore learns latent reasoning through token likelihood rather than through explicit vector regression. This enables parallel teacher-forced training over the CoT trace. The trade-off is that the method inherits the structure and length of the teacher trace, and at inference it can suffer from accumulated errors because the model must condition on its own latent states rather than teacher-forced textual context.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments separate three regimes. On short structured reasoning traces, typically under 100 tokens, C-MTP outperforms previous direct-supervision methods and is competitive with, or better than, slower indirect-supervision methods. The paper reports better training efficiency, better sample efficiency, and stronger out-of-distribution generalization in this regime. On longer semi-natural traces, indirect supervision becomes stronger because its recurrent objective is better suited to compressing long reasoning trajectories into a small number of latent states. On realistic traces generated by a strong teacher, both direct and indirect ContinuousCoT methods fall well short of standard CoT supervised fine-tuning. This is the key empirical message: structured reasoning benchmarks can overstate the practical utility of continuous latent reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with attention to the regime split; 25 to 35 minutes is enough for the main ideas. Read the introduction for the distinction between direct and indirect supervision. Then read the C-MTP objective in the methodology section, focusing on how multi-token prediction replaces latent-space distribution matching. In the experiments, prioritize the tables or figures that compare short structured traces, verbose semi-natural traces, and realistic teacher-generated CoT. The most useful part is the failure analysis around compression, teacher forcing, and error accumulation.

recommendation.zh: 长CoT轨迹下连续推理性能暴跌的发现很有价值，直接看§4长轨迹实验和对应图表即可，方法部分可略读。
recommendation.en: The sharp performance drop of continuous CoT on long reasoning traces is a valuable finding; focus on §4 long-trace experiments and skip the method section.

paper.title: Uncovering Latent Reasoning Strategies in Language Models
paper.abstract: A language model $p_θ(y \mid x)$ trained on reasoning tasks learns to solve problems via multiple distinct strategies, yet these strategies are implicit and entangled within the model's response distribution. We study the problem of decomposing the response distribution of a given pretrained language model into a structured, strategy-conditioned representation. Specifically, we learn a latent-variable factorization $p_θ(y \mid x) \leadsto (r_φ(z \mid x), g_φ(y \mid x,z))$, where a router $r$ map

summary.core_problem: 预训练 LLM 在推理任务上习得了多种隐式解题策略，但这些策略纠缠在响应分布里难以分解。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出一种能把 p(y|x) 分解为路由 + 策略条件生成的潜变量方法，并解决后验塌缩问题；对理解 latent reasoning / 策略多样性有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 学习 p_θ(y|x) ⇝ (r_φ(z|x), g_φ(y|x,z)) 的分解：路由器 r 输出潜策略 z 上的分布，生成器 g 在 z 条件下生成响应；针对“初始化自 base model 的 g 已经能表示 p_θ(y|x) 而无需 z”导致的后验塌缩，提出基于 fractional information gain 的变分目标，强制 z 承载可测量的信息份额。
summary.experiments: 在预训练语言模型上做策略分解实验（摘要未列具体模型规模/数据集），验证能恢复出可解释、可区分的潜在策略簇，缓解标准 VI 的后验塌缩。
summary.authors_note: John Lafferty 是统计学习/ML 理论领域资深学者（芝加哥大学/Yale 等），长期做概率模型与 LM 理论分析。

summary_en.core_problem: Pretrained LLM learn multiple implicit problem-solving strategies on reasoning tasks, but these strategies are entangled within the response distribution.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: a latent-variable decomposition of p(y|x) into a strategy router and a strategy-conditioned generator, with a targeted fix for posterior collapse; directly relevant to understanding latent reasoning and strategy diversity.
summary_en.technical_approach: Learns a factorization p_θ(y|x) ⇝ (r_φ(z|x), g_φ(y|x,z)) where router r outputs a distribution over latent strategies z and generator g produces responses conditioned on z. To counter posterior collapse (the generator, initialized from the base model, already represents p_θ(y|x) without using z), a variational objective based on fractional information gain forces z to carry a measurable share of information.
summary_en.experiments: Strategy decomposition on pretrained language models (abstract does not specify model sizes or datasets); recovers interpretable, distinguishable latent strategy clusters and mitigates the posterior collapse seen with standard VI.
summary_en.authors_note: John Lafferty is a senior figure in statistical learning and ML theory (UChicago/Yale etc.), with long-running work on probabilistic models and LM theory.

recommendation.zh: 把 LM 响应分布分解为可解释策略簇的干净做法，对 latent reasoning / 思考预算建模有启发；重点看 fractional IG 目标和塌缩分析。
recommendation.en: A clean decomposition of LM response distributions into interpretable strategy clusters, useful for latent reasoning and thinking-budget modeling; focus on the fractional IG objective and collapse analysis.

paper.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence
paper.abstract: Transformer reasoning is limited by autoregressive decoding, which repeat edly compresses rich hidden computation through token space and makes it difficult for intermediate reasoning states to persist across time. We in troduce Transformers with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence (T2MLR), a transformers-based latent reasoning architecture that fuses a cached middle layer representation from the previous token directly into an earlier layer of the current token position, enabling abstract intermed

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“让 Transformer 多想几步”这么泛的问题，而是一个更具体的架构瓶颈：标准自回归解码把每一步的高维中间计算都压回 token 空间，再由下一个 token 重新展开，导致跨时间持续存在的潜在推理状态很难保留。已有 latent reasoning 方法通常把递归信号放在输入嵌入或最终层附近，离真正承载抽象推理的中间层较远；另一类 depth looping 方法虽然能增加单 token 计算，但推理成本会随循环次数上升。T^2MLR 的目标是把“跨 token 持续的连续推理状态”直接安放在中间层，并且尽量不破坏标准 teacher-forcing 预训练和低开销推理。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它给“latent reasoning 该放在哪里”这个问题提供了一个很清楚的答案：不是输入端，也不是只在输出端，而是中间层。这个判断和 mechanistic interpretability 中关于中层承担抽象组合与关系推理的观察是对齐的。第二，它提出了一种仍然兼容 dense token-level supervision 的连续推理架构，避免了很多 latent CoT 方法在训练可扩展性上的硬伤，尤其是 sequence parallel 下的 teacher-forced pretraining。第三，它的收益不是只出现在小型合成任务上，而是延续到自然语言预训练、下游多跳推理、以及对现有 1.7B instruct 模型的 retrofit，这说明它更像一个可插入的基座改造方向，而不是只在特定 benchmark 上成立的技巧。贡献量级上，我会把它看成“值得持续跟踪的架构分支”：还谈不上替代标准 AR Transformer，但已经把 latent recurrence 从概念推进到可预训练、可扩展、可低开销部署的阶段。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计是 temporal middle-layer recurrence。模型在前一个 token 的某个较深中间层缓存表示，然后在当前 token 的一个较早中间层把这份缓存通过门控融合进去。这样做有两个关键点。其一，递归信号不是从 embedding 重新进入网络，而是直接注入到中层计算图里，因此前一时刻形成的抽象状态可以在后续 token 的中层继续演化。其二，作者强调 recurrence 只放在局部中层，而不是全层都做递归。原因很直接：早层更偏词法和局部句法，晚层更接近词表投影；把递归集中在中层更符合功能分工，也更省参数和算力。

从实现上看，T^2MLR 需要定义一对层位点：一个“写入层”产生要缓存的中间状态，一个“读取层”在下一个 token 处接收该状态。两者之间通过一个 gated fusion 模块连接，门控负责控制当前 token 本地表示与前一 token 持续状态的混合比例。这个设计和简单 residual addition 的区别在于，它允许模型按上下文动态决定何时依赖跨时间潜变量，何时主要依赖当前 token 的标准前向计算。

训练上的难点比结构本身更重要。严格的时间递归会让 teacher forcing 下不同位置之间产生真实依赖，从而破坏标准并行训练。作者提出 approximate temporal-parallel training 来恢复可扩展性：训练时对递归路径做近似并行化处理，使得序列维度仍可并行，而不是像 RNN 那样完全串行。论文把这一点作为可预训练性的关键，因为如果没有这一步，架构即使概念上成立，也很难在大规模语料上训练。这里值得注意的是，它不是完全精确地复现推理时的递归，而是在训练可扩展性和递归保真度之间做了工程折中。

和相关方法相比，差异很明确。相对 latent-recurrent methods，它把状态放在中层而不是输入端；相对 depth-looping methods，它把额外计算沿时间维传播，而不是在单 token 内反复过层，因此推理时每 token 只多一个轻量递归融合，而不是多次整网循环；相对标准 Transformer，它显式提供了跨 token 的连续隐状态通路，缓解 token bottleneck。
summary.experiments:
实验分成四块，结构比较完整。

第一块是合成任务 S5-Retrieval。这个任务同时要求不可解群状态跟踪和 in-context retrieval，单纯 Transformer 或单纯 recurrent 模型都难以胜任。作者用它证明中层时间递归确实能表达“跨步持续的抽象状态”，不是只在自然语言任务上靠数据偏置取巧。摘要里没有给出具体数值，但正文结论是 shallow T^2MLR 能解这类标准架构失败的组合任务，这对机制层面的说服力很重要。

第二块是自然语言预训练。作者在 data- and parameter-matched 设置下比较 T^2MLR 与标准 Transformer，结果是 perplexity 更低，且下游 NLP benchmark 也更好。一个很关键的消融是：最好的收益出现在只对约 20% 的中间层做 recurrence/looping，而不是全层递归。这说明收益并不来自“多加一条状态通路”本身，而是来自把递归放在合适的层段。论文还把规模扩到 361M 和 1B 参数、50B pretraining tokens，收益仍然存在，说明不是小模型特有现象。

第三块是下游推理微调。作者在 GSM-Aug、ProsQA、HotPotQA、Variable Assignment 上都报告了优于参数和数据匹配基线的结果。这里最有信息量的观察不是单个 benchmark 提升多少，而是 middle-layer recurrence 变体持续优于 full-layer recurrence。也就是说，论文的核心架构判断在多个任务上都被重复验证了。

第四块是 retrofit 实验，这也是最接近实际采用场景的一部分。作者把递归路径插入到预训练好的 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct，再做短暂数学数据微调。结果 GSM8K 从 35.8 提升到 39.9，MATH500 从 12.8 提升到 18.0，且对照组是“同样微调但没有递归改造”的基线。这个结果说明 T^2MLR 不一定要求从头预训练，至少在已有模型上加一条中层递归支路也能带来可见收益。

成本方面，论文给出的推理额外开销最多约 8% per-token，这一点很关键。因为很多 latent reasoning 或 depth recurrence 方法的主要问题不是无效，而是推理成本太高，难以进入真实 serving。T^2MLR 的 trade-off 是把更多复杂性放在训练端，换取较低的在线开销。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里对问题的拆解，再直接看方法部分关于“为什么递归要放在中层”的论证。这篇文章真正有价值的地方不是门控公式，而是层功能分工与时间递归位置选择的结合。精读时重点看三类内容。

第一，架构图和 recurrence/fusion 的定义。要弄清楚缓存的是哪一层、注入到哪一层、门控如何做、是否共享参数、缓存张量的形状和更新时机是什么。这里决定了它到底是“轻量跨 token 状态”还是“变相加深网络”。

第二，训练部分的 approximate temporal-parallel scheme。这是全文最值得深挖的工程点。要重点看它如何在 teacher forcing 下近似递归依赖、误差来自哪里、是否会造成 train-test mismatch、以及 sequence parallel 的实现边界。如果你关心大规模预训练可行性，这部分比 benchmark 分数更重要。

第三，消融实验。尤其要看 middle-only recurrence vs full-layer recurrence、不同递归层段比例、与 looped transformer/latent recurrent baseline 的对比、以及推理 overhead 的测量。这里能回答“为什么不是全层递归”“为什么不是单 token 内多循环”这两个关键问题。

如果时间有限，优先顺序可以是：方法图 + 训练近似 + 预训练主表 + 层位点消融 + retrofit 实验。预计精读 60–90 分钟比较合适；如果要评估是否能复现或改造成自家模型，训练并行化细节需要再多花一轮时间。
summary.authors_note: Princeton 相关团队，代码仓库挂在 princeton-pli 名下。摘要与正文片段未完整列出作者名单，无法在当前材料中可靠确认具体作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific architectural bottleneck in autoregressive Transformers: rich intermediate computation is repeatedly compressed back into token space at every decoding step, so abstract reasoning states do not persist well across time. Prior latent-reasoning approaches usually pass recurrent information through embeddings or final-layer outputs, which is a poor match to the empirical observation that abstract reasoning is concentrated in middle layers. Depth-looping alternatives increase per-token compute by reusing layers multiple times, but their inference cost grows with the number of loops. T^2MLR asks whether a Transformer can preserve and evolve latent reasoning states directly in the middle of the network, while keeping standard teacher-forced pretraining and near-standard decoding cost.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is threefold. First, it makes a concrete architectural claim about where persistent reasoning state should live: in middle layers rather than at the input interface or only near the output. That aligns well with mechanistic findings on layer specialization. Second, it offers a latent-reasoning design that remains compatible with dense token-level supervision and scalable teacher-forced pretraining, which is where many continuous-CoT style ideas become impractical. Third, the gains are not confined to synthetic tasks: they carry over to language pretraining, downstream reasoning finetuning, and even a retrofit setting on a pretrained 1.7B instruct model. That makes it more than a benchmark trick. It looks like a plausible architectural branch for future base models, even if it is not yet a replacement for standard AR Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is temporal middle-layer recurrence. The model caches a representation from a deeper middle layer at token t-1 and injects it into an earlier middle layer at token t through a gated fusion pathway. This creates a continuous latent channel across decoding steps, but places that channel inside the part of the network where abstract computation is believed to happen.

Two design choices matter. First, the recurrent signal does not re-enter through the embedding layer. It is fused directly into the middle of the computation graph, so the previous token’s abstract state can continue evolving in the current token’s middle-layer processing. Second, recurrence is localized to a subset of middle layers rather than applied everywhere. The rationale is functional: early layers are more lexical/syntactic, late layers are closer to vocabulary projection, and middle layers are the best place to preserve reasoning state.

Architecturally, T^2MLR defines a write location and a read location. A hidden state from the write layer is cached, then consumed at the read layer of the next token. A gating module controls how much of the current token’s local representation should be mixed with the carried-over latent state. This is more flexible than a plain residual addition because the model can decide contextually when to rely on persistent latent state and when to ignore it.

The training story is a major part of the contribution. Exact temporal recurrence would introduce token-to-token dependencies under teacher forcing and break standard sequence-parallel training. The paper proposes an approximate temporal-parallel training scheme that preserves scalable parallelism while still training the recurrent pathway. This is the practical enabler: without it, the architecture would behave more like an RNN-style serial model and would be hard to pretrain at scale. The approximation introduces a train-time compromise between recurrence fidelity and throughput, and that trade-off is central to evaluating the method.

Relative to prior work, the distinctions are clean. Compared with latent-recurrent methods, recurrence is placed in the middle layers rather than at the input side. Compared with looped/depth-recurrent Transformers, extra computation is propagated across time instead of repeatedly re-running the full stack for one token, so inference overhead stays small. Compared with a standard Transformer, the model adds an explicit continuous hidden-state pathway across tokens, reducing the token bottleneck.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is broad and well structured.

First, the paper uses the synthetic S5-Retrieval benchmark, which combines non-solvable group state tracking with in-context retrieval. The point is not benchmark coverage but mechanism stress-testing: standard Transformers and recurrent models fail in isolation, while a shallow T^2MLR can solve the task. Even without focusing on the exact number, this result supports the claim that middle-layer temporal recurrence can maintain abstract state across steps.

Second, in language pretraining, T^2MLR achieves lower perplexity than parameter- and data-matched Transformer baselines and also improves downstream NLP benchmarks. A particularly informative ablation is that the best gains come from applying recurrence to only about 20% of the middle layers rather than the full stack. That strongly suggests the benefit comes from placing recurrence in the right region, not from adding generic extra machinery. The paper also scales experiments to 361M and 1B parameters with 50B pretraining tokens, and the gains persist.

Third, in downstream reasoning finetuning, the model consistently beats matched baselines on GSM-Aug, ProsQA, HotPotQA, and Variable Assignment. The most important pattern is not any single benchmark delta, but the repeated finding that middle-layer recurrence outperforms full-layer recurrence. That reinforces the paper’s central architectural thesis.

Fourth, the retrofit experiment is practically important. The authors insert the recurrent pathway into a pretrained SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct model and do brief math finetuning. GSM8K improves from 35.8 to 39.9, and MATH500 from 12.8 to 18.0, compared with an identically finetuned baseline without the recurrent modification. This suggests the architecture may be adoptable without full pretraining from scratch.

On efficiency, the paper reports at most about 8% extra per-token inference overhead. That matters because many latent-reasoning or depth-looping methods fail the deployment test due to decoding cost. T^2MLR shifts more complexity to training while keeping online overhead modest.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem framing in the introduction, then move quickly to the method section that argues why recurrence should live in the middle layers. The main value is not the gating formula by itself, but the combination of layer specialization and temporal recurrence.

Three parts deserve close reading. First, inspect the architecture figure and the exact recurrence/fusion definition: which layer writes the cache, which layer reads it, how the gate is parameterized, whether parameters are shared, what tensor is cached, and when it is updated. Those details determine whether this is truly a lightweight cross-token latent state or just another way of deepening the network.

Second, study the approximate temporal-parallel training scheme. This is the most important engineering contribution. Focus on how teacher-forced recurrence is approximated, where the approximation error comes from, whether it creates train-test mismatch, and how it interacts with sequence parallelism. If large-scale pretraining feasibility is your main concern, this section matters more than the benchmark tables.

Third, read the ablations carefully: middle-only versus full-layer recurrence, the fraction of layers used for recurrence, comparisons against looped Transformers and latent-recurrent baselines, and the inference overhead measurements. These experiments answer the two key design questions: why not recur everywhere, and why not just loop depth within a token.

If time is limited, the best path is: method figure, training approximation, main pretraining table, layer-placement ablations, and the retrofit experiment. A serious read is about 60–90 minutes; reproducing or adapting the method would require another pass over the training-parallelism details.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with Princeton-related authors; the code repository is under princeton-pli. The provided material does not include a reliable full author list, so individual author backgrounds cannot be confirmed here.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接动摇“AR 推理状态只能靠 token 传递”的 prior，先看 recurrence 插入位置和 retrofit 实验；若结果稳，内部应立刻做中层状态通路 ablation。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the prior that AR models can only pass reasoning state through tokens; start with the recurrence placement and retrofit results, and reproduce the middle-state pathway ablation internally.

paper.title: SPARK: Susceptibility-Guided Profiling and Steering of Latent Reasoning States in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Reasoning failures in large language models (LLMs) are usually evaluated from final answers, but a wrong answer does not reveal why the model failed. The same incorrect output may reflect missing capability, an unstable reasoning trajectory, or a failure to activate a reasoning state that is already available in the frozen model. Existing prompting and benchmark-based evaluation methods mostly operate at the output level, while generic activation-steering methods typically apply global direction

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型会不会推理”，而是“模型失败时到底缺了什么”。作者认为，仅看最终答案无法区分三种情况：模型根本没有该能力、模型有能力但推理轨迹不稳定、模型内部已有可用的 reasoning state 却没有被激活。现有 benchmark 和 prompting 主要停留在输出层，通用 activation steering 又往往对所有样本施加同一方向，缺少诊断。论文因此聚焦一个更细的问题：能否在冻结模型、单次前向附近，用隐藏状态对微小输入扰动的响应来判断某个样本是否进入了有效推理状态，并据此只对“该救的难例”做定向 steering。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练的直接影响有限，因为核心对象是推理阶段的隐状态诊断与测试时干预，不是预训练目标、数据或优化本身。但它仍有两点启发。第一，它把“latent reasoning state 是否被激活”当作一个可测量对象，而不是只从 accuracy 反推能力边界，这对理解预训练后模型内部能力的可达性有价值。第二，作者发现 raw susceptibility 被输入长度严重混淆，尤其在算法推理里，难度上升常伴随序列更长，导致隐藏状态响应变弱未必代表 reasoning collapse。这一点对任何用 activation statistics 分析训练动态、长度泛化或 long-context 失效的人都很重要：不做长度控制，内部信号很容易被 token 数效应污染。整体上，这篇更像一篇机制分析加轻量 steering 的工作，而不是 pretrain 方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
SPARK 包含 profiling 和 steering 两部分。第一步，作者先在带连续难度标注的任务上估计 behavioral boundary，也就是准确率随难度下降的拐点区域。第二步，不直接用最终正确与否划分样本，而是测量 hidden-state susceptibility：对输入 embedding 加小噪声，观察各层隐藏状态响应幅度。作者的关键发现是，原始 susceptibility 与 prompt length 强相关，特别是在图、程序、算法类任务中，难例序列化后更长，raw response 会因长度扩展而衰减。于是他们不看原始值，而是做 length-controlled susceptibility，用同长度样本的期望响应做校正，取 residual 作为“超出长度解释之外的内部激活强度”。

在此基础上，SPARK 再结合 cross-layer coordination 去区分 reasoning-active anchors 与 under-activated hard targets。前者是已经进入有效推理状态的样本，后者是行为上困难且内部激活不足的样本。Steering 阶段从 active anchors 中提取 reasoning direction，表示从 baseline state 到 active reasoning state 的隐空间位移，然后只在选定层对 under-activated hard examples 注入该方向。这里的设计重点有两个：一是 steering 不是全局统一施加，而是诊断驱动、样本选择性的；二是方向不是凭人工 prompt 或通用差分构造，而是从“已激活的同类推理样本”中抽取。论文还强调层选择同样由 susceptibility/coordination 信号指导，而不是盲目在所有层加偏置。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕一个新构建的 FRONTIER-4.5K 展开，这是 4500 条 programmatic reasoning 样本，覆盖 symbolic composition、logical inference、algorithmic reasoning，并带可执行监督和连续难度标注。作者把算法推理作为主要诊断场景，因为这里既有明显能力边界，也有强长度混淆。关键结果有三类。

第一，分析性结果：raw hidden-state susceptibility 不能直接当 reasoning 指标，因为它会随着输入长度增长而系统性下降；长度校正后的 residual 更能区分真正的 under-activation 与单纯长输入。第二，诊断结果：用 corrected susceptibility 加 cross-layer coordination，可以把 hard examples 进一步分成“已经激活但仍失败”和“未充分激活”的子类，这为后续干预提供了依据。第三，干预结果：SPARK-Steering 在 FRONTIER、GSM8K、MATH-500 上都有提升，而且增益更集中在更难样本上，同时对容易样本的破坏较小，说明 selective steering 比全局 activation steering 更稳。

当前提供的全文片段没有给出精确分数、提升点数、模型规模和层位选择的完整表格，因此不能可靠复述具体数字。真正值得核对的是：长度校正前后 susceptibility 与难度/长度的相关系数变化；anchor/target 划分后的成功率差异；不同层注入、不同方向构造、是否做样本选择的消融；以及在 GSM8K、MATH-500 上相对通用 steering baseline 的增益幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着问题读。先看引言和方法总览，确认作者到底在诊断什么：不是一般的可解释性，而是“冻结模型是否已经具备但未激活某种推理状态”。然后重点看 susceptibility 定义和长度校正方法，这是整篇最关键的地方。如果这个校正站不住，后面的 profiling 和 steering 都会变弱。接着看 FRONTIER-4.5K 的构造方式，尤其是难度标注是否连续、可执行监督如何保证标签质量、为什么 programmatic reasoning 更适合做内部状态分析。

实验部分优先看三块：一，raw susceptibility 与 length 的关系图；二，length-controlled residual 如何重排样本并识别 under-activated hard cases；三，steering 的主结果和消融，特别是 selective vs global、layer selection、direction source。若只想抓主线，30 分钟左右足够；若要判断方法是否可靠，建议把附录里关于噪声幅度、层聚合、长度回归方式和鲁棒性检验一起看。对做预训练的人，最值得带走的是那个负面结论：很多看似反映“推理强弱”的内部统计量，先要排除长度这个一阶混淆因素。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether an LLM can reason in general. It asks what a failure actually means. A wrong final answer may come from missing capability, an unstable reasoning trajectory, or a failure to activate a reasoning state that already exists in the frozen model. Standard benchmarks and prompting only observe outputs, while generic activation steering applies broad interventions without diagnosing which examples need help. The core problem is therefore whether hidden-state response to small perturbations can identify under-activated reasoning states at test time and support selective steering only for the hard cases that are likely recoverable.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is moderate rather than central, because the main contribution is latent-state diagnosis and test-time intervention, not a new pretraining objective or data recipe. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, it treats reasoning-state activation as a measurable internal variable rather than inferring everything from accuracy curves. That matters for understanding what pretraining has already encoded but not reliably surfaced. Second, the paper shows that raw hidden-state susceptibility is heavily confounded by input length, especially in algorithmic reasoning where harder instances serialize into longer prompts. That is a broadly useful warning for anyone using activation statistics to study training dynamics, long-context degradation, or reasoning behavior: without length control, internal metrics can mostly reflect token-count effects rather than computation quality.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SPARK has two parts: profiling and steering. It first estimates a behavioral boundary from accuracy as a function of task difficulty. It then measures hidden-state susceptibility by adding small noise to the input embeddings and tracking how strongly hidden states respond across layers. The key empirical finding is that raw susceptibility is not a clean reasoning signal because it is strongly coupled to prompt length. In many programmatic and algorithmic tasks, harder examples are simply longer, and the raw response attenuates with length.

To address this, the paper introduces length-controlled susceptibility. Instead of using the raw response, it compares each example to the expected response among inputs of similar length and uses the residual as a corrected activation signal. A positive residual indicates stronger-than-expected internal activation given the length; a negative residual suggests under-activation. SPARK then combines this corrected signal with cross-layer coordination to separate reasoning-active anchors from under-activated hard targets.

The steering stage extracts a reasoning direction from the active anchors, representing the latent shift from a baseline state to an active reasoning state. That direction is injected only into selected layers and only for the under-activated hard examples. This is the main methodological distinction from generic activation steering: intervention is diagnosis-guided, example-selective, and derived from active reasoning cases rather than from a global handcrafted direction. Layer selection is also informed by the susceptibility and coordination signals rather than applied uniformly across the network.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experimental asset is FRONTIER-4.5K, a 4,500-example programmatic reasoning benchmark with executable supervision and continuous difficulty annotations, covering symbolic composition, logical inference, and algorithmic reasoning. Algorithmic reasoning is the main diagnostic setting because it exhibits both a clear capability boundary and a strong length confound.

The results appear in three layers. First, the analysis result: raw hidden-state susceptibility decreases with input length and can therefore misrepresent reasoning quality. Length-controlled residual susceptibility is a better indicator of whether a hard example is genuinely under-activated. Second, the profiling result: corrected susceptibility plus cross-layer coordination can split hard failures into at least two groups, those that already show active internal reasoning signatures and those that do not. Third, the intervention result: SPARK-Steering improves performance on FRONTIER, GSM8K, and MATH-500, with larger gains on harder cases and less damage to easy cases than broad steering methods.

The provided text does not include trustworthy numerical tables, exact gains, model sizes, or full ablations, so those should be checked directly in the paper. The most important numbers to verify are the correlation changes before and after length correction, the quality of the anchor-target partition, and the gains over generic steering baselines under different layer-selection and direction-construction choices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this with one question in mind: is the paper really measuring latent reasoning activation, or just another proxy for prompt size and difficulty? Start with the introduction and method overview to understand the intended diagnosis target. Then go straight to the definition of susceptibility and the length-control procedure. That is the critical hinge of the paper. If the correction is weak, the rest of the profiling and steering story becomes much less convincing.

Next, inspect how FRONTIER-4.5K is built: how difficulty is annotated, why executable supervision matters, and why programmatic reasoning is a good setting for latent-state analysis. In the experiments, prioritize three pieces: plots showing the relationship between raw susceptibility and length, evidence that the corrected residual identifies under-activated hard cases, and the steering ablations comparing selective versus global intervention, layer choice, and direction source. A quick pass takes about 30 minutes. A careful read should also include appendix details on noise magnitude, layer aggregation, regression or normalization used for length control, and robustness checks. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main lesson is the negative one: many internal statistics that look like reasoning signals need explicit control for sequence length before they can support mechanistic claims.

recommendation.zh: 指出隐状态敏感性分析的关键混淆变量prompt长度，重点看§3长度控制方法，对研究预训练推理能力内化有参考。
recommendation.en: Identifies prompt length as a key confounder in hidden-state susceptibility analysis; focus on §3 length-control method, useful for studying pretrained reasoning capability internalization.

paper.title: HALO: Hybrid Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Language Models
paper.abstract: We study how to improve a frozen pretrained language model with a small amount of adaptive extra computation. A simple approach is to add additional refinement steps on top of the backbone hidden states, but fixed extra refinement can be wasteful: a one-step refinement head may be too weak, while forcing a second full-sequence refinement step everywhere can increase compute without improving transfer. We introduce HALO, a hybrid adaptive latent-refinement method that combines a coarse refinement

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很具体的问题：在冻结预训练语言模型的前提下，如何用少量额外 latent 计算提升推理能力，并避免把同样的 refinement 计算浪费在所有 token 上。核心比较对象是固定一轮全序列 refinement、固定两轮全序列 refinement，以及按 token 选择性追加第二阶段 refinement。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在推理时计算分配和 latent reasoning 接口。它不是改预训练目标，也不是重训基座，而是在冻结 backbone 后加入轻量 refinement 路径，观察额外计算应该分配到哪些 token。价值在于把“多算一步”从序列级决策改成 token 级预算控制，这对 future pretrain-time latent computation、adaptive depth、early exiting 这类方向有参考意义。贡献量级偏方法探索，benchmark 覆盖较窄，不能直接外推到通用基座训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: HALO 在冻结 LM 的 hidden states 和 logits 之上接一个可训练 refinement 模块。第一阶段是 coarse refinement 路径，但胜出配置并不强制所有 token 都执行第一步更新；控制器用当前 logits，以及可用时的 logits 变化量，构造便宜的 gate features，再由小 gate head 输出 keep probability。若概率低或预测已经稳定，该 token 可以直接跳过 refinement。第二阶段用 token scoring 和 monotonic token halting 选择一部分 token 进入更贵的 refinement block。胜出配置使用 learned-gain token score，预算比例为 0.35，且至少选择 8 个 token；被丢弃的 token 在同一次 forward 内不会重新激活。被选中的 token 维护 selected-token state 和 latent scratchpad state，scratchpad 提供一个小的辅助工作区，使第二阶段不只是普通的逐 token 残差更新。一个关键工程点是 train-test consistency：固定评测调用第二阶段时，也使用同一套 budgeted learned-gain routing，而不是训练时选择、评测时全量走另一条路径。
summary.experiments: 主要公开比较来自 MMLU-Pro 和 GPQA-Diamond。HALO 在论文面向的公开平均分上优于 frozen backbone、fixed-1 和 fixed-2。增益并不均匀：GPQA-Diamond 是主要收益来源；MMLU-Pro 上 frozen backbone 仍然更强。内部 token-accuracy 指标上，fixed-2 略高于 HALO，但 HALO 接近 fixed-2，同时平均执行的 refinement steps 少于 fixed-1，远少于 fixed-2。论文给出的重要消融信号是：选择性第二阶段比统一加第二步更有效；同时，控制器实际执行的更新次数和架构上存在的 refinement path 不能混为一谈，因为胜出配置允许 token 在第一阶段前就被跳过。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 中 gate features、learned-gain token score、monotonic halting 和 selected-token scratchpad 的定义；这些部分决定了它和普通 adaptive depth 或 early exit 的区别。实验部分优先看 MMLU-Pro/GPQA-Diamond 的分项结果，以及 average applied refine steps 与 token accuracy 的对照。需要留意两个边界：一是公开任务很少，二是 MMLU-Pro 上没有超过 frozen backbone，所以更适合作为 adaptive latent compute 的设计案例，而不是通用推理增强结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but useful question: given a frozen pretrained language model, how should a small amount of extra latent computation be allocated? The main issue is whether a second refinement pass should be applied to every token, stopped after one pass, or selectively assigned to tokens that are likely to benefit.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is in adaptive inference-time computation and latent reasoning interfaces. HALO does not change the pretraining objective or retrain the base model. Its contribution is a token-level compute allocation mechanism on top of frozen representations. This is useful for thinking about adaptive depth, latent refinement, and future pretraining setups that may expose controllable internal computation. The evidence is still limited in scope, so the result should be read as a design signal rather than a general recipe for base-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: HALO attaches a lightweight trainable refinement module to the hidden states and logits of a frozen LM. The first component is a coarse refinement path, but in the best reported configuration tokens are not forced to take an initial update. A small controller builds cheap gate features from current logits and, when available, the change in logits from the previous step. It then predicts a keep probability; stable or low-value tokens can skip refinement early. The second component scores eligible tokens and applies monotonic token halting. The reported winning setup uses a learned-gain score, a budget fraction of 0.35, and a minimum of 8 selected tokens. Dropped tokens are not reactivated within the same forward pass. Selected tokens are updated together with a latent scratchpad state, which gives the refinement block a small auxiliary workspace rather than a plain residual update. The paper also emphasizes train-test consistency: the same budgeted routing rule is used when the second-stage path is invoked in fixed evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The public comparison is built around MMLU-Pro and GPQA-Diamond. HALO obtains the best average among the reported methods, compared with the frozen backbone, a one-step full-sequence refinement baseline, and a two-step full-sequence refinement baseline. The gain is concentrated on GPQA-Diamond; on MMLU-Pro, the frozen backbone remains the strongest. On an internal token-accuracy metric, fixed-2 is slightly ahead, but HALO is close while using fewer average applied refinement steps than fixed-1 and far fewer than fixed-2. The main ablation-level message is that selective second-stage refinement gives a better quality-compute tradeoff than uniformly spending the second pass everywhere.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the method description of the gate features, learned-gain token scoring, monotonic halting, and the selected-token scratchpad. Then inspect the tables that compare public accuracy against average applied refinement steps. The main caveat is the narrow benchmark set and the non-uniform gains, especially the fact that the frozen backbone is still best on MMLU-Pro.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 token-halting 分析；若 setup 干净，适合放进 latent compute ablation 里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and token-halting analysis; if the setup is clean, this is worth reproducing in a latent-compute ablation.

paper.title: A First-Principles Theory of Slow Thinking and Active Perception
paper.abstract: As part of a series on first-principles modeling of cognitive functions, this paper attempts to provide a mathematical formulation of thinking and perception. It formally derives slow thinking or more generally, active perception, and encompasses the design, training and inference of slow thinking large language models. Our starting point is the lifting and projection of probability distributions on the observable and latent spaces, with the objective of representing complex data distributions b

summary.core_problem: 尝试从数学第一性原理统一刻画 slow thinking 与 active perception，并把这种表述延伸到 slow-thinking LLM 的设计、训练和推理。
summary.importance: 这是理论/机制取向工作，野心很大，想给“慢思考”建立统一形式化框架。对做 reasoning 或 latent reasoning 范式的人有概念启发，但离可操作的预训练 recipe 还有明显距离。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从可观测空间与潜在空间上的概率分布 lifting/projection 出发，提出 active lifting：通过采样潜在序列，并以最大速率降低不确定性为内在驱动，导出一个包含 slow-thinking 模型的设计空间。文中还定义了 static theory 下的表示层级与采样器层级，认为模型可沿这两个层级升级。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出清晰的实证设置、模型规模、数据规模或与主流 reasoning/slow-thinking 方法的定量对比。更像理论框架论文，实验可信度和可复现性需要看正文后再判断。
summary.authors_note: Institute for Advanced Algorithms Research、上海交通大学、北京大学。Weinan E 与 Zhi-Qin John Xu 在理论深度学习与科学计算方向有较强代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper attempts to formulate slow thinking and active perception from first principles, and to extend that formulation to the design, training, and inference of slow-thinking LLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory/mechanism-oriented work with broad ambition: it tries to provide a unified formalism for slow thinking. It may be conceptually useful for researchers exploring reasoning or latent-reasoning paradigms, but it is still far from an actionable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from lifting and projection of probability distributions between observable and latent spaces, the paper proposes active lifting: sampling latent sequences under an intrinsic objective of reducing uncertainty at the maximum rate. This yields a design space that contains slow-thinking models as a subspace, with representation and sampler hierarchies in the static theory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide a clear empirical setup, model scale, data scale, or quantitative comparison against mainstream reasoning or slow-thinking methods. It reads more like a theoretical framework paper, so empirical credibility must be checked in the full text.
summary_en.authors_note: Institute for Advanced Algorithms Research, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Peking University. Weinan E and Zhi-Qin John Xu are well known in theoretical deep learning and scientific computing.

recommendation.zh: 理论野心大，但先别把它当 recipe；若你在想 latent reasoning/slow thinking 的统一表述，可只读形式化部分，实验先持保留。
recommendation.en: Ambitious theory, but do not treat it as a recipe yet; read the formalism if you care about latent reasoning or slow thinking, and stay skeptical about the empirical side.

paper.title: Latent Memory Palace: Reasoning for Control as Autoregressive Variational Inference
paper.abstract: Human decision-making is highly flexible -- some actions are taken immediately; others require longer deliberation. Language models have exhibited a similar capacity for adaptive "reasoning." However, transferring this capability to continuous control policies has been challenging, as directly reasoning in language space may lack the granularity for spatial understanding and precise motions. In this work, we show that reasoning for control policies can emerge by organizing information in an auto

summary.core_problem: 让连续控制策略具备类似“按需多步思考”的能力，而不依赖语言 token 作为推理空间。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 latent reasoning 方法探索。它把控制中的推理建模为自回归 latent space 上的变分推断，对研究 latent computation、非语言 CoT 和 test-time adaptive computation 有间接参考价值，但不是 LLM 预训练论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Latent Memory Palace，将策略的内部推理写成自回归 latent distribution，并把逐步检索/组织信息解释为 memory palace。训练上推导 latent-space reinforcement learning 技术，用可优化的变分下界来学习 LMP-π；方法核心是让策略在 latent 空间中自适应分配推理步数和信息访问。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 LMP-π 在仿真和真实世界控制任务上表现强，并展示可解释的、自适应的推理分配；未给出任务名称、网络规模、baseline、训练步数或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to give continuous-control policies an adaptive multi-step reasoning mechanism without using language as the reasoning medium.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a latent reasoning formulation for control. It is indirectly relevant to latent computation, non-linguistic chain-of-thought, and adaptive test-time computation, but it is not an LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent Memory Palace formulates reasoning as variational inference over an autoregressive latent distribution. The resulting LMP-π policy is trained with a latent-space reinforcement learning procedure that optimizes a tractable variational lower bound and allows adaptive allocation of latent reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims strong results in simulation and real-world domains with interpretable adaptive reasoning allocation, but it does not disclose task names, model sizes, baselines, training budget, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 可把它当 latent reasoning 旁证读摘要；没有 LLM setup，别把控制任务上的结论外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: Treat it as weak evidence for latent reasoning; without an LLM setup, do not extrapolate the control results to pretraining.

paper.title: Final Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Analyzing Latent Reasoning Faithfulness Along Training Trajectories
paper.abstract: Latent reasoning methods perform multi-step inference entirely in the model's continuous hidden states, promising more compact and efficient reasoning. However, these opaque hidden states raise a question of faithfulness: whether these latent reasoning steps causally drive the final answer. Prior work investigates this question at converged checkpoints and reports several unfaithful behaviors, such as latent reasoning steps that can be replaced without changing the answer, but leaves how these b

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：latent reasoning 的“faithfulness”不是只看最终 checkpoint 就能判断，训练过程中这种因果贡献会如何形成、衰减或反转。
summary.importance: 对预训练和训练动态研究的启发在于，它把一个通常在收敛点上做静态分析的问题，改成了沿训练轨迹的动态分析。结论很重要：不同 latent reasoning 范式在最终 checkpoint 上可能表现出相似的不忠实行为，但形成路径并不一样；而且 latent steps 对最终答案的因果作用会随着训练推进而衰减，甚至会因为答案格式不同而出现相反趋势。这对任何把“中间隐状态当作推理空间”的建模路线都有提醒作用：训练目标未必在强化真正依赖 latent steps 的计算，模型可能逐渐学会绕开它们。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者用统一的 GPT-2 backbone，跟踪不同 latent reasoning 训练范式在多个保存 checkpoint 上的 faithfulness 变化。分析分两层。第一层是输出层面的 counterfactual faithfulness：在 ProsQA 上构造 405 组经 BFS oracle 验证的最小编辑样本对，只改图中的一条边，使正确答案从 A 翻到 B，然后看模型预测是否随编辑一起翻转。第二层是激活层面的 causal contribution：对 latent reasoning steps 做 noise-ablation activation patch，测量替换或扰动这些隐状态后输出变化的比例，从而估计这些 latent steps 是否真的在驱动答案。作者还控制内容与训练 recipe，只改变答案格式，比较 binary choice 与 open-ended decoding 下轨迹是否一致。核心贡献不在提出新的 latent reasoning 模型，而在提出一套沿训练过程观察 faithfulness 形成机制的分析框架。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三点。第一，不同 latent reasoning 范式在最终 checkpoint 上都可能显得不够 faithful，但沿训练轨迹看，输出层面的行为分化明显，说明“终点相似”掩盖了“路径不同”。第二，latent reasoning steps 的因果贡献在训练过程中会下降，且这种下降与输出层面发生 counterfactual failure 的样本群体是对应的，不是随机现象。第三，只改变答案格式，激活层面的轨迹就会反向：binary choice 设定下 latent steps 的因果作用随训练减弱，而 open-ended decoding 下反而增强。实验规模上，核心分析基于 405 个经 oracle 验证的 ProsQA counterfactual pairs 和 6 个保存 checkpoint。这个结果更像机制诊断，而不是追求 benchmark 分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看引言里的三个研究问题，再看 counterfactual construction 和 activation patch 的定义，最后看按 checkpoint 展开的主图。重点不是记住具体范式名字，而是理解作者如何把“faithfulness”拆成输出响应和激活因果贡献两层。若时间有限，读方法设定、RQ1/RQ2 主结果图、以及答案格式对比部分，大约 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线。若你关心 latent reasoning 或 continuous hidden-state computation，这篇值得作为训练动态分析的参考模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but underexplored question: if latent reasoning is sometimes unfaithful at the final checkpoint, how does that unfaithfulness emerge during training rather than only at convergence?
summary_en.importance: Its main value is methodological. Instead of treating a trained latent reasoner as a fixed object, the paper studies faithfulness as a training-trajectory property. The key finding is that similar endpoint behavior can arise from different trajectories, and that the causal contribution of latent reasoning steps can decay over training rather than strengthen. It also shows that this trajectory is not format-invariant: changing only the answer format can reverse the direction of the effect. For researchers interested in hidden-state reasoning, implicit computation, or training dynamics, this is a useful warning that optimization may gradually route around the intended latent computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze multiple latent reasoning paradigms on a shared GPT-2 backbone across saved checkpoints. They use two interventions. First, they build 405 verified counterfactual pairs on ProsQA by minimally editing one graph edge so that the BFS-oracle answer flips from one option to the other; this measures output-level counterfactual faithfulness. Second, they perform noise-ablation activation patching on the latent reasoning steps to estimate whether those hidden states causally affect the final prediction. They then compare these trajectories across training and across answer formats while keeping content and training recipe otherwise fixed. The contribution is not a new latent reasoning architecture, but a training-time causal analysis framework for faithfulness.
summary_en.experiments: There are three main findings. First, different latent reasoning paradigms can look similarly unfaithful at the final checkpoint while following qualitatively different output-level trajectories during training. Second, the causal contribution of latent reasoning steps tends to decay over training, and this decay aligns with the same example cohorts that fail the counterfactual edit test. Third, answer format matters a great deal: under binary choice, the causal role of latent steps decreases over training, whereas under open-ended decoding it increases. The core analysis is built on 405 oracle-verified ProsQA counterfactual pairs and six saved checkpoints. This is a mechanism paper, not a benchmark paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim path is: read the three research questions in the introduction, then the construction of the counterfactual pairs, then the activation-patching setup, and finally the checkpoint-wise main figures. The important idea is how the paper separates faithfulness into output responsiveness and activation-level causal contribution. If you only have 20–30 minutes, focus on the RQ1/RQ2 figures and the section comparing answer formats. It is especially useful if you care about latent reasoning or training-trajectory analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接给 recipe，但会改变你看 latent reasoning 的方式：别只盯 final checkpoint，先看训练中何时开始“空转”；读干预设计和轨迹图就够了。
recommendation.en: It won’t hand you a recipe, but it changes the right question for latent reasoning: stop judging only final checkpoints and inspect when faithfulness collapses during training.

paper.title: Reading Between the Dots: Decoding Hidden Computation across Filler Tokens
paper.abstract: Frontier LLMs can perform multi-step reasoning over content-free filler tokens like dots or counting sequences, producing correct answers with no visible chain-of-thought (CoT). This is a limit case for behavioral oversight, where surface tokens carry no information about the underlying reasoning. But hidden from the output is not the same as hidden from us. On four task families (fact retrieval, parallel numeric composition, string manipulation, and in-context computation), two open-weights fro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“模型会不会在 filler token 上思考”，而是更关键的两层问题：第一，这种看起来空白的输出区间里是否真的承载了任务相关计算；第二，这些隐藏计算能否被外部审计，而不是只能从行为上猜。作者把问题放在 CoT 可监督性的边界条件上来讨论：如果模型在一串点号、计数序列、字母序列上完成了中间推理，那么单靠读可见输出就失效了。论文的核心贡献，是把“隐藏于表面文本”与“不可被机制分析恢复”明确区分开，并用开放权重前沿模型证明，filler 区域里确实存在结构化、可定位、可解码、且对最终答案有因果作用的中间表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练和基座模型研究，这篇论文的重要性不在于提出新训练方法，而在于它直接触到一个越来越现实的问题：模型的有效计算未必沿着人类可读的 token 语义展开。只要模型学会把 residual stream 当作内部工作区，表面 token 可以几乎不携带可读信息，但内部状态仍然在推进推理。这个结论会影响三类研究。其一，CoT 监控和行为审计的可靠性边界，需要从“看输出”转向“看内部表征与路由”。其二，预训练目标和推理行为的关系：next-token 训练并不要求中间 token 对人类可解释，只要求它们对后续预测有用，因此 filler computation 不是异常现象，而可能是语言模型自然会利用的计算自由度。其三，机制分析方法的价值被抬高了：attention tracing、logit lens、activation transplant 这类工具，不只是解释性附属品，而是未来审计隐藏推理的必要手段。贡献量级上，这篇工作更像是一个扎实的机制证据包，而不是单点现象复现。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步，层层递进。第一步是行为层面确认 filler uplift。作者构造四类带明确中间变量的任务：1-fact addition、2-fact addition、2-hop letter position、以及完全在上下文内计算的线性方程系统。然后在问题和答案槽之间插入不同类型的内容空洞 token，如 dots、counting sequences、alphabet sequences，并比较有无 filler 时的正确率变化。这里设计得比较好的一点，是既覆盖“检索型中间量”，也覆盖“上下文内计算型中间量”，避免把现象误判为单纯 retrieval artifact。

第二步是定位机制。作者先看 attention，发现加入 filler 后，answer token 不再主要直接看 question，而是形成 question→filler→answer 的 relay 结构。这个观察本身还不够，因为 attention 不等于 computation。于是他们进一步用 logit lens 在每一层、每个 filler 位置上读 residual stream，检查哪些中间值在何时出现。结果显示，不同任务的中间变量会按时间和位置逐步浮现：例如 2-fact addition 中，A1 往往在 filler 前段较早层出现，A2 在后续位置出现，而 A1+A2 的和在靠近答案前的晚层才稳定“结晶”。这说明 filler 区域不是均匀缓存，而是有阶段性的计算轨迹。

第三步是做因果验证。作者采用 KV-cache transplant，只替换 filler token 对应的 KV 行，而不动问题和答案位置，观察答案分布是否随 donor example 改变。如果仅移植 filler 区域就能显著把答案 logits 推向 donor 的中间值或最终答案，那么 filler 中编码的内容就不是旁观信号，而是实际参与了生成。更细的一步是只移植那些 logit lens 已经能读出 addend 的位置，发现大部分效应都能保留；移植互补位置则几乎无效。这把“某些特定 filler 位置承载关键中间量”从相关性推进到了位置级因果性。

在无监督恢复部分，作者给出一个很实用的 pipeline：对所有 layer-position 做 logit lens，减去跨样本均值以抑制系统性伪影，再跨位置聚合 token 分数，把 top-50 候选交给 LLM judge 解释。这个流程不需要中间变量标签，也不训练 probe，重点是证明隐藏计算并不一定需要重监督才能恢复。与常见 probe 工作不同，这里更强调“可审计性”而不是“线性可分性”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两类开放权重前沿模型：DeepSeek V3（总参数约 671B，每 token 激活约 37B）和 Kimi K2（总参数约 1T，每 token 激活约 32B）。行为结果上，filler token 在四类任务里都带来稳定提升。DeepSeek V3 上，1-fact addition 从 54% 提升到 72%；2-fact addition 从 21% 到 24%，其中 9% 样本发生 wrong→right 翻转；2-hop letter position 从 61% 到 70%；system of equations 从 31% 到 61%。Kimi K2 上，2-fact addition 从 27% 到 35%；2-hop letter position 从 69% 到 75%；system of equations 从 18% 到 36%。这些数字说明 uplift 在需要多步中间态的任务上更明显，尤其是方程系统这种上下文内计算任务，增幅很大。

filler 类型消融也很关键。dots、计数序列、字母序列效果接近，而 scrambled sequences 明显更差。这个结果说明模型需要的是一段“非破坏性、可持续推进状态”的 token 轨道，而不是某种特定语义内容。换句话说，filler 的作用更像给模型提供额外计算步数和稳定位置结构，而不是提供知识。

机制实验里，attention 图显示 answer 对 filler 的依赖显著增强；logit lens 则在不同层和位置读出任务中间量。论文最有说服力的部分是 KV transplant：仅替换 filler 区域，就能让 donor 答案的 rank 上升几十到几百名；对检索得到的事实值和上下文内算出的变量值都成立。再往下做位置选择移植，只移植“能解出 addend 的位置”就能恢复大部分效应，说明编码不是弥散在整段 filler 上，而是有局部功能分工。

无监督恢复实验中，作者报告 strongest LLM judge 在两种模型、四类任务上都能以 80%–95% 的准确率恢复中间值，包括数值型事实、字符串型实体名，以及方程系统里在上下文中算出的变量。这一点很重要，因为它表明即便没有人工标注中间步骤，也能从 hidden states 中相当稳定地挖出模型到底在算什么。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“现象—机制—因果—恢复”的顺序读。先看引言和行为实验，确认作者不是只展示一个有趣例子，而是在四类任务、两种大模型上建立了较稳定的 filler uplift。这里重点看各任务定义，以及不同 filler 类型的对比，因为这决定了后面的机制解释是否站得住。

第二步重点读 attention 和 logit lens 部分。不要只看图上亮不亮，而要看作者如何把中间变量的出现时间与任务结构对应起来。2-fact addition 和 system-of-equations 两节最值得精读：前者展示检索+组合，后者展示纯上下文内计算，二者一起说明 filler 不是单一 retrieval cache。

第三步一定要细看 KV-cache transplant。这是全文最关键的证据，因为它把“能读出来”推进到“对答案有因果作用”。需要关注三点：移植的是哪些 KV 行；donor/recipient 如何匹配；以及只移植关键位置与移植补集位置时效应差多少。这里能看出作者对 activation patching 类方法的使用是否严谨。

最后看无监督恢复 pipeline。重点不是 judge 模型本身，而是前面的去均值、跨位置聚合、top-k 候选构造，这些步骤决定了方法是否能从 noisy hidden states 中提取稳定信号。如果做后续研究，可以沿两条线深挖：一是把这种恢复流程扩展到更自由的 reasoning setting，而不是人工构造任务；二是研究 filler computation 与训练目标、解码策略、RL 后训练之间的关系。全文里最值得反复对照的是行为提升曲线、layer-position 解码热图，以及 transplant 的 rank-shift 结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether models can “think over filler tokens.” It asks whether the apparently empty region between a question and an answer actually carries task-relevant computation, and whether that computation can be audited mechanistically rather than inferred from behavior alone. The setup targets a hard limit of chain-of-thought oversight: if a model reasons through dots or counting tokens, there is no readable CoT to inspect. The central claim is that hidden-from-output does not mean hidden-from-analysis. In open-weight frontier models, filler positions contain structured intermediate states that can be localized, decoded, and shown to causally affect the final answer.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and foundation-model research, the value of this work is not a new training recipe but a concrete demonstration of a broader property of next-token models: useful internal computation does not need to align with human-readable token semantics. Once the residual stream is used as a workspace, surface tokens can be semantically empty while still supporting multi-step reasoning. That matters in at least three ways. First, it sets a real boundary on CoT-based monitoring and behavioral oversight. Second, it clarifies what autoregressive training permits: the objective only rewards states that help future prediction, not states that remain legible to humans. Third, it raises the importance of mechanistic tools such as attention tracing, logit-lens readout, and activation/KV transplantation as auditing instruments rather than optional interpretability add-ons. The contribution is best understood as a strong mechanistic evidence package around a phenomenon that has mostly been discussed behaviorally.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method proceeds in three stages. The first stage establishes the behavioral phenomenon. The authors build four task families with explicit intermediate values: 1-fact addition, 2-fact addition, 2-hop letter-position queries, and a system-of-equations task where the relevant values are computed entirely in context. They insert content-free fillers between the question and the answer slot, using dots, counting sequences, and alphabet sequences. This task design is important because it spans both retrieved intermediates and in-context computed intermediates, reducing the chance that the effect is just a retrieval artifact.

The second stage localizes the mechanism. Attention analysis shows that when filler is present, the answer token no longer relies mainly on a direct question-to-answer path. Instead, the model forms a relay structure: question to filler to answer. Since attention alone is not computation, the paper then applies the logit lens at every layer and filler position to inspect what is present in the residual stream. The resulting picture is temporally and spatially structured. In 2-fact addition, one addend tends to appear early in the filler region, the second later, and the sum stabilizes only in late layers near the answer. This suggests that the filler region is not a passive buffer but a staged computational trajectory.

The third stage tests causality with KV-cache transplantation. The authors replace only the KV rows corresponding to filler tokens, leaving the question and answer positions untouched, and measure whether the answer distribution shifts toward the donor example. If swapping only the filler region changes the answer, the filler content is not merely correlated with the computation; it participates in it. They further restrict transplantation to positions where the logit lens already decodes an addend and find that most of the effect is preserved, while the complementary positions carry little effect. This gives position-level causal evidence that specific filler locations encode specific intermediate values.

The unsupervised recovery pipeline is also notable. It applies the logit lens over all layer-position pairs, subtracts the cross-example mean to remove shared artifacts, aggregates scores across positions, and sends the top-50 candidate tokens to an LLM judge for interpretation. No intermediate labels and no trained probe are required. Compared with standard probing work, the emphasis here is less on linear separability and more on practical auditability of hidden computation.
summary_en.experiments:
The study uses two open-weight frontier models: DeepSeek V3 (about 671B total parameters, roughly 37B activated per token) and Kimi K2 (about 1T total parameters, roughly 32B activated per token). Behaviorally, filler tokens improve accuracy across all four task families. On DeepSeek V3, 1-fact addition rises from 54% to 72%; 2-fact addition from 21% to 24%, with 9% of examples flipping from wrong to right; 2-hop letter position from 61% to 70%; and the system-of-equations task from 31% to 61%. On Kimi K2, 2-fact addition rises from 27% to 35%; 2-hop letter position from 69% to 75%; and the equations task from 18% to 36%. The largest gains appear on tasks that clearly benefit from extra intermediate computation, especially the in-context equations setting.

The filler-type ablation is informative. Dots, counting sequences, and alphabet sequences produce similar gains, while scrambled sequences underperform. This suggests that the model benefits from a non-disruptive token scaffold with stable positional structure, not from any particular semantic content. In other words, the filler acts more like extra computational runway than extra knowledge.

The mechanistic evidence is strongest in the KV-transplant experiments. Attention maps show increased reliance on filler positions, and logit-lens readouts reveal intermediate values across layers and positions. But the key result is that transplanting only the filler KV rows can move the donor answer upward by tens to hundreds of ranks, for both retrieved facts and values computed in context. When transplantation is restricted to positions that decode an addend, most of the effect remains; the complementary positions contribute little. This argues for localized functional structure rather than diffuse storage across the whole filler span.

In the unsupervised recovery experiments, the strongest LLM judge recovers intermediate values with 80% to 95% accuracy across both models and all four task families. The recovered content includes numeric facts, string-valued entities such as city or element names, and variables computed inside the prompt in the equations task. That result matters because it shows that hidden reasoning traces can be extracted without supervised labels for the intermediate steps.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of phenomenon, mechanism, causality, and recovery. Start with the introduction and behavioral section to verify that this is not a single anecdote but a repeated effect across four task families and two large models. Pay attention to the task construction and the filler-type comparisons, because they determine whether the later mechanistic claims are well supported.

Next, focus on the attention and logit-lens sections. Do not stop at the visual patterns. Track how the emergence of decoded intermediates aligns with the structure of each task. The 2-fact addition and system-of-equations analyses are the most useful pair: one shows retrieval plus composition, the other shows purely in-context computation.

Then read the KV-cache transplantation section carefully. This is the core evidence in the paper because it upgrades decodability into causal relevance. The important details are which KV rows are swapped, how donor and recipient examples are matched, and how much effect remains when only the “decoded” positions are transplanted versus their complement. That section reveals whether the activation-patching logic is used rigorously.

Finish with the unsupervised recovery pipeline. The main point is not the judge model but the preprocessing steps: mean subtraction, aggregation across positions, and candidate construction. Those choices determine whether stable signals can be extracted from noisy hidden states. Two follow-up directions are especially natural: extending the recovery method to less synthetic reasoning settings, and studying how filler computation interacts with training objective, decoding policy, and post-training. The figures worth revisiting are the behavioral uplift plots, the layer-position decoding heatmaps, and the transplant rank-shift results.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变对“无 CoT 就无可审计计算”的 prior；建议复现 KV transplant 和隐状态解码。
recommendation.en: This weakens the prior that no visible CoT means no auditable computation; reproduce the KV transplants and hidden-state decoder.

paper.title: DiscoLoop: Looping Discrete Embeddings and Continuous Hidden States for Multi-hop Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models achieve strong performance on many reasoning tasks when allowed to externalize intermediate steps as Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, many questions require the model to internalize the multi-step reasoning within a single forward pass before generating the answer. We study this challenge through two-hop reasoning, a representative task where the model must compose multiple pieces of parametric knowledge within a single forward pass. Standard non-recurrent Transformers suff

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 在单次 forward pass 内做多跳组合推理的问题。标准 Transformer 即使记住了原子事实，也常常不能把两个事实组合起来；looped Transformer 通过重复使用同一参数块缓解了深度局部存储问题，但仍然存在中间表示和下一轮输入 embedding 空间不对齐的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的启发主要在架构和机制分析。论文指出，隐式多跳推理不只是“中间实体能否从 hidden state 解码出来”的问题，还取决于这个 hidden state 是否以后一轮计算可直接使用的几何形式存在。这个观察对 latent reasoning、recurrent Transformer、test-time compute、以及减少显式 CoT 依赖都有参考意义。它不是通用预训练 recipe，但给出了一个清楚的架构假设：循环计算中传递连续 hidden state 还不够，需要显式保留或恢复离散 embedding 对齐的通道。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用受控 symbolic two-hop reasoning 任务分析 vanilla looped Transformer。结果显示，第一轮循环后，bridge entity 往往可以从连续 hidden vector 中线性或探针式解码出来，但这个向量仍然噪声较大，并且和该实体的干净 token embedding 几何不一致。换句话说，模型“知道”了中间实体，但下一轮循环不能像读取正常输入 token 那样稳定使用它。作者进一步做 training-free realignment intervention，把中间表示重新对齐到离散 embedding 空间，性能差距几乎被补上。基于这个发现，DiscoLoop 在 looped Transformer 中加入 decoded embedding channel：循环之间不仅传递 continuous hidden states，也传递解码后、与离散 embedding 对齐的向量。这样既保留 recurrence 复用参数记忆的好处，又降低 loop-to-loop representation mismatch。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 symbolic two-hop reasoning、synthetic-language multi-hop reasoning，以及真实预训练任务。论文报告 DiscoLoop 在 symbolic 和 synthetic-language 任务上以更少训练步数达到接近满分的测试准确率，尤其改善了 OOD 设置：训练中只见过原子事实，测试时要求组合成未见过的二跳查询。在真实预训练任务上，DiscoLoop 相比 looped Transformer baseline 获得更低 training loss，并在若干 benchmark 上表现更好。给定内容没有提供具体参数规模、训练 token 数或逐项数值，因此这些数字需要读原文实验表格确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟，若关注 latent reasoning 可读到 1 小时。先看 Section 2 的 ID/OOD two-hop 任务定义，否则后面的泛化结论不容易判断。然后看 Section 3 的机制分析，重点是 bridge entity 的 decodability 与 embedding alignment 的区别，以及 training-free realignment intervention。最后看 Section 5 的真实预训练实验，判断 decoded embedding channel 是否只解决合成任务，还是对普通 LM 训练也有收益。读实验时要特别检查 baseline 是否匹配参数量、循环次数和计算量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies implicit multi-hop reasoning inside a single forward pass. Standard Transformers can memorize atomic facts but often fail to compose them. Looped Transformers help by reusing the same parametric memory across hops, but they still suffer from a representation mismatch between the hidden state produced after one loop and the clean discrete embedding that the next loop would ideally consume.
summary_en.importance: The main value is architectural and mechanistic. The paper argues that decoding an intermediate entity from a hidden vector is not sufficient for reliable implicit reasoning; the representation also needs to be aligned with the embedding space used by the next reasoning step. This matters for latent reasoning, recurrent Transformers, test-time computation, and approaches that try to reduce dependence on explicit chain-of-thought tokens. The contribution is not a full pretraining recipe, but it gives a concrete design principle for recurrent language models: pass both continuous states and discrete-embedding-aligned information across loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first analyze vanilla looped Transformers on controlled symbolic two-hop reasoning tasks. They find that after the first loop, the bridge entity is often recoverable from the continuous hidden vector, yet the vector remains noisy and geometrically misaligned with the clean embedding of that entity. This explains why the next loop cannot reliably use the bridge as if it had appeared as a normal input token. A training-free realignment intervention nearly closes the gap, supporting the representation-mismatch diagnosis. DiscoLoop implements this idea architecturally by adding a decoded embedding channel between loops. The recurrent block still passes continuous hidden states, but it also passes vectors aligned to the discrete embedding space, preserving memory reuse while reducing loop-to-loop mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover symbolic two-hop reasoning, synthetic-language multi-hop reasoning, and real-world pretraining tasks. DiscoLoop is reported to reach near-perfect test accuracy with substantially fewer training steps on symbolic and synthetic-language tasks, including harder OOD settings where atomic facts are observed during training but their compositional two-hop queries are not. On real-world pretraining tasks, it obtains lower training loss and stronger benchmark performance than looped-Transformer baselines. The provided content does not include exact model sizes, token counts, or per-benchmark numbers, so those details should be checked in the experiment tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30-minute skim is sufficient for a first pass; spend up to an hour if latent reasoning is a focus. Start with the task definitions in Section 2, especially the distinction between ID and OOD two-hop evaluation. Then read the mechanistic analysis in Section 3, where the key distinction is decodability versus embedding alignment. The training-free realignment intervention is the clearest evidence for the proposed bottleneck. Finally inspect the real-world pretraining results in Section 5 and check whether baselines are matched for parameter count, number of loops, and compute.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看机制部分：它把“单步多跳推理不行”从泛泛能力问题落到表示对齐缺陷；先读 bridge entity 可解码但答不出的分析，再决定要不要试 looped/latent scratchpad 线。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism section: it turns single-pass multi-hop failure from a vague capability issue into a representation-alignment defect; start with the analysis showing the bridge entity is decodable yet unusable, then decide whether to pursue looped or latent-scratchpad variants.

paper.title: Multimodal Continuous Reasoning via Asymmetric Mutual Variational Learning
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are often constrained by a language-space bottleneck, forcing complex visual reasoning into discrete tokens which can lose perceptual nuance. A promising alternative is continuous latent reasoning, where the goal is to discover implicit reasoning pathways that bridge the multimodal query and the final answer. However, this introduces a severe train-inference mismatch: a training-time posterior, conditioned on the ground-truth answer, can exploit answer-de

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多模态连续推理里的一个关键训练缺口：如果用潜变量表示中间推理过程，训练时后验分布 q(z|x,y) 可以看到标准答案，推理时先验 p(z|x) 却看不到答案，那么标准 ELBO 会把先验往一个“带答案泄漏”的后验上去逼近，导致 train-inference mismatch。作者认为，现有连续 latent reasoning 方法要么依赖手工设计的重建/对齐监督，要么没有真正解决这个后验作弊问题，因此测试时先验生成的 latent 并不适合做推理。
summary.importance: 从基座预训练视角看，这篇论文的直接相关性不如纯 LLM pretrain 工作强，但它触到一个更一般的问题：当模型把中间计算迁移到连续潜空间时，训练分布与推理分布如何对齐。这个问题不只属于 MLLM，也会出现在 latent reasoning、hidden CoT、甚至某些非 AR 建模里。它的贡献不在于提出新的视觉模块，而在于给“连续中间状态如何学、如何避免答案条件泄漏”提供了一个较完整的变分训练框架。若后续有人把类似思路迁到纯语言 latent reasoning 或 unified multimodal pretraining，这篇会有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 Asymmetric Mutual Variational Learning, AMVL。核心不是简单做双向 KL，而是把 prior 和 posterior 的角色区分清楚：posterior q(z|x,y) 负责训练时利用答案发现有用的 latent reasoning 轨迹，prior p(z|x) 负责测试时在无答案条件下生成可用 latent；两者条件结构不同，因此不能只用单边 ELBO 里的 forward KL 去逼近。

具体建模上，作者在多模态输入 x 与答案 y 之间引入一串连续潜变量 Z=[z1,...,zk]，把它们当作中间 reasoning states。生成模型写成 pθ(y|x,Z)pθ(Z|x)，其中 pθ(Z|x) 是推理时使用的先验，decoder 根据 x 和 Z 自回归生成答案。训练时再引入一个 target-aware posterior，用于近似真实后验并采样 latent。

AMVL 的关键是双重校准：
1. forward KL 对齐项，让 prior 去贴近 posterior 推断出的 latent，保证测试时 prior 不至于偏离训练时发现的有效推理空间；
2. reverse KL 正则项，反过来约束 posterior 不要跑到 prior 支持集之外太远，减少 posterior 借助答案信息形成捷径式、不可推理时复现的 latent 几何。

作者把这种设计称为 asymmetric mutual learning。这里的“asymmetric”很重要，因为两边不是对等学生，而是一个 answer-aware、一个 answer-agnostic，职责不同。与标准 ELBO 相比，差别在于不再默认 posterior 是唯一可信老师；与已有 latent reasoning 方法相比，差别在于不依赖额外手工监督去规定 latent 应编码什么，而是让答案驱动的生成目标自己塑造 latent，但同时用 reverse KL 限制泄漏带来的分布偏移。

架构实现上，论文强调是 latent-integrated MLLM 加轻量 variational heads，说明主体 backbone 并未大改，重点在训练目标而非大规模结构创新。若从方法判断，这更像一种可插拔训练框架。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验结论是 AMVL 在多个有挑战性的多模态 benchmark 上稳定优于离散 CoT 和已有 latent reasoning baseline，但当前可见文本没有完整列出具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、latent 长度、以及逐项数值，因此无法像 must-read 论文那样精确复述全部数字。

即便如此，实验设计的关键信息还是能看出来。作者显然在比较三类对象：
1. 纯离散文本推理基线，检验连续 latent 是否能缓解 language-space bottleneck；
2. 现有 latent reasoning 方法，检验不依赖手工 latent supervision 的 AMVL 是否更有效；
3. 去掉 forward KL 或 reverse KL 的消融，检验 train-inference mismatch 是否真由单边训练造成，以及双向校准各自的作用。

从论文主张推断，最重要的实验洞察不是单点分数，而是：只用 posterior→prior 的单向逼近不够，加入 reverse KL 后，测试时 prior 采样得到的 latent 更可用，说明 posterior 的答案依赖捷径确实会伤害泛化。若正文里有 latent 可视化、KL 项权重消融、或 prior/posterior gap 的统计，这些会是判断方法是否站得住的关键证据。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，重点看问题设定和目标函数，不必在视觉任务细节上停留太久。建议先读 Introduction 前半，确认作者批评的对象不是“离散 CoT 不好”这么简单，而是“连续 latent 训练时 posterior 泄漏答案”。然后直接看 Method 里 conditional generative model、ELBO 推导和 AMVL 的两个 KL 项，弄清每一项在约束谁、为什么单边 KL 不够。

实验部分建议优先看：
1. 主结果表，确认提升是相对离散 CoT 还是相对 latent baseline；
2. ablation，尤其是去掉 reverse KL 后性能和 prior/posterior gap 的变化；
3. 若有 latent 可视化或案例分析，看看 AMVL 是否真的保留了更强的视觉/空间信息，而不是仅仅增加参数或训练技巧。

如果只是判断是否值得跟进，20-30 分钟足够。若想把它迁移到纯语言 latent reasoning，需要更仔细看 posterior 参数化方式、latent 注入 decoder 的位置、以及训练稳定性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central failure mode in multimodal continuous reasoning: if latent reasoning states are learned with an answer-conditioned posterior q(z|x,y) during training, but inference relies on an answer-agnostic prior p(z|x), then standard ELBO training creates a train-test mismatch. The posterior can exploit answer-dependent shortcuts, and the prior is then forced to imitate a latent geometry that is partly shaped by information unavailable at test time. The authors argue that existing latent reasoning methods either rely on hand-crafted supervision or do not properly solve this posterior leakage problem.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining research is indirect but real. The paper is less about vision modules and more about a general issue in latent computation: how to learn continuous intermediate states that remain usable at inference time when training has access to stronger conditioning. That question extends beyond MLLMs. It also matters for latent reasoning in language models, hidden-chain training, and potentially non-AR modeling setups where internal trajectories are learned under mismatched conditions. The contribution is a reasonably clean variational framework for learning latent reasoning without manually specifying what the latent states should encode, while explicitly controlling answer leakage.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed method is Asymmetric Mutual Variational Learning (AMVL). The key idea is not just to add two KL terms, but to treat the prior and posterior as fundamentally different objects with different roles. The posterior q(z|x,y) is answer-aware and used during training to discover useful latent reasoning trajectories. The prior p(z|x) is answer-agnostic and must generate usable latent states at inference time. Because their conditioning structures differ, a one-sided ELBO is insufficient.

The model introduces a sequence of continuous latent variables Z = [z1, ..., zk] as intermediate reasoning states between multimodal input x and answer y. The generative model factorizes into p_theta(Z|x), the inference-time prior, and p_theta(y|x,Z), an autoregressive decoder conditioned on both the input and the latent sequence. Training uses a target-aware posterior to approximate the intractable true posterior over latent states.

AMVL then applies two complementary regularizers:
1. a forward KL term that aligns the prior toward posterior-inferred latent states, so the inference-time prior does not drift away from the useful latent space discovered during training;
2. a reverse KL term that constrains the posterior relative to the learned prior, preventing it from moving too far into answer-dependent shortcut regions outside the prior’s support.

This is why the method is called asymmetric mutual learning. The two distributions are not symmetric peers. One is answer-aware, the other is not, and they serve different downstream roles. Compared with standard ELBO training, the difference is that the posterior is no longer treated as an unrestricted teacher. Compared with prior latent reasoning work, the difference is that AMVL does not rely on external reconstruction or alignment losses to define what the latent states should contain. Instead, the answer-driven objective shapes the latent space, while reverse KL keeps that space inference-compatible.

Architecturally, the implementation appears lightweight: a latent-integrated MLLM with variational heads rather than a major backbone redesign. So the main contribution is the training objective and the probabilistic framing, not a new large-scale multimodal architecture.

recommendation.zh: 值得读目标函数部分；它抓住了 latent reasoning 常见的 posterior 泄漏问题，比单纯加隐变量更有方法论意义。
recommendation.en: Read the objective section; it targets posterior leakage in latent reasoning, which is more useful than simply adding hidden variables.

paper.title: Bridging the Gap Between Latent and Explicit Reasoning with Looped Transformers
paper.abstract: Language models typically reason via explicit chain-of-thought (CoT), generating intermediate steps token-by-token. Latent CoT offers an alternative: it performs multi-step reasoning in the model's hidden states, replacing decoded tokens with continuous representations for greater efficiency. However, existing latent CoT methods underperform explicit CoT beyond 1B parameters, and the gap widens with scale. Looped, or recurrent-depth, Transformers, which reuse their weights to increase computatio

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是大模型 latent reasoning 里最关键的两个断点：一是许多 latent CoT 方法仍然按自回归方式逐个生成 latent token，顺序步数仍随推理长度线性增长；二是 latent trace 缺少像显式 CoT 那样逐位置、逐 token 的直接监督，规模变大后容易和可解释的推理过程脱钩。目标不是简单压缩 CoT，而是在 3B 级别模型上，让连续隐状态推理接近显式 CoT 的准确率，同时显著减少 thought phase 的串行延迟。
summary.importance: 价值在于把 latent reasoning 的失败点拆得比较清楚，并给出一个可扩展的结构化解法。LOTUS 说明，latent CoT 要在 billion-scale 上工作，不能只依赖隐状态蒸馏、KV 压缩或间接答案监督；它需要足够直接的 CoT token grounding，也需要把中间推理从自回归序列改成并行可细化的计算。对预训练研究的启发主要在两个方向：第一，looped / recurrent-depth Transformer 可以作为 inference compute scaling 的参数高效载体；第二，隐藏状态如果要承担推理过程，训练目标需要让它和语言空间保持可读、可校验的对应关系。这比单纯追求不可见 latent efficiency 更稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 LOTUS，即 Looped Transformers with parallel supervision on latents。它在问题和答案之间插入 K 个可学习的 padded latent blocks，每个 block 含 c 个 latent tokens。整段序列经过同一个 Transformer backbone 重复处理 R 次，权重共享，用 recurrent depth 增加计算量。这样，一个长度为 N 的显式 CoT 不再需要 N 次逐 token 解码，而是用 R 次并行 dense computation 来细化 latent slots，且 R 远小于 N。

关键训练信号是 parallel cross-entropy supervision。每个 post-loop latent position 通过 base model 自带的 LM head 去预测对应的 gold CoT token。也就是说，latent slot 不是只为了最后答案服务，而是被直接拉到显式 CoT 的 token 空间里。这个设计和 Coconut、CODI、SIM-CoT 的差别在于：它不再逐步自回归生成 latent thoughts。和 PCCoT、KaVa 这类 Jacobi-style 或 KV 压缩路线的差别在于：它不主要依赖 teacher hidden states 或压缩 cache 这类间接目标，而是用 gold CoT token 做位置对齐监督。

作者还实现了 LOTUS-aux。它把同样的 latent supervision 路由到一个辅助 decoder：decoder 条件化在所有 latents 上，并在 teacher forcing 下给 gold CoT tokens 打分。辅助 decoder 只用于训练。结果显示，aux 路线在 3B 上可以接近 direct LM-head routing，但在小模型上更容易退化。这个现象说明，直接使用 base LM head 做 latent-to-token grounding 更稳，可能因为它避免了额外 decoder 学到一套和主干不完全一致的读出空间。
summary.experiments:
核心实验使用 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct。作者报告 LOTUS 在 GSM8K test 上把 latent reasoning 和显式 CoT 的差距缩到 1 个点以内，并且在 out-of-domain math 平均指标上超过显式 CoT。延迟上，math-expression setting 的 thought-phase latency 降低 2.5 倍；在更啰嗦的自然语言 CoT stress test 上，准确率与显式 CoT 持平，同时 thought-phase latency 降低 6.9 倍。

消融实验给出两个比较实用的结论。第一，parallel supervision 很关键。没有直接、位置对齐的 CoT token 监督，latent traces 更难稳定地承载推理过程。第二，looped architecture 的容量配置也很关键，需要足够的 block width 和 loop depth。只把普通 Transformer 换成 latent slots，或只做浅层循环，都不足以填平显式 CoT 的差距。

可解释性实验也有信息量。作者把 post-loop latents 直接通过 base LM head 读出，能够恢复大部分 gold intermediate tokens，并且有时会给出训练目标中没有出现、但逻辑上有效的替代中间步骤。这说明 latent space 不是完全黑箱的连续压缩，而是和语言化推理步骤保持了较强对应关系。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读 Section 3.1 到 3.4。重点看 padded latent prefix 如何插入序列、looped backbone 如何重复处理、latent positions 如何和 gold CoT tokens 对齐，以及 LOTUS-aux 为什么只在训练时使用。

实验部分优先看 Figure 1、Section 4.2、Section 4.3.1 和 Section 4.3.2。Figure 1 给出 latent CoT 和显式 CoT 在 3B 上的主结果。Section 4.2 需要关注准确率与 thought-phase latency 的同时变化，尤其要分清 math-expression setting 和 natural-language CoT stress test。Section 4.3.1 看监督路径消融，Section 4.3.2 看 loop depth、block width 这类结构超参。

Section 5.1 值得细看。这里验证 latent 是否真的对齐 CoT，而不只是对答案有用。对于预训练研究者，最值得深挖的是三个问题：latent slots 和 CoT tokens 的长度错配如何处理；R 次 loop 的 compute 与显式 CoT token 解码的 wall-clock 比较是否公平；如果把这种目标前移到 mid-training 或 reasoning-oriented continual pretraining，是否能减少后训练阶段对显式长 CoT 数据的依赖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two failure modes of latent chain-of-thought reasoning at scale. Many latent CoT methods still generate latent thoughts autoregressively, so the number of sequential forward passes grows with the reasoning length. At the same time, their latent traces are often weakly grounded: unlike explicit CoT, they do not receive direct, position-aligned token supervision for each reasoning step. The goal is to close the accuracy gap to explicit CoT at the 3B scale while reducing the sequential latency of the thought phase.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a concrete recipe for making latent reasoning scale better: combine recurrent-depth computation with direct CoT-token grounding. The result is useful for pretraining and model-design research because it treats inference-time reasoning as a structured compute allocation problem, not only as a decoding problem. It also suggests that continuous latent reasoning should remain anchored to the language space if it is expected to replace explicit intermediate text. This is a stronger and more testable position than relying only on hidden-state distillation, compressed KV caches, or answer-level supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LOTUS inserts K learnable padded latent blocks, each with c latent tokens, between the question and the answer. The whole sequence is processed R times by the same Transformer backbone, reusing weights across iterations. This recurrent-depth design converts a length-N explicit CoT into R rounds of parallel dense computation, with R much smaller than N.

The central training signal is parallel cross-entropy supervision on the post-loop latents. Each latent position is read through the base model’s own LM head and trained to predict the corresponding gold CoT token. This gives the latent trace a direct token-level target. The design differs from autoregressive latent methods such as Coconut, CODI, and SIM-CoT because it does not generate latent thoughts one by one. It also differs from methods such as PCCoT and KaVa, which reduce sequential bottlenecks but rely on more indirect grounding signals such as teacher hidden states or compressed KV-cache targets.

The paper also introduces LOTUS-aux, where the same supervision is routed through an auxiliary decoder conditioned on all latents and trained with teacher forcing. The auxiliary decoder is used only during training. It can match the direct route at the 3B scale, but it degrades on smaller backbones, which makes the direct LM-head route the more robust design choice.
summary_en.experiments:
The main model is Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. On GSM8K, LOTUS comes within 1 point of explicit CoT. On the out-of-domain math average, it surpasses explicit CoT while reducing thought-phase latency by 2.5x in the math-expression setting. On a more verbose natural-language CoT stress test, it matches explicit CoT accuracy and reduces thought-phase latency by 6.9x.

The ablations support two key claims. First, direct parallel supervision is important; without CoT-token grounding, the latent trace is less reliable as a reasoning carrier. Second, the looped architecture needs enough block width and loop depth. The benefit is not obtained simply by inserting latent tokens into a standard forward pass.

The interpretability analysis is also notable. Reading post-loop latents through the base LM head recovers most gold intermediate tokens, and sometimes assigns probability mass to alternative valid reasoning steps that were not used as training targets. This is evidence that the latent states are aligned with language-level reasoning rather than only optimized for final-answer accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read Sections 3.1–3.4 carefully. The important details are how padded latent blocks are inserted, how recurrent-depth processing is applied, how latent positions are aligned to gold CoT tokens, and why LOTUS-aux is only a training-time route.

For experiments, focus on Figure 1, Section 4.2, Section 4.3.1, and Section 4.3.2. Figure 1 gives the main comparison with explicit CoT. Section 4.2 should be read with attention to both accuracy and thought-phase latency. Section 4.3.1 isolates the supervision design, and Section 4.3.2 tests loop depth and latent block capacity.

Section 5.1 is useful for understanding whether the latents remain readable. The most relevant follow-up questions are how length mismatch between latent slots and CoT tokens is handled, how wall-clock latency is measured against explicit token decoding, and whether the same objective could be moved into mid-training or reasoning-focused continual pretraining.
