recommendation.zh: 改变对隐式CoT scaling上限的认知，循环权重复用+并行隐块监督的配方应立刻加入内部预训练架构ablation清单
recommendation.en: Shifts prior beliefs on latent CoT scaling limits; the weight-reuse loop + parallel latent supervision recipe should be added to internal pretraining architecture ablation queues immediately.

paper.title: CoLT: Teaching Multi-Modal Models to Think with Chain of Latent Thoughts
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has enabled multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) to tackle complex visual reasoning tasks by generating explicit intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. However, this text-based reasoning paradigm is inherently slow at inference time with even thousands of tokens and fundamentally constrained by the expressiveness of natural language. In this paper, we propose CoLT, (Chain of Latent Thoughts), a novel framework that teaches multi-modal models to re

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型依赖文本形式的思维链推理，存在推理延迟高（需自回归生成数百到数千推理token）、自然语言表达能力受限、早期推理错误易累积的问题；现有纯文本潜推理方法不匹配多模态场景，依赖额外图像标注的潜视觉推理方案又存在标注成本高、扩展性差的缺陷。
summary.importance: 为多模态推理提供了无需额外图像标注的潜推理范式，验证了用极短潜状态链替代长文本思维链的可行性，对多模态基座模型的推理效率优化、推理范式设计有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CoLT框架，用连续潜表示替代文本推理步骤，通过三重监督机制约束潜空间语义有效性：1）前向解码监督：轻量解码器基于前置潜思维预测下一步文本推理内容，保证潜表示携带递进的推理信息；2）反向解码监督：将解码器基于前置文本思维生成的隐状态与潜思维表示对齐，锚定潜空间的语义结构；3）内部监督：让模型基于当前潜步预测下一步的潜表示，约束相邻潜步的连贯过渡。
summary.experiments: 在8个多模态基准上测试，性能优于现有潜推理方法和依赖图像监督的潜视觉推理方案；相比文本思维链，推理总时长降低10.1倍，文本解码时长降低22.6倍，仅需3步潜思维即可完成推理；可视化结果验证潜表示中确实编码了有效的推理模式。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章方法部分的三重监督机制设计（3.3-3.4节），以及第4章的效率对比实验和潜表示可视化结果；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current multimodal large language models rely on text-form chain-of-thought reasoning, which suffers from three inherent limitations: high inference latency caused by autoregressive generation of hundreds to thousands of reasoning tokens, constrained expressiveness of natural language, and error accumulation from early reasoning steps. Existing text-only latent reasoning methods do not adapt to multimodal scenarios, while latent visual reasoning schemes requiring extra image annotations incur high labeling costs and poor scalability.
summary_en.importance: Provides a latent reasoning paradigm for multimodal models without additional image annotations, validates the feasibility of replacing long text CoT with extremely short latent state chains, and offers practical reference for reasoning efficiency optimization and reasoning paradigm design of multimodal base models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the CoLT framework, which replaces text reasoning steps with continuous latent representations, and regularizes latent space semantics via three complementary supervision signals: 1) Forward decoding supervision: a lightweight decoder predicts next-step textual reasoning content from preceding latent thoughts to ensure semantic validity and progressiveness of latent representations; 2) Backward decoding supervision: hidden states generated by the decoder from preceding textual thoughts are aligned with latent thought representations to anchor the semantic structure of the latent space; 3) Internal supervision: the model predicts the next-step latent representation from the current latent step to enforce coherent transitions between consecutive latent steps.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 8 multimodal benchmarks, outperforms both existing latent reasoning methods and latent visual reasoning schemes relying on image supervision. Compared with text CoT, reduces total inference latency by 10.1× and text decoding latency by 22.6×, requiring only 3 latent thought steps to complete reasoning. Visualizations confirm that effective reasoning patterns are encoded within latent representations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the three-fold supervision mechanism design in Method Chapter 3 (Sections 3.3-3.4), as well as the efficiency comparison experiments and latent representation visualization results in Chapter 4. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 潜在思维推理的双向监督设计对推理效率优化有参考价值，重点看§3的监督机制和消融实验。
recommendation.en: The bidirectional supervision design for latent reasoning is valuable for inference efficiency optimization; focus on §3 supervision mechanism and ablation studies.

paper.title: Why Struggle with Continuous Latents? Interpretable Discrete Latent Reasoning via Rendered Compression
paper.abstract: Large language models achieve high reasoning performance via explicit chain-of-thought and reinforcement learning, but require long output sequences and extended inference time. Latent reasoning reduces this cost by shifting computation into a latent space; however, continuous latent methods are hard to train, suffering from unstable and uninterpretable reasoning trajectories. We argue these issues stem from a misalignment between continuous-space reasoning and discrete symbolic supervision, as

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理 latent reasoning 的训练稳定性和可解释性问题。连续 latent token 虽然可以减少显式 CoT 的输出长度，但缺少离散锚点，难以做 teacher forcing、过程奖励分配和轨迹检查。作者提出把中间推理状态离散化成 latent token，让 latent reasoning 回到标准 next-token 训练框架内。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更接近 reasoning post-training 与新型语言建模接口，而不是基座预训练结果。它的启发在于：如果 latent reasoning 要进入可扩展训练流程，离散化可能比纯连续状态更容易接入现有 SFT、RL、reward model 和解码系统。对预训练研究也有间接意义，因为它把“压缩推理”转化为扩展词表上的序列建模问题，可用于思考未来是否需要在预训练阶段加入 latent token 或混合符号-潜变量轨迹。当前证据主要来自数学推理微调，不能直接外推到通用预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 Discrete Latent Reasoning，简称 DLR。它包含两个主要部分。第一部分是 stochastic latent codebook construction：先把文本 CoT 渲染成图像，再使用 DeepSeek-OCR2 encoder 提取结构化视觉特征，随后通过随机聚类或向量量化构建离散 latent 词表。作者希望每个 latent token 对应一个可恢复的语义单元，并报告最高约 20 倍压缩。第二部分是 augmented latent LM training：扩展 LLM 的词表和输出头，使模型可以在同一序列中处理自然语言 token 与 latent token。训练分三步：latent-text alignment 让 latent embedding 对齐到语言模型空间；latent SFT 学习生成正确的 latent 轨迹；latent RL 用 outcome reward 和 process reward 优化 latent-token policy。相较连续 latent 方法，DLR 的关键区别是把中间状态变成显式 token，因此可以使用标准 next-token prediction，也可以在离散步骤上施加过程监督。辅助 decoder 用来把 latent 轨迹还原成人可读内容，服务于检查和调试。
summary.experiments: 实验在 GSM8K-Aug-train 上微调 LLaMA3 和 Qwen3-VL，并在 GSM8K、GSM-Hard、SVAMP、MultiArith、MATH-500 上评估。论文报告 DLR 相比 RoT、ReGuLaR、CODI 等 latent reasoning baseline 有一致准确率提升，但给出的材料中没有包含完整数值表。作者还测试了从 1B 到 8B 模型规模的可扩展性，并分析 latent 轨迹的可解释性。实验重点说明 DLR 在数学推理上能减少显式推理 token，同时比连续 latent 方案更稳定。需要注意，当前验证集中在算术和数学题，尚不足以证明其对开放域推理或长程规划同样有效。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 40 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对连续 latent reasoning 三个问题的拆解：SFT/RL 训练瓶颈、动态不稳定、不可解释。方法部分重点看 codebook construction 和 augmented latent LM training，尤其是 latent token 如何进入词表、输出头如何扩展、三阶段训练各自解决什么问题。实验部分优先看压缩率、准确率、latent 轨迹重建质量、不同模型规模下的曲线。需要额外留意几个细节：codebook size 如何选，latent token 长度是否随题目复杂度变化，渲染 CoT 是否引入额外先验，以及过程奖励是否依赖人工或模型生成的步骤标签。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a training and interpretability bottleneck in latent reasoning. Continuous latent tokens can reduce the length of explicit chain-of-thought outputs, but they lack discrete anchors for teacher forcing, process rewards, and trajectory inspection. The proposed solution is to discretize intermediate reasoning states into latent tokens and train them with standard autoregressive next-token objectives.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a reasoning post-training and modeling-interface paper, not a base pretraining result. Its main relevance is the discrete interface: latent reasoning becomes compatible with existing SFT, RL, reward modeling, and decoding infrastructure once intermediate states are represented as tokens. For pretraining research, it suggests a possible route for adding compressed reasoning units to the vocabulary or training mixture. The current evidence is limited to math-oriented fine-tuning, so the result should not be read as a general pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Discrete Latent Reasoning, or DLR, has two main components. The first is stochastic latent codebook construction. Textual chain-of-thought traces are rendered into images, encoded with a DeepSeek-OCR2 encoder, and then discretized through stochastic clustering or vector quantization to form a latent vocabulary. The goal is to make each latent token a semantically recoverable unit, with reported compression up to about 20x. The second component is augmented latent LM training. The model vocabulary and output head are expanded so that natural-language tokens and latent tokens can be generated in a single sequence. Training has three stages: latent-text alignment to place latent embeddings into the LLM space, latent SFT to teach valid latent trajectories, and latent RL using outcome and process rewards. Compared with continuous latent methods, the key design choice is that intermediate computation is converted into explicit token prediction, which makes supervision and reward assignment much cleaner. An auxiliary decoder is used to render latent trajectories back into readable form for inspection.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments fine-tune LLaMA3 and Qwen3-VL on GSM8K-Aug-train and evaluate on GSM8K, GSM-Hard, SVAMP, MultiArith, and MATH-500. The paper reports consistent accuracy gains over latent reasoning baselines such as RoT, ReGuLaR, and CODI, although the supplied content does not include the full numeric tables. The authors also study scaling from 1B to 8B models and inspect the interpretability of latent trajectories. The empirical claim is that DLR reduces explicit reasoning tokens while improving stability over continuous latent approaches. The scope remains math reasoning, so transfer to open-ended reasoning or long-horizon planning is still an open question.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 to 40 minutes. Read the introduction for the diagnosis of continuous latent reasoning: inefficient supervision, unstable dynamics, and weak interpretability. In the method section, focus on the latent codebook construction and the augmented LM training pipeline, especially how latent tokens are added to the vocabulary and how the three training stages interact. In the experiments, prioritize compression ratio, accuracy tables, reconstruction or decoding quality of latent trajectories, and scaling behavior across model sizes. Useful details to check include codebook size, latent sequence length, whether rendered CoT introduces extra priors, and how process rewards are obtained.

recommendation.zh: 潜推理建模范式的新颖思路，用渲染+聚类实现离散化，重点看§3的潜词表构建方法，实验结果待完整论文验证。
recommendation.en: Novel latent reasoning paradigm using rendering + clustering for discretization; focus on §3 for latent vocabulary construction, experimental results await full paper verification.

paper.title: Invariant Reasoning Directions in Latent Trajectories of Language Models
paper.abstract: Latent reasoning models perform multi-step inference directly in hidden-state space, yet the structure of these latent reasoning trajectories remains poorly understood. We show that contrastive refinement signals between stronger and weaker reasoning trajectories exhibit a highly concentrated low-rank structure, while unconstrained latent updates remain sensitive to paraphrases, checkpoint choice, and trajectory perturbations. These observations suggest that latent reasoning trajectories contain

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 latent reasoning model 在隐藏状态空间里做多步推理时，轨迹内部到底哪些方向承载了稳定的“推理质量”信号，哪些只是对表述、checkpoint 选择、局部扰动很敏感的噪声成分。作者指出，现有 training-free latent refinement 方法通常直接用强弱参考模型的隐藏状态差分去做 steering，但这个差分向量混合了稳定结构和实例特异扰动，因此会出现三类问题：对超参敏感、对参考 checkpoint 对敏感、对语义等价 paraphrase 不稳定。论文要解决的核心问题，不是再造一个更强的 latent reasoner，而是把 latent trajectory 的几何结构拆开，识别出跨 paraphrase、跨 perturbation、跨 reference pair 仍然稳定存在的低维 invariant reasoning directions，并只沿这些方向做干预。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于提升常规 next-token LM 的训练 recipe，而在于给“非显式 CoT、直接在隐空间推理”的建模路线补上了一个关键分析视角：latent reasoning 不是一团不可解释的高维动态，强弱推理轨迹之间的有效差异可能集中在很低秩的子空间里。如果这个观察成立，它会影响两类工作。第一类是 latent reasoning / recurrent reasoning / hidden-state planning 的建模设计，后续方法可以显式约束更新落在稳定子空间，而不是在全空间里做粗暴 steering。第二类是 pretrain-posttrain 接口：如果推理质量差异在隐空间中有稳定低维结构，那么蒸馏、RL 或 verifier 信号也许可以更直接地作用在这些方向上，而不是只通过 token loss 间接塑形。贡献量级更像“机制分析 + inference-time intervention 框架”，不是基础训练范式的定型工作，但对理解 latent reasoning 这条线有实质信息增益。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 TILR，核心是“先找稳定子空间，再做受约束干预”。从全文描述看，作者先收集 stronger / weaker reasoning trajectories 的隐藏状态差分，关注的不是单个样本某一步的原始更新，而是跨输入、跨 paraphrase、跨 checkpoint pair 反复出现的差异结构。经验上这些差异在谱上高度集中，也就是前几个主方向解释了大部分强弱轨迹差异。基于这个观察，TILR 先学习一个低秩 invariant subspace，用来表示那些在不同语义等价输入和不同参考设置下都较稳定的 reasoning-associated directions。之后，原本全空间的 contrastive update 会被投影或约束到这个子空间中，只保留稳定成分，抑制实例特异噪声。第二个关键部件是 adaptive alignment gate：并不是每一步都同样强地施加子空间干预，而是根据当前轨迹与该 invariant structure 的对齐程度自适应调节 intervention strength。对齐强时，说明当前状态确实落在可解释的稳定方向附近，可以更积极地修正；对齐弱时，说明此时的差分更可能是噪声或错配，门控会减弱干预，避免把错误 steering 注入轨迹。和已有 latent refinement 相比，区别不在于再换一种 residual blending 公式，而在于把“强弱模型差分是否可直接用”这个前提拆开，认为只有其中低秩、跨条件稳定的部分才值得信任。论文还引入了 trajectory-level analysis，而不是只看最终 accuracy，包括 paraphrase consistency、latent trajectory variance、checkpoint-pair sensitivity，用这些指标去验证所谓 invariant directions 是否真的具有功能性。
summary.experiments: 从全文可确认的实验结论有几条。第一，强弱 reasoning trajectories 的差分具有明显低秩结构，少量方向就能解释大部分 variation，这支持了 invariant subspace 的前提。第二，在六个 benchmark 上，TILR 类的子空间约束干预能更稳定地改善 reasoning consistency 和 trajectory stability，同时基本保持 accuracy，不像无约束 contrastive steering 那样容易因 paraphrase 或 reference pair 改变而波动。第三，作者专门分析了三类敏感性：对 paraphrase 的一致性、对轨迹扰动后的方差、对不同 checkpoint pair 的依赖。结论是 unconstrained latent updates 在这些维度上都更脆弱，而 TILR 能显著降低这种不稳定性。摘要和给出的正文片段没有出现完整数值表、参数规模、具体 benchmark 名称和提升幅度，因此无法负责任地填入精确数字；但从实验设计看，重点不是追求大幅 accuracy gain，而是证明“低秩 invariant directions 具有功能作用”，也就是当干预被限制在这些方向上时，推理轨迹会更一致、更稳，且不会明显伤害任务正确率。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着“机制问题”去读，而不是把它当成一个直接可复用的训练 recipe。建议先看 Introduction 和 Problem Setup，抓住作者要反驳的对象：现有 latent refinement 默认强弱差分在全空间都可信，这个假设并不成立。然后重点看方法部分里 invariant subspace 的构造方式：差分样本怎么收集，低秩子空间怎么估计，是否用 SVD/PCA 类谱方法，跨 paraphrase 与跨 checkpoint 的稳定性约束具体怎么实现。接着看 adaptive alignment gate，理解它到底是基于投影能量、夹角、还是某种相似度来控制干预强度。实验部分优先看三类图表：一是差分谱集中度或 explained variance 图，二是 paraphrase consistency / trajectory variance 的对比图，三是 reference checkpoint sensitivity 的消融。若时间有限，先读这些图和对应分析，预计 30-45 分钟能抓住主线。值得深挖的点有两个：其一，低秩结构是 latent reasoning 特有，还是任何强弱模型 hidden-state 差分都会出现；其二，这种 invariant subspace 是否能转化为训练时正则、蒸馏目标或 recurrent block 的结构先验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question about latent reasoning models: when a model performs multi-step inference directly in hidden-state space, which directions in the trajectory encode stable reasoning-quality information, and which directions are merely paraphrase-sensitive or checkpoint-specific variation? Existing training-free latent refinement methods typically steer the trajectory using hidden-state differences between a stronger and a weaker reference model. The authors argue that this update is structurally mixed: it contains both useful reasoning-related signal and unstable instance-level noise. That mixture leads to three recurring failure modes: sensitivity to hyperparameters, dependence on the chosen checkpoint pair, and instability under semantically equivalent paraphrases. The core problem is therefore not “how to add another steering heuristic,” but how to isolate invariant reasoning directions in latent space and intervene only along those directions.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is indirect but meaningful. The work does not change the standard autoregressive pretraining recipe. Instead, it gives a geometric lens on latent reasoning, a line of work that tries to move reasoning from explicit token generation into hidden-state dynamics. If reasoning-quality differences are concentrated in a low-rank subspace, that has implications for future model design: recurrent latent reasoners, hidden-state planners, and post-training refinement methods may benefit from explicitly constraining updates to stable subspaces rather than operating in the full embedding space. It also matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. If verifier, distillation, or RL signals ultimately act through a small set of stable latent directions, then there may be more direct ways to shape reasoning behavior than token-level supervision alone. The contribution is best read as mechanism analysis plus an inference-time intervention framework, not as a settled new training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, TILR (Trajectory-Invariant Latent Refinement), follows a simple principle: identify a stable low-rank subspace first, then constrain refinement to that subspace. The authors collect hidden-state differences between stronger and weaker reasoning trajectories and study their structure across inputs, paraphrases, perturbations, and reference checkpoint choices. Empirically, these contrastive differences are highly concentrated spectrally: a small number of directions explain most of the variation between strong and weak trajectories. TILR uses this observation to estimate an invariant subspace that captures reasoning-associated directions that persist across semantically equivalent inputs and across reference settings. Once this subspace is learned, the usual contrastive latent update is projected into it, filtering out unstable components that are specific to a particular phrasing or trajectory realization. A second component, the adaptive alignment gate, modulates intervention strength based on how well the current trajectory aligns with the learned invariant structure. When alignment is high, the intervention is trusted more; when alignment is weak, the method suppresses the update to avoid injecting noisy or mismatched steering signals. This is the main conceptual difference from prior latent refinement methods: the paper rejects the assumption that the full strong-minus-weak hidden-state difference is uniformly meaningful. It treats only the low-rank, cross-condition stable component as reliable. The paper also introduces trajectory-level analyses beyond final accuracy, including paraphrase consistency, latent trajectory variance, and checkpoint-pair sensitivity, to test whether the identified directions are functionally relevant rather than merely descriptive.
summary_en.experiments: Several experimental findings are clear from the full text excerpt. First, the difference between stronger and weaker reasoning trajectories exhibits a pronounced low-rank structure: a small number of directions explain most of the variation. This supports the invariant-subspace premise. Second, across six benchmarks, subspace-constrained interventions improve reasoning consistency and trajectory stability while largely preserving task accuracy. Third, the paper explicitly evaluates three robustness axes: consistency under paraphrases, variance under trajectory perturbations, and sensitivity to the chosen reference checkpoint pair. Unconstrained latent steering is fragile on all three, whereas TILR reduces that fragility. The provided text does not include the full result tables, benchmark names, model sizes, or exact gains, so it would be unsafe to invent numbers. The experimental point is not primarily a large accuracy jump. It is to show that the low-rank invariant directions are functionally meaningful: when interventions are restricted to them, trajectories become more stable and more consistent without materially harming correctness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this as a geometry-and-mechanism paper, not as a plug-and-play training recipe. Start with the introduction and problem setup to understand the target of criticism: prior latent refinement methods implicitly assume that strong-vs-weak trajectory differences are trustworthy in the full hidden space. Then focus on the method section that constructs the invariant subspace. The key questions are how the contrastive trajectory differences are collected, how the low-rank subspace is estimated, and how stability across paraphrases and checkpoint pairs is enforced or measured. Next, inspect the adaptive alignment gate carefully: is it based on projection energy, angular similarity, or another alignment score? In the experiments, prioritize three kinds of figures: spectral concentration / explained-variance plots, paraphrase-consistency and trajectory-variance comparisons, and checkpoint-pair sensitivity ablations. If time is limited, those parts are enough to recover the main argument in about 30–45 minutes. Two deeper follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the low-rank structure is specific to latent reasoning or a generic property of hidden-state differences between stronger and weaker models, and whether the learned invariant subspace can be turned into a training-time regularizer, a distillation target, or an architectural prior for recurrent latent reasoning blocks.

recommendation.zh: 读低秩轨迹分析和 gate 设计即可；若实验规模小，它更像机制探针，不足以证明 latent reasoning recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the low-rank trajectory analysis and gate design; if the scale is small, treat it as a probe, not evidence for a latent-reasoning recipe.

paper.title: Formalizing Latent Thoughts: Four Axioms of Thought Representation in LLMs
paper.abstract: We introduce an axiomatic evaluation framework for latent thought representations in LLMs, comprising metrics that are independent of downstream benchmark scores and reveal representational failures that benchmark accuracy masks. Existing evaluations conflate representation quality with model capacity. Therefore, failures cannot be attributed to the representation rather than to the model that processes it. We formalize four functional axioms (Causality, Minimality, Separability, and Stability)

summary.core_problem: 提出一套不依赖下游任务准确率的 latent thought representation 评估框架，用来判断 LLM 内部或外部“思维表示”是否真的具备可用的功能属性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评估方法和机制分析。它试图区分表示质量和后续处理模型能力，避免把 benchmark accuracy 误当成 latent representation 本身的质量证据。
summary.technical_approach: 作者形式化四个功能性公理：Causality、Minimality、Separability、Stability，并为每个公理定义可直接在 representation 上计算的定量指标。方法重点不是训练新模型，而是对候选表示做独立审计。
summary.experiments: 论文审计 open-weight LLM 在 23 个推理任务上的候选表示，任务包括 spatial reasoning 和 factual QA。主要发现是没有候选表示同时满足四个公理；表示可以区分任务类型，但难以区分同一任务内的两个具体问题；表示包含的信息很大程度上不超过输入本身。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of British Columbia。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to evaluate latent thought representations in LLMs without reducing representation quality to downstream task accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation and analysis framework. The useful point is the separation between the representation itself and the capacity of the model that consumes that representation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formalizes four functional axioms—Causality, Minimality, Separability, and Stability—and defines quantitative metrics that can be computed directly on the representation. The work is an audit framework rather than a new pretraining or reasoning method.
summary_en.experiments: The authors audit open-weight LLMs across 23 reasoning tasks, including spatial reasoning and factual QA. They report that no candidate representation satisfies all four axioms, that representations separate task type more reliably than individual instances within a task, and that they encode little information beyond the input.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of British Columbia.

recommendation.zh: 可看 abstract 和指标定义；结论像是给 latent reasoning 表示降温，但实验规模不足以改动训练侧 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and metric definitions; it is a useful caution on latent reasoning representations, but not strong enough to change pretraining practice.

paper.title: VideoLatent: Video-Language Learning via Latent Self-Forcing
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning have shown promise in enhancing video understanding and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing CoT-based MLLMs require labor-intensive CoT annotations and incur substantial training and inference overhead. While visual latent reasoning has emerged as a more efficient alternative, existing methods primarily focus on image tasks and heavily rely on additional supervision signals for visual latent

summary.core_problem: 解决现有视频多模态大模型依赖人工CoT标注、视觉潜推理需要额外监督信号，导致训练推理成本高、迁移性差的问题。
summary.importance: 多模态理解方向的方法创新，首次提出仅依赖标准答案的视频潜推理自监督训练范式，降低标注成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VideoLatent，设计潜变量注入模块适配视频时序特征，配套潜自强迫训练范式，包含潜对齐与潜多样性两个目标，无需CoT/辅助图像等额外监督。
summary.experiments: 在多个视频理解与推理基准上测试，相比现有CoT类MLLM降低训练推理开销的同时保持或提升推理性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses high training/inference costs and poor transferability of video MLLMs caused by reliance on manual CoT annotations and extra supervision signals for visual latent reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation in multimodal understanding, proposing the first self-supervised video latent reasoning training paradigm that only depends on ground-truth answers to reduce annotation costs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes VideoLatent with a latent injection module tailored for video temporal features, paired with a latent self-forcing training paradigm consisting of latent alignment and latent diversity objectives, requiring no extra supervision such as CoT traces or auxiliary images.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multiple video understanding and reasoning benchmarks, maintaining or improving reasoning performance compared to CoT-based MLLMs while reducing training and inference overhead.

recommendation.zh: 视频MLLM的潜推理训练思路可参考，但属于增量改进，核心是后训练侧技巧，看摘要和方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The latent reasoning training idea for video MLLMs is worth referencing, but it is an incremental improvement focused on post-training tricks; read the abstract and method section only.

paper.title: Continuous Audio Thinking for Large Audio Language Models
paper.abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) have shown impressive capabilities on diverse audio understanding tasks, ranging from speech transcription to music analysis. However, because LALMs are typically trained to produce text-aligned responses, their hidden states are progressively shaped for text generation rather than for preserving acoustic information. As a result, the diverse acoustic content that audio carries, such as phonetic detail, prosody, sound events, affect, and pitch, is lost along t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是大型音频语言模型中的监督错配问题：输入音频包含帧级、频谱级和韵律级信息，但训练目标主要是生成文本响应，导致模型上层隐状态逐步偏向文本预测，细粒度声学信息在回答前被压缩或丢失。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“思考”从文本链式推理扩展到连续隐空间，尤其适合音频这类难以完整语言化的模态。它不是重新设计音频 tokenizer 或基座架构，而是在 audio encoder 和 LLM decoder 之间引入受监督的 latent workspace，用额外声学教师信号约束中间状态。这类方法对多模态预训练有参考意义：当目标模态信息密度高、文本监督稀疏时，仅靠 response loss 很难让 LM 保留足够的非文本证据，需要在隐层位置加入更贴近模态结构的训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: CoAT 在用户音频输入和 assistant 文本响应之间插入一段连续思考块，由 <|audio_think_start|>、若干 <|audio_think|> 和 <|audio_think_end|> 组成。这些位置不是生成自然语言 rationale，而是作为 LLM 内部的连续 latent positions。模型在这些位置上的 hidden states 会接受多教师蒸馏监督，教师覆盖多个互补声学维度，包括音频重建、语音内容、声音事件、副语言特征和音高。训练时仍保留文本 response 的 next-token loss，同时用蒸馏 loss 让 thinking states 对齐不同专家的声学表征。方法的一个关键取舍是：不让模型把音频先转写成语言解释，因为这会丢掉音高、韵律、情感、背景声等细节；也不改 backbone 架构，而是用特殊 token 和辅助监督嵌入现有 LALM。推理时 thinking block 在 prefill 阶段一次性消耗，不像文本 CoT 那样增加自回归解码长度。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个音频语言模型 backbone：Qwen2-Audio、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 和 Audio Flamingo 3。作者在多类音频理解和推理 benchmark 上比较 CoAT、原始模型和文本 CoT。给出的主要结论是：CoAT 在不同 backbone 上都带来稳定提升，并且相比文本 CoT 有更低的单样本延迟。文中还做了传播分析，显示 thinking positions 上的辅助声学监督会影响最终文本响应，而不只是停留在中间层表征。由于提供的正文片段没有包含完整实验表格，具体 benchmark 分数、训练数据量、thinking block 长度消融和各专家蒸馏项贡献无法可靠补充。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点看方法部分 3.2 到 3.4：thinking block 的构造、多专家蒸馏目标、stage-wise training schedule。Figure 1 适合看清楚它和文本 CoT 的延迟差异，Figure 2 适合看整体训练管线。实验部分应优先找三类消融：不同音频专家的贡献、thinking token 数量或长度策略、是否只靠 response loss 也能学到类似效果。预计阅读 25 到 35 分钟。若关注多模态基座训练，可以重点思考它是否能迁移到视频、音乐、语音对话和 native multimodal LM 的中间表征监督。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a supervision mismatch in large audio language models: the input carries dense acoustic structure, while the training signal is mostly sparse text generation. As a result, upper-layer hidden states become optimized for textual responses and may discard fine-grained acoustic evidence before the model answers.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining research is the move from verbalized reasoning to continuous latent reasoning for a non-text modality. CoAT does not introduce a new audio tokenizer or a new backbone. Instead, it adds a supervised latent workspace between audio input and text response. This is relevant to multimodal pretraining because response-only losses are often too weak for modalities where important evidence is not naturally expressible as text, such as pitch, prosody, affect, background events, and temporal acoustic structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoAT inserts an audio thinking block between the user input and the assistant response. The block is marked by special tokens such as <|audio_think_start|>, repeated <|audio_think|> positions, and <|audio_think_end|>. These positions are not decoded as natural-language rationales. They are continuous hidden-state slots inside the LLM. The hidden states at these slots are supervised through distillation from multiple audio experts, covering reconstruction, speech content, sound events, paralinguistic attributes, and pitch. The model is still trained with the usual next-token loss on the textual answer, but the latent thinking states receive additional acoustic supervision. The main design choice is to avoid forcing acoustic evidence through text CoT, since text is a lossy bottleneck for many audio attributes. At inference time, the thinking block is consumed during prefill, so it does not add autoregressive decoding steps.
summary_en.experiments: The method is instantiated on three LALM backbones: Qwen2-Audio, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, and Audio Flamingo 3. The evaluation spans multiple audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks. The reported pattern is consistent improvement across backbones, with lower per-sample latency than text chain-of-thought. The paper also reports analyses showing that auxiliary supervision on the thinking positions propagates to the final textual responses. The provided manuscript excerpt does not include the full experimental tables, so exact benchmark scores, training data size, thinking-block length ablations, and per-expert contribution numbers cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper with focus on Sections 3.2 to 3.4: construction of the thinking block, the multi-expert distillation objective, and the stage-wise training schedule. Figure 1 is useful for understanding the latency tradeoff against text CoT, and Figure 2 gives the training pipeline. In the experimental section, prioritize ablations over the headline scores: expert type, number of thinking positions, and whether the improvement comes from latent supervision rather than extra context length. Expected reading time is about 25 to 35 minutes. For multimodal pretraining, the main question is whether this latent-supervision pattern transfers to video, music, spoken dialogue, and native multimodal LMs.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和蒸馏目标即可；它提醒音频 LM 不能把声学信息过早压成文本语义。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and distillation loss; the useful signal is that audio LMs should not collapse acoustics into text semantics too early.

paper.title: Learning to Refine Hidden States for Reliable LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models show strong reasoning ability, but their internal reasoning process can remain unstable in complex multi-step settings, where early hidden-state errors may propagate to incorrect predictions. We propose ReLAR, a reinforcement-guided latent refinement framework that iteratively updates hidden representations before decoding. ReLAR maintains a compact latent reasoning state and uses learned depth and action controllers to adaptively determine both the number and direction of

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是推理阶段的内部状态稳定性：LLM 在多步推理里常不是缺知识，而是早期隐藏状态一旦偏了，后续解码会沿着错误方向持续放大。作者试图解决的问题是，能否在不显式生成长链式思维文本的情况下，直接在 latent space 中迭代修正 hidden states，让模型在输出前先把内部表征调整到更稳定、更一致的状态。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接相关性不算强，更接近推理时 latent reasoning / test-time computation 方向。但它有两个启发点。第一，它把“推理增强不一定要靠外显 CoT”这件事做成了一个可训练框架，说明内部状态控制可能是 next-token 解码之外的一条补充路径。第二，它把 RL 用在 hidden-state refinement controller 上，而不是传统 token-level policy，这对研究 pretrain 与 post-train 接口、latent reasoning、隐式思维预算分配的人有参考价值。贡献量级偏方法探索，不像基础训练 recipe 那样会直接改变大规模预训练实践。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 ReLAR。整体结构是在一个预训练 Transformer 上外挂一套轻量 latent refinement 模块。输入经过基模型前向后得到最终层 hidden state h0，再通过一个抽取网络压缩成低维 reasoning state s0。之后不立刻解码，而是在 latent space 中执行若干轮 refinement。每一步由两个控制器共同决定：depth controller 决定是否继续 refinement、需要多少步；action controller 决定当前 refinement 的方向或动作。作者把 s_t 设计成一个紧凑瓶颈，两个控制器都只读这个状态，这样所有后续修正都由一个低维摘要来驱动，避免直接在全量 hidden tensor 上做高成本搜索。训练上使用 policy gradient，奖励信号不是最终任务回报，而是 step-wise likelihood improvement，也就是每次 refinement 后目标输出似然是否提升。这个设计的好处是 credit assignment 更细，训练信号更密；同时避免显式 CoT 监督。与已有 latent intervention 工作相比，区别在于它不是一次性编辑 hidden state，也不是静态 steering，而是把 hidden-state revision 做成可迭代、可自适应深度的过程。与 CoT 相比，它不生成中间文本，因此试图用更低的 token 开销换取更稳定的内部推理。
summary.experiments: 从全文片段能确认的实验范围包括 medical reasoning、mathematical reasoning、multi-hop reasoning 和 open-ended generation。作者声称在临床推理 benchmark 上提升了 step-level coherence 和整体可靠性，同时推理时开销低于显式 reasoning baseline。方法层面的关键实验应包括：1）与直接解码基线比较，验证 hidden-state refinement 能减少早期错误传播；2）与 CoT 或其他显式推理方法比较，验证在不生成长推理文本时仍能获得更稳的结果；3）对 depth controller 和 action controller 的消融，检查自适应步数和动作选择是否都必要；4）对 latent state 维度、refinement 步数上限、奖励设计的消融。给出的全文片段没有完整结果表和具体数字，因此无法可靠写出提升幅度、模型规模或数据规模。就论文叙述看，作者更强调 reliability / coherence 与 latency trade-off，而不是绝对任务分数的大幅领先。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着问题去读：它到底是在做真正的 latent reasoning，还是在做一种 learned test-time hidden-state editing。先看 Introduction，确认作者要替代的是显式 CoT 的哪一部分。然后重点看 Methodology 里三个对象：reasoning state s_t 如何从 h0 提取、action controller 具体如何作用到 hidden state、depth controller 如何决定停止。训练部分要看清 reward 定义和 policy gradient 的 credit assignment 是否稳定。实验部分优先看消融，而不是主表，因为这类方法最容易靠额外计算量取胜。预计 25–35 分钟可完成泛读；如果关心 latent reasoning，可进一步细看 refinement operator 的参数化方式和每步计算成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses instability in internal reasoning rather than lack of knowledge. In multi-step problems, an LLM may commit too early to a flawed hidden representation, and subsequent decoding amplifies that error. The central question is whether one can refine hidden states directly, before decoding, so that the model stabilizes its internal representation without relying on explicit chain-of-thought text generation.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to latent reasoning and test-time computation. Its main value is conceptual. First, it treats reasoning improvement as hidden-state control rather than token-level rationale generation, which is useful for people exploring alternatives to standard autoregressive CoT. Second, it applies reinforcement learning to a latent refinement controller instead of a token policy, which may matter for the pretrain/post-train interface and for future work on implicit reasoning budgets. The contribution is exploratory and method-oriented, not a change to large-scale pretraining recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReLAR augments a pretrained transformer with an iterative latent refinement loop. A normal forward pass produces the final-layer hidden state h0. A lightweight extractor compresses this into a low-dimensional reasoning state s0, which acts as a bottleneck summary of the current internal reasoning status. Instead of decoding immediately, the model performs a sequence of refinement steps in latent space. Two learned controllers govern the process: a depth controller decides how many refinement steps to take, and an action controller chooses the direction or type of refinement at each step. Both controllers consume only the compact reasoning state, which keeps the control mechanism lightweight and avoids direct search over the full hidden tensor. Training uses policy gradients with a step-wise likelihood improvement signal as reward: if a refinement step improves the likelihood of the desired output, it is reinforced. This gives denser credit assignment than using only final-task reward and avoids explicit supervision on natural-language reasoning traces. Relative to prior latent intervention work, the novelty is iterative and adaptive hidden-state revision rather than one-shot editing or static steering. Relative to CoT, the method aims to trade text-level reasoning overhead for internal latent computation.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full text, the evaluation covers medical reasoning, mathematical reasoning, multi-hop reasoning, and open-ended generation. The claimed outcome is improved step-level coherence and overall reliability on clinical reasoning benchmarks, with lower inference overhead than explicit reasoning baselines. The most important experiments are likely: comparison against direct decoding to show reduced error propagation; comparison against CoT-style baselines to test whether latent refinement can recover some reasoning gains without generating long traces; ablations on the depth and action controllers; and sensitivity studies on latent state size, maximum refinement depth, and reward design. The excerpt does not include full tables, model sizes, dataset sizes, or exact gains, so it would be unsafe to provide fabricated numbers. The framing suggests that the paper emphasizes reliability/latency trade-offs more than large absolute score jumps.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this one with a narrow question in mind: is it learning genuine latent reasoning, or is it mainly a form of test-time hidden-state editing? Start with the introduction to see what failure mode of CoT the authors are targeting. Then focus on three components in the method section: how the reasoning state is extracted from h0, how the action controller modifies the hidden representation, and how the depth controller decides when to stop. In training, inspect the reward definition carefully; the paper depends on whether step-wise likelihood improvement is a stable and meaningful signal. In experiments, prioritize ablations over headline results, because methods like this can benefit simply from extra computation. A practical skim takes about 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融；latent refinement方向值得跟，但摘要缺模型规模和baseline细节，先当弱证据别改训练路线。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; latent refinement is worth tracking, but missing model-scale and baseline details make this weak evidence for changing a training plan.

paper.title: Tyler: Typed Latent Reasoning for Language Models -- When to Think, What to Compute, and How Much to Allocate
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves reasoning in large language models (LLMs) by externalizing intermediate computation as discrete text tokens, but this textual interface also introduces redundancy and inference overhead. Latent reasoning offers a promising alternative by carrying part of the computation in continuous representations. However, existing methods typically predefine when latent computation is invoked and how it is allocated during decoding, leaving a key problem unresolved:

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 latent reasoning 里一个一直没有被真正解决的问题：模型不只是“能不能插入 latent token”，而是要在自回归解码过程中，在线决定三件事——什么时候进入 latent computation、进入后做哪一类计算、以及分配多少计算预算。已有方法大多把 latent reasoning 当成一种固定接口：要么预先规定 latent step 出现的位置，要么只做二元决策，判断是否触发 latent mode。这样做的问题是，latent computation 与当前推理状态耦合不够，也无法表达不同推理阶段需要不同内部计算的事实。Tyler 把这个问题重新表述为 typed and budgeted computation：把隐式推理看成若干具有明确功能角色的算子，由模型在生成时按需调用，而不是把所有隐式推理都压进一种统一的连续表示里。
summary.importance: 对预训练和基座建模的启发主要有两层。第一，它把“latent reasoning 是否有用”推进到“latent reasoning 应该如何被组织和调度”。这比单纯压缩 CoT 更接近一种新的语言建模接口：visible token 负责对外通信，latent operator 负责内部计算。第二，它强调 latent computation 的功能分化，而不是把 latent token 当成无类型的软提示或隐藏状态补丁。这一点对未来把 reasoning 作为模型内生计算资源来训练很关键，因为它涉及计算分配、推理阶段结构、以及跨任务迁移时哪些内部操作可以复用。就量级看，这还不是替代 AR 预训练范式的工作，但它给出了一个比较完整的 online latent reasoning 框架，尤其对“test-time compute 如何由模型自己调度”这个方向有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成。第一部分是 typed latent operator。作者定义了三类操作：Og 对应 global orientation，用来在较早阶段建立整体解题方向；Os 对应 state update，用来更新当前推理状态；Op 对应 procedural abstraction，用来调用更偏程序化、模式化的求解过程。每个 operator 都不是输出离散 token，而是根据当前 decoding context 生成一段 operator-conditioned latent tokens，再把这些连续向量拼接回上下文，继续后续可见 token 的自回归生成。这里的关键不是“插入 latent token”本身，而是给 latent computation 加上功能标签，使不同 operator 学到不同的计算角色。

第二部分是 operator invocation policy。模型在每个解码步不再只在词表上做 next-token 预测，而是在“生成可见 token”与“调用某个 latent operator 并指定预算”之间做选择。也就是说，动作空间包含 visible decoding 和若干 latent actions，latent action 还带 budget 维度，决定插入多少 latent tokens。这样模型可以在简单位置直接输出文本，在困难位置先做内部计算，再回到显式生成。

训练分两阶段。Stage 1 先冻结主 LLM，只训练 latent operators 和 latent synthesis module，让每个 operator 对齐到预设的功能角色。这里作者引入 Latent Synthesis Model，把 operator identity 与当前状态映射成一段可被主模型消费的 latent token 序列。先冻结 backbone 的目的很明确：避免在早期把“operator 学什么”和“主模型如何适配 latent interface”纠缠在一起，降低训练不稳定性。Stage 2 再固定 Stage 1 学到的 latent interface，只训练调用策略，使用 GRPO 做策略优化。奖励来自最终任务表现，因此 policy 学的是何时调用、调用哪种 operator、预算给多少。由于 operator invocation 是稀疏事件，作者还加了 operator-anchored auxiliary objective 来稳定训练，避免 policy 在少量触发位置上梯度过弱或塌缩到单一动作。

和已有 latent reasoning 方法相比，区别主要有三点。其一，不是 fixed-position latent insertion，而是 online decision。其二，不是单一 latent mode，而是 typed operators。其三，不是只决定“要不要想”，而是连“想什么”和“想多久”一起学。这使它更像一个可调度的内部计算系统，而不是一个附加的 soft-thought 通道。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验重点是三类：多骨干、多任务泛化，以及连续适应。摘要和正文可确认的结论是，Tyler 在多个 backbone 和多个 reasoning benchmark 上都优于强基线，而且提升能迁移到训练域之外。作者特别强调两点分析结果。

第一，policy 学到了与任务难度和推理阶段相关的 operator 使用模式。较容易样本或较直接的生成阶段，更倾向于继续 visible decoding；难度上升时，latent operator 调用频率增加。不同 operator 的触发位置也不同：Og 更像前期的全局定向，Os 更像中间过程中的状态修正，Op 更偏向需要复用程序化解题模板的阶段。这说明 typed design 不是纯粹的人为命名，至少在行为上形成了可分化的功能角色。

第二，在 sequential adaptation 设置里，作者按 code、science、math、theorem reasoning 这样的顺序做连续适应，Tyler 的最终性能更高，同时遗忘更低。这个结果对基座研究更有意思，因为它暗示 typed latent operators 可能提供了一种比纯显式 CoT 更稳的内部计算接口：新领域适应时，不必完全改写外显推理分布，而是部分复用已有 operator 的内部功能。

从你给出的全文片段里，具体参数量、数据规模、各 benchmark 的绝对分数和提升幅度没有完整展开，因此不适合编造数字。阅读时应重点去正文实验表确认：1）用了哪些 backbone；2）训练域与测试域是否严格分离；3）相对 fixed latent、untyped latent、纯 CoT baseline 的提升幅度；4）budget 分配的消融是否证明“typed + adaptive budget”同时必要，而不是只靠更多 test-time compute 获益。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读后挑重点深看，预计 35 到 50 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，确认作者到底把 latent reasoning 重新定义成了什么问题。很多类似工作只是换一种 soft token 接口，这篇的关键在于 online typed scheduling。

方法部分重点看三处。第一，三类 operator 的形式化定义，以及 latent synthesis module 如何把 operator 与当前状态映射成 latent token 序列。这里决定了 typed latent 是否真的有独立参数化和独立功能。第二，policy 的动作空间设计，尤其 budget 是离散选择还是连续参数化，奖励如何构造，GRPO 在这里优化的对象到底是单独 policy head 还是与主模型共享部分参数。第三，operator-anchored auxiliary objective 的具体形式，因为这关系到稀疏调用场景下 RL 是否稳定。

实验部分优先看：主结果表、operator ablation、budget ablation、跨域泛化、sequential adaptation。若时间有限，可以跳过常规 benchmark 描述，直接看能否回答三个问题：typed operator 是否比 untyped latent 更好；adaptive invocation 是否比 fixed schedule 更好；continual adaptation 的收益是否来自更少遗忘而不只是更高初始分数。

如果要深挖，最值得追的是两个点。一个是 typed operator 是否真的学到可迁移的“计算原语”，还是仍然高度依赖训练任务分布。另一个是这种框架能否前移到 pretraining 或 mid-training，而不只是 reasoning finetune 阶段使用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a missing piece in latent reasoning: not merely how to insert latent tokens, but how to let an autoregressive LM decide online when to invoke latent computation, what kind of internal computation to run, and how much budget to spend. Prior latent-reasoning methods usually hard-code the invocation pattern or reduce the decision to a binary trigger. That leaves the model with little control over how latent computation should interact with the evolving reasoning state. Tyler reframes the problem as typed, budgeted computation during decoding, where latent reasoning is treated as an internal compute interface rather than a compressed form of chain-of-thought.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is conceptual. It moves the discussion from “can latent reasoning help” to “how should latent reasoning be structured and scheduled.” That matters for foundation-model research because it points toward a richer generation interface: visible tokens for communication, latent operators for internal computation. The typed design is also important. Instead of treating all latent tokens as one undifferentiated soft channel, the paper argues that different reasoning stages require different internal functions. This is relevant to future work on test-time compute allocation, reasoning-aware pretraining, and reusable internal computation across domains. It is not yet a replacement for standard AR pretraining, but it is a serious step toward making latent computation a first-class modeling primitive.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Tyler has two core components.

First, it introduces typed latent operators. The model can invoke three operator types: Og for global orientation, Os for state update, and Op for procedural abstraction. Each operator takes the current decoding state and produces a sequence of operator-conditioned latent tokens, which are appended to the context and consumed by the same autoregressive backbone. The key idea is not latent-token insertion by itself, but functional specialization: latent computation is decomposed into reusable roles rather than collapsed into a single generic latent mode.

Second, Tyler learns an operator-invocation policy. At each decoding step, the model chooses between emitting a visible token and invoking one of the latent operators with a certain budget. The budget controls how much latent computation is inserted, typically via the number of latent tokens or latent steps. This turns decoding into a mixed action process: direct visible generation for easy steps, internal computation for harder ones.

Training is split into two stages. In Stage 1, the backbone LM is frozen while the latent operators and the latent synthesis module are trained. This isolates the problem of learning a usable latent interface from the problem of policy learning. The latent synthesis module maps the current state plus operator identity into latent-token sequences that the frozen LM can consume. In Stage 2, the learned latent interface is fixed and only the invocation policy is optimized with GRPO. The policy learns when to call an operator, which operator to call, and how much budget to allocate, using task-level reward. Because operator calls are sparse events, the paper adds an operator-anchored auxiliary objective to stabilize learning and prevent collapse or weak gradients at invocation positions.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear: online invocation instead of fixed insertion points, typed operators instead of a single latent mode, and joint learning of whether, what, and how much to compute instead of a simple trigger mechanism.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story centers on three claims: gains across multiple backbones and reasoning benchmarks, transfer beyond the training domain, and better sequential adaptation. From the provided full-text excerpt, the paper reports consistent improvements over strong baselines across several model families and tasks.

The most interesting analysis is behavioral specialization of the learned policy. Operator usage varies with task difficulty and decoding stage. Easier steps rely more on direct visible decoding, while harder steps trigger more latent computation. The three operators are used differently: Og appears earlier as a planning or orientation mechanism, Os is used more for intermediate state refinement, and Op is associated with more procedural or template-like reasoning segments. This supports the claim that the typed operators acquire differentiated functional roles rather than acting as arbitrary labels.

The second notable result is in sequential adaptation across domains such as code, science, math, and theorem reasoning. Tyler reaches higher final performance with lower forgetting than baselines. That is especially relevant for foundation-model researchers, because it suggests that typed latent computation may provide a more reusable internal interface under domain shift.

The excerpt does not expose the full numeric tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains, model sizes, or dataset scales. When reading the paper, the main things to verify are: which backbones were used, how training and transfer domains were separated, how much Tyler improves over fixed latent and untyped latent baselines, and whether the budget ablations show that the benefit comes from adaptive allocation rather than simply spending more test-time compute.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it deserves a careful skim. A good pass takes about 35 to 50 minutes. Start with the introduction and the main framework figure to pin down the paper’s actual claim. The important shift is not “latent tokens exist,” but “latent computation is typed and scheduled online.”

In the method section, focus on three pieces. First, how the three operators are parameterized and how the latent synthesis module turns operator identity plus current state into latent-token sequences. Second, the action space of the invocation policy: whether budget is discrete or continuous, how policy decisions are integrated with token decoding, and what exactly GRPO is optimizing. Third, the operator-anchored auxiliary loss, since sparse invocation is where many RL-style control schemes become unstable.

In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison table, operator ablations, budget ablations, transfer results, and sequential adaptation. If time is limited, skip benchmark boilerplate and read only enough to answer three questions: does typed latent reasoning beat untyped latent reasoning, does adaptive invocation beat fixed schedules, and does the continual-adaptation gain come from reduced forgetting rather than a stronger starting point.

The two deeper follow-up questions are whether these operators really become transferable computational primitives, and whether the same framework could be moved earlier into pretraining or mid-training instead of being used only at reasoning fine-tuning time.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和预算策略即可；想法切中 latent CoT 的硬问题，但没有规模实验前先当架构假设。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and budget policy; it targets a real latent-CoT bottleneck, but treat it as an architectural hypothesis until scaled evidence appears.

paper.title: DLWM: Diverse Latent World Models for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have improved considerably in recent years. Existing approaches typically rely on explicit chain-of-thought or continuous latent-space trajectories to enhance multi-step reasoning. However, these methods generally assume that an input admits a single latent interpretation and unfold reasoning along a fixed path or under a uniform computation budget. In real-world multimodal settings, visual observations are often subject to occlu

summary.core_problem: 多模态推理中，视觉输入常有遮挡、模糊、视角变化和语义歧义，单一路径 latent reasoning 难以覆盖多个可能解释。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态 latent reasoning 方法创新：把连续潜空间世界模型、多假设推理和强化学习结合，目标是在不固定单一路径和统一算力预算的情况下改进多步推理。
summary.technical_approach: DLWM 在连续 latent space 中构造多组 latent world hypotheses，每组表示一种可能的视觉解释或推理状态；再用强化学习选择、展开或分配推理预算。相对显式 CoT，它不依赖文本链；相对单轨 latent trajectory，它显式保留多假设分支。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据、RL 细节、baseline 名称或具体提升。可确认实验目标是 MLLM 的多步 multimodal reasoning，并关注 memory usage 与 rollout cost。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses multimodal reasoning under ambiguous visual observations, where a single latent interpretation and a fixed reasoning path can be inadequate.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a latent-reasoning method for MLLMs: it combines continuous latent world models, multiple hypotheses, and reinforcement learning to allocate reasoning effort more flexibly.
summary_en.technical_approach: DLWM constructs a set of diverse latent world hypotheses, each corresponding to a plausible interpretation of the multimodal input. Reinforcement learning is then used to guide hypothesis selection, rollout, or compute allocation. Compared with textual CoT, the reasoning is latent; compared with single-trajectory latent reasoning, it keeps multiple branches alive.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include model size, data scale, RL algorithm details, named baselines, or numerical gains. It states that the method targets MLLM multi-step reasoning while reducing memory and rollout cost.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和 RL 预算分配部分即可；多假设 latent reasoning 值得跟，但缺数字前不要改训练路线。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and RL budget-allocation section; multi-hypothesis latent reasoning is worth tracking, but do not update training plans without numbers.

paper.title: Latent Thought Flow: Efficient Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on intermediate reasoning, yet explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) suffers from a linguistic space bottleneck: each thought must be decoded into tokens, causing high inference overhead. Latent reasoning moves deliberation into continuous space, but existing methods mostly learn deterministic or reward-maximizing paths, lacking a principled way to allocate probability across trajectories with different correctness and costs. We propose Latent Thought Flo

summary.core_problem: 把 LLM 的中间推理从显式 CoT token 序列迁移到连续潜变量轨迹中，以降低推理开销并更好分配计算。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练/推理范式创新：它不是继续优化文本 CoT，而是把 latent reasoning 建模为带质量-成本权衡的随机轨迹采样问题，对 test-time compute 和 reasoning supervision 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Latent Thought Flow，将推理过程表示为可变长度连续轨迹，并训练 sampler 去匹配由答案质量和计算成本共同诱导的 posterior；具体用 continuous GFlowNet 和随机 latent transition 实现。为缓解答案级监督稀疏，加入 Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance 作为中间奖励训练目标，并用 reference-prior regularizer 约束探索，避免 latent path 漂移过大。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在 finetuning 和 transfer learning setting 下实验，但未披露模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。需要重点检查实验是否控制了解码 token 数、latent steps、wall-clock latency 和最终正确率之间的 trade-off。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper moves intermediate reasoning from explicit Chain-of-Thought tokens into continuous latent trajectories to reduce inference overhead and allocate computation more flexibly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training and reasoning-paradigm method: instead of optimizing textual CoT, it formulates latent reasoning as stochastic trajectory sampling under answer-quality and computation-cost rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent Thought Flow represents reasoning as variable-length continuous trajectories and trains a sampler to match a reward-induced posterior over correctness and cost. The implementation uses a continuous GFlowNet with stochastic latent transitions, an Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance objective for sparse answer supervision, and a reference-prior regularizer to keep exploration anchored.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments in fine-tuning and transfer-learning settings, but gives no model sizes, data scale, baseline list, or quantitative gains. The key checks are whether the paper controls for decoded token count, latent-step count, latency, and final accuracy under the same compute budget.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法目标和 compute-cost posterior 设定；若实验 latency 口径干净，可作为 latent reasoning 内部消融候选。
recommendation.en: Read the objective and the compute-cost posterior setup; if the latency accounting is clean, it is worth adding to internal latent-reasoning ablations.

paper.title: SuperThoughts: Reasoning Tokens in Superposition
paper.abstract: Long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves LLM problem-solving but is computationally expensive due to sequential token generation. While recent works explore reasoning in continuous latent spaces to bypass discrete token generation, they often struggle with training stability and fail to scale to complex, long-horizon tasks due to lack of supervision signal. We propose SuperThoughts, which compresses pairs of consecutive CoT tokens into single latent representations and decodes two tokens p

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想解决长 CoT 推理的串行开销问题：标准自回归推理每生成一个思维 token 都要做一次前向计算，而直接转向连续 latent reasoning 又容易丢掉 token 级监督，训练不稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在建模接口，而不是完整的基座预训练 recipe。SuperThoughts 提供了一个折中点：不完全放弃离散 CoT，也不让模型在无约束 latent 空间里自由漂移，而是把相邻两个 CoT token 压到一个表示中，同时保留两个离散 token 的交叉熵监督。它更像是 latent reasoning 和 multi-token prediction 的结合，可用于理解“压缩推理轨迹”时监督信号怎样保留。贡献量级偏中等，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 CoT 区间按 token pair 重排。每一步不再消费单个 CoT token，而是由 Compressor 将两个 token embedding 压成一个 H 维向量。Compressor 有两种实现：简单线性投影，把两个 embedding 拼接后映射回 hidden size；或用一个小 Transformer block 处理 token pair，再取第二个位置的 hidden state。随后主干模型预测下一对中的第一个 token，轻量 MTP module 预测下一对中的第二个 token。训练分两阶段：先做压缩表示对齐，通过 distillation 让压缩向量落到主干可理解的表示空间；再端到端联合训练 Compressor、主干和 MTP module，用离散 token 级 CE 约束两个输出位置。推理时加入 confidence-based adaptive inference：当 MTP 对第二个 token 不够确定时，回退到标准单 token 解码。这个设计牺牲一部分理论上的 2 倍步数压缩，换取难步骤上的准确率稳定。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct、7B-Instruct、14B-Instruct 做 finetuning，评测 MATH500、AMC23、OlympiadBench 和 GPQA-Diamond。论文报告在保持 accuracy 距离标准 CoT baseline 约 1–2 个百分点的情况下，CoT 长度减少约 20–35%。这个数字低于理想的 50%，原因是 adaptive fallback 会在低置信步骤恢复单 token 解码。关键实验应关注不同模型规模下的长度-准确率折中、Compressor 形式的消融、两阶段训练是否必要、以及 confidence threshold 对吞吐和准确率的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。重点看方法部分 3.1–3.3：Compressor 如何构造、MTP head 如何接到主干上、adaptive inference 的回退条件是什么。实验部分优先看主结果表和消融表，尤其是线性 Compressor 与 Transformer Compressor 的差异、没有 distillation 时是否掉点、fallback 比例与准确率的关系。需要带着一个限制去读：它主要压缩已有 CoT token 序列，并不证明模型学到了更抽象的连续推理；性能也依赖高质量 CoT 监督和数学指令模型初始化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the serial cost of long chain-of-thought reasoning. Standard autoregressive CoT spends one forward pass per reasoning token, while unconstrained latent reasoning often loses dense token-level supervision and becomes hard to train.
summary_en.importance: The main value is as a modeling interface rather than a full pretraining recipe. SuperThoughts sits between explicit CoT and latent reasoning: it compresses adjacent CoT tokens into one representation, but still supervises both discrete tokens with cross-entropy. This makes it useful for studying how far reasoning traces can be compressed before supervision and controllability degrade. The contribution is moderate and is best read as a practical variant of multi-token prediction for reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method groups the CoT span into token pairs. A Compressor maps two token embeddings into one hidden-size vector. The compressor can be a linear projection over concatenated embeddings or a small Transformer block whose second-position hidden state is used as the compressed representation. Given the compressed state, the main backbone predicts the first token of the next pair, and a lightweight MTP module predicts the second token. Training has two stages: first, representation distillation aligns the compressed latent with a space the backbone can consume; then all components are trained jointly with token-level cross-entropy for both predicted positions. At inference time, a confidence-based adaptive decoder falls back to standard single-token generation when the MTP prediction is uncertain. This keeps difficult steps safer, at the cost of giving up the ideal 2x reduction in decoding steps.
summary_en.experiments: The paper fine-tunes Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct, 7B-Instruct, and 14B-Instruct, and evaluates on MATH500, AMC23, OlympiadBench, and GPQA-Diamond. It reports roughly 20–35% CoT length reduction while staying within about 1–2 accuracy points of the standard CoT baseline. The reduction is smaller than the theoretical 50% because adaptive fallback restores single-token decoding on uncertain steps. The most informative results are the scale comparison, compressor ablations, the effect of the distillation stage, and the accuracy-throughput curve under different confidence thresholds.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus on Sections 3.1–3.3 for the compressor, MTP attachment, and adaptive decoding rule. In the experiments, read the main benchmark table and the ablations on compressor type, two-stage training, and fallback threshold. The key caveat is that the method compresses supervised CoT tokens; it does not by itself establish a general latent reasoning mechanism independent of high-quality CoT traces.

recommendation.zh: 读 MTP 设计和 fallback 消融即可；它是实用加速，不是 latent reasoning 的根本解法。
recommendation.en: Read the MTP design and fallback ablation; this is a practical decoding-speed trick, not a fundamental solution to latent reasoning.

paper.title: LaME: Learning to Think in Latent Space for Multimodal Embedding via Information Bottleneck
paper.abstract: Reasoning-driven universal multimodal embedding has advanced rapidly by introducing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning into the embedding pipeline. Despite the strong performance across both general and complex tasks, this paradigm suffers from two core limitations: (i) autoregressive CoT reasoning incurs high computational cost, making it impractical for low-latency retrieval; and (ii) embedding performance is heavily coupled with CoT annotation quality, making large-scale training unreliable. Th

summary.core_problem: 研究多模态 embedding 中是否必须用自回归文本 CoT 做推理，以及能否把面向检索和表示学习的推理压缩到 latent space 中一次前向完成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态表示学习中的 latent reasoning 方法。它不是标准 LLM 预训练论文，但触及一个重要接口问题：显式语言推理并不一定是所有表示任务的最优中间形态，固定容量 latent bottleneck 可能更适合低延迟 embedding。
summary.technical_approach: LaME 将 embedding-oriented latent reasoning 表述为弱监督 information bottleneck。模型引入 K 个可学习 reason tokens 作为固定容量瓶颈，在单次前向中完成推理，避免生成文本 CoT；训练使用两个弱监督信号来约束 latent reasoning，使其既保留任务相关信息，又减少对 CoT 标注质量的依赖。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法面向 reasoning-driven universal multimodal embedding，并针对通用任务和复杂任务比较文本 CoT embedding 范式；未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、benchmark 名称、baseline 数值或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether multimodal embedding models need autoregressive textual CoT reasoning, and whether retrieval-oriented reasoning can instead be performed in latent space within a single forward pass.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a latent-reasoning method for multimodal representation learning. It is not a standard LLM pretraining paper, but it targets an important interface question: explicit language may not be the best intermediate form for every representation task, and a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck may be better suited for low-latency embedding.
summary_en.technical_approach: LaME formulates embedding-oriented latent reasoning as a weakly supervised information bottleneck. It introduces K learnable reason tokens as a fixed-capacity bottleneck, performs reasoning in one forward pass instead of generating textual CoT, and uses two weak supervision signals to retain task-relevant information while reducing dependence on CoT annotation quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for reasoning-driven universal multimodal embedding and compares against textual-CoT-style embedding pipelines on general and complex tasks. It does not provide model size, training data scale, benchmark names, baseline numbers, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和消融：若 latent bottleneck 真能替代文本 CoT，embedding 训练不必继续追逐高成本推理标注。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: if the latent bottleneck really replaces textual CoT, embedding training need not keep chasing expensive reasoning annotations.

paper.title: Observable Patterns Are Not Explanations: A Causal-Geometric Analysis of Latent Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Latent reasoning models (LRMs) replace explicit chain-of-thought with continuous thoughts. Recent work treats observable latent-state patterns, such as BFS-like frontiers and decodable arithmetic computation, as evidence for internal reasoning mechanisms. Evaluating two LRMs (Coconut and CODI) against controls lacking the proposed recurrence or curriculum, we find these patterns also appear in the controls and do not always causally affect behavior. Causal interventions reveal that latent-though

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 latent reasoning models 中一个很关键的解释性问题：从连续 latent thought 里观察到 BFS-like frontier、候选路径 superposition、可解码算术中间量等模式，并不能直接说明模型真的在用这些模式推理。作者要区分三件事：模式是否由 latent reasoning 机制特异地产生，是否能跨任务和训练 recipe 泛化，以及它是否对最终预测有因果作用。
summary.importance: 对预训练和新型语言建模的启发在于，它给 latent reasoning 的机制分析设了更高标准。Coconut、CODI 这类模型把显式 CoT 换成连续状态，确实可能带来效率收益，但也让监督和解释变难。论文的主要贡献不是提出新的 LRM 训练方法，而是指出：不能把 probe 读出的可解释模式直接当成内部算法。更可靠的分析对象应该是对行为有因果影响的 latent 子空间，以及这些子空间随 thought step 的演化。这对后续做 latent reasoning、continuous thought、hidden CoT 安全评估都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把已有 LRM 的观察性解释拆成对照实验、因果干预和几何分析三层。第一层是 matched controls：在 ProsQA 图跳任务上比较 Coconut 与 Pause-as-thought、curriculum-perturbed Coconut、base GPT-2、explicit-CoT GPT-2；在 GSM8K 算术任务上比较 CODI 与相应控制模型。Pause-as-thought 保留 Coconut 的格式和课程，但把 recurrence 换成 learned thought tokens，用来分离 recurrence 机制的贡献。Coconut_u 以 u=0.3 的概率采样其他 curriculum stage，用来检查课程本身的作用。第二层是因果分析，包括 latent thought ablation、causal tracing，以及基于梯度的子空间干预。作者不再二分地问某个 thought 是否被使用，而是衡量它对 loss 或输出行为的影响强度。第三层是几何分析：把全维 latent trajectory 与低秩、loss-sensitive 的 causal gradient subspace 分开看，比较不同 thought step 的结构性变化。核心差异在于，论文没有把 decodability 或 probe pattern 当成解释终点，而是把它们作为候选现象，再用干预验证其行为相关性。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 GPT-2 small 初始化，分别在 ProsQA 和 GSM8K 上训练任务专用模型。统计上报告 95% bootstrap confidence interval，并用 McNemar test 做 paired comparison。关键发现有三点。第一，曾被解读为 Coconut BFS-style reasoning 的 frontier probability 和 candidate mass pattern，并不只出现在目标 LRM 中；非 recurrent 或未按 latent reasoning 训练的控制模型也可能出现类似结构。这说明 probe pattern 可能来自任务、提示格式、训练课程或 probe 本身，而不一定来自 latent recurrence。第二，latent thought 对输出的影响是连续量，不是 used / unused 的二元属性。一些 thought position 可被观察或解码，但对预测影响很弱；另一些影响集中在低秩方向上。第三，几何上，弱影响 latent thought 往往跨 step 变化很小，接近静态表示；行为影响更强的 thought 则呈现更有结构的 step-to-step 演化。论文没有给出新的大规模性能提升，主要价值在机制诊断和方法论校正。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的三个 RQ，它们清楚定义了 emergence、generalizability、causality 三个判断标准。然后看实验设置里各个 control 的设计，尤其是 Pause-as-thought 和 Coconut_u，因为这些控制决定了结论力度。结果部分优先看第 4 节的 observable structure 对照实验，再看第 5 节的 causal tracing 和 gradient-subspace intervention。第 6 节适合关注图示和 trajectory geometry，重点是作者如何把全维 latent 表示与 causal subspace 区分开。若只关心 latent reasoning 训练，可跳过部分 interpretability 术语，但应保留对“可解码不等于因果机制”的结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether visible patterns in latent reasoning models are real explanations of internal reasoning. Prior work has interpreted BFS-like frontiers, superposed candidate paths, and decodable arithmetic states as evidence that continuous thoughts implement reasoning procedures. This work separates observation from mechanism: whether the pattern is specific to latent reasoning, whether it generalizes beyond one recipe, and whether it causally affects the model's answer.
summary_en.importance: The value for pretraining and alternative language modeling is methodological. Latent reasoning models replace explicit chain-of-thought with hidden continuous computation, which makes them attractive for efficiency but harder to monitor. The paper argues that interpretability claims for such models need causal tests, not only probes or decoders. The useful unit of analysis is the behaviorally effective subspace inside a latent thought, especially low-rank directions that control loss or predictions. This matters for future work on continuous thought, hidden CoT, and latent computation safety.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study combines matched controls, causal interventions, and representation geometry. For graph reasoning on ProsQA, it revisits Coconut-style claims about simultaneous candidate encoding and breadth-first exploration. For arithmetic reasoning on GSM8K, it revisits CODI-style claims about decodable scratchpad computation. The controls are important: Pause-as-thought keeps Coconut's format and curriculum but replaces recurrence with learned thought tokens; Coconut_u perturbs the curriculum by sampling other stages with probability u=0.3; base GPT-2 and explicit-CoT GPT-2 test whether similar observable patterns can arise without latent-reasoning training. The causal analysis uses latent thought ablations, causal tracing, and gradient-subspace interventions. Instead of asking whether a latent thought is used or not, the paper measures how strongly it changes behavior and where that influence is concentrated. The geometric analysis then studies both full latent trajectories and the causally sensitive subspaces across thought steps.
summary_en.experiments: All task-specific models are trained from GPT-2 small. The evaluation covers ProsQA for graph hopping and GSM8K for arithmetic reasoning, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals and McNemar paired tests. The main empirical result is negative but informative: observable structures previously attributed to latent recurrence can also appear in non-recurrent or curriculum-matched controls, and in some cases even in models without the proposed latent reasoning mechanism. Causal interventions show that latent thought use is graded. Some latent positions are decodable or visually structured but weakly affect the final prediction, while stronger behavioral effects concentrate in low-rank, loss-sensitive directions. The geometric analysis finds that weakly influential thoughts are often nearly static across steps, whereas more influential thoughts show more structured step-to-step movement.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 to 45 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with the three research questions in the introduction, since they define the paper's standards for mechanism: emergence, generalizability, and causality. Then inspect the experimental setup and the control models, especially Pause-as-thought and Coconut_u. The most useful technical parts are Section 4 on observable structures under controls, Section 5 on causal tracing and gradient-subspace interventions, and Section 6 on latent trajectory geometry. Readers working on latent reasoning should focus on the distinction between decodability and causal influence.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会纠正 latent reasoning 里“看见 pattern 就当机制”的坏习惯；重点读因果干预设计和 control setup，结论比花哨可视化更可信。
recommendation.en: This is worth reading because it attacks the bad habit of mistaking visible latent patterns for mechanism; focus on the causal interventions and matched controls, not the geometry plots alone.

paper.title: Dropout-GRPO: Variational Stochasticity for Continuous Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) relies on the diversity of $K$ rollouts within each group; otherwise, the group-mean advantage $A^{(k)} = r^{(k)} - μ_r$ collapses to zero. This presents a structural challenge for latent-reasoning models like Coconut, which feed continuous hidden states recurrently in place of discrete chain-of-thought tokens. Because the latent phase is inherently deterministic given the parameters and prompt, multiple rollouts produce identical trajectories, stalling

summary.core_problem: 连续潜变量推理模型（如 Coconut）在使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）做强化学习后训练时，潜变量循环过程给定参数和 prompt 后是确定性的，同一 prompt 的多次 rollout 会产生完全相同的轨迹，导致组均值优势 A(k)=r(k)-μr 全部坍缩为零，GRPO 无法产生有效学习信号。
summary.importance: 首次给出了将组相对强化学习成功应用到 Coconut 风格连续潜推理模型的可行路径，打通了潜推理范式与 RL 后训练的接口；方法本身改动极小，理论上有清晰的贝叶斯模型平均解释，对后续 latent reasoning + RL 方向的工程落地有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是用结构化 dropout 为确定性的潜循环注入外生随机性。具体做法：每次 rollout 采样一个独立的 Bernoulli mask，并在所有潜循环步骤内保持该 mask 不变；策略更新阶段回放同一个 mask，保证梯度对应的正是被评估奖励的那条轨迹。从变分视角看，共享 mask 的每次 rollout 等价于从参数后验分布中采一个样本，GRPO 优化的是 mask 边际化后策略的期望奖励。论文还给出四个工程稳定化细节：Huber 化的 k3 KL 项、与学习率耦合的 β 退火、按序列均值聚合损失、组级准确率过滤配合 DDP 协调的 skip step。
summary.experiments: 在 GSM8K 上验证：确定性 rollout 的 vanilla GRPO 完全学不动，Dropout-GRPO 将 Coconut 基线的 pass@1 从 27.29% 提升到 29.01%。理论部分证明了在 θ=θ_old 处，带均值优势的 dropout-GRPO surrogate gradient 等于 (1-1/K) 倍的真实策略梯度；证明了 mask replay 相比重新采样 rollout 有 common-random-numbers 方差缩减；并在标准 Transformer 正则条件下证明了任意深度 T 的潜状态雅可比 ∂hT/∂θ 良定义。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 30-40 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 GRPO 失效结构原因的拆解；Section 3 的变分视角构造与梯度无偏性证明；实验部分对比 vanilla GRPO 完全失效而 dropout 版本有效的那组曲线。工程实现上，跨整个潜循环做到 bit-identical mask replay 的细节值得做 RL 基础设施的同学参考。可以深挖的点：dropout 率与组大小 K 的联合调参、该思路能否迁移到其他确定性推理架构（如递归隐状态的 SSM 类模型）。

summary_en.core_problem: When applying Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as post-training for continuous latent-reasoning models such as Coconut, the latent recurrence is deterministic given parameters and a prompt. Multiple rollouts on the same prompt therefore produce identical trajectories, collapsing the group-mean advantage A(k) = r(k) − μr to zero across the group and removing any usable learning signal for GRPO.
summary_en.importance: This work provides the first practical recipe to make group-relative RL work on Coconut-style continuous latent-reasoning models, bridging the latent-reasoning paradigm with RL post-training. The method is minimally invasive, admits a clean Bayesian model-average interpretation, and is directly actionable for engineering teams working on latent reasoning plus RL pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to inject exogenous stochasticity into the deterministic latent recurrence via structured dropout. For each rollout, a single Bernoulli mask is sampled and held constant across all latent recurrence steps. During the policy update, the exact same mask is replayed so that the gradient is computed against the precise trajectory that produced the evaluated reward. Under the variational view of Gal & Ghahramani, each shared-mask rollout corresponds to one posterior sample over parameters, and GRPO then optimizes the expected reward of the mask-marginalized policy. Four implementation refinements are documented to stabilize training: Huberized k3 KL, learning-rate-coupled β annealing, sequence-mean loss aggregation, and a group-level accuracy filter with DDP-coordinated skip steps.
summary_en.experiments: On GSM8K, vanilla GRPO with deterministic rollouts yields no learning signal at all, while Dropout-GRPO improves the Coconut baseline from 27.29% to 29.01% pass@1. Theoretically, the paper proves that at θ = θ_old the dropout-GRPO surrogate gradient with mean-only advantage equals (1 − 1/K) times the true policy gradient ∇θJ(θ); that mask replay provides a common-random-numbers variance reduction over fresh resampling; and that the latent Jacobian ∂hT/∂θ is well defined at any depth T under standard Transformer regularity conditions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, roughly 30–40 minutes. Focus on the Introduction for the structural diagnosis of why GRPO fails on deterministic latent recurrence; Section 3 for the variational construction and gradient unbiasedness proofs; and the experiment panels that contrast the zero-learning vanilla GRPO with the working dropout variant. Engineers building RL infra should pay attention to how bit-identical mask replay is enforced across the full latent recurrence. Worth deeper investigation: the joint tuning of dropout rate and group size K, and whether the same construction transfers to other deterministic reasoning architectures such as recurrent SSM-style models.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和方差消融；若实验干净，应在 latent reasoning RL ablation 里复现 shared-mask dropout。
recommendation.en: Read the method and variance ablations; if the setup is clean, shared-mask dropout should be reproduced in latent-reasoning RL experiments.

paper.title: Why Limit the Residual Stream to Layers and Not Tokens? Persistent Memory for Continuous Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning abilities on mathematical and multi-hop planning tasks. The CoCoNuT (Chain of Continuous Thought) paradigm~\cite{hao2024coconut} extends this by enabling models to reason in latent space, exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously rather than committing to a single chain early on. However, we identify a limitation we term the \textbf{concept bottleneck}. At each reasoning pass, intermediate hidden states are overwritten,

summary.core_problem: 在连续潜在推理（如 CoCoNuT）中，随着推理深度的增加，中间隐藏状态被覆盖，导致模型丢失早期步骤计算出的关键事实（概念瓶颈）。
summary.importance: 指出了连续潜在推理范式中的一个关键缺陷（概念瓶颈），并提出了一种通过持久化残差内存来解决该问题的新架构，显著提升了潜在推理的性能。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AGCLR (Adaptive Gated Continuous Latent Reasoning)，通过引入 Gated Concept Stream 来增强 CoCoNuT。该机制在所有推理通道中维护一个持久的残差内存，防止早期推理步骤的信息丢失。
summary.experiments: 在 HotpotQA 上，vanilla CoCoNuT (10.4% EM) 未能超越 CoT 基线 (11.0% EM)；引入 AGCLR 后，有效缓解了随 curriculum 深度增加而导致的性能下降问题（如在 GSM8K 上的表现）。

summary_en.core_problem: In continuous latent reasoning (e.g., CoCoNuT), intermediate hidden states are overwritten as reasoning depth increases, causing the model to lose critical facts computed in earlier steps (the concept bottleneck).
summary_en.importance: Identifies a critical flaw (concept bottleneck) in the continuous latent reasoning paradigm and proposes a novel architecture with persistent residual memory to address it, significantly improving latent reasoning performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes AGCLR (Adaptive Gated Continuous Latent Reasoning), which augments CoCoNuT with a Gated Concept Stream. This mechanism maintains a persistent residual memory across all reasoning passes, preventing information loss from earlier steps.
summary_en.experiments: On HotpotQA, vanilla CoCoNuT (10.4% EM) fails to improve over the CoT baseline (11.0% EM); AGCLR effectively mitigates performance degradation associated with increased curriculum depth (e.g., on GSM8K).

recommendation.zh: 精准定位了 latent reasoning (如 CoCoNuT) 随深度增加性能崩塌的根本原因（状态覆盖），提出的 Gated Concept Stream 是一种优雅的架构修正，值得关注 latent reasoning 的研究员阅读。
recommendation.en: Accurately pinpoints the root cause of performance collapse in latent reasoning (e.g., CoCoNuT) as depth increases (state overwriting); the proposed Gated Concept Stream is an elegant architectural fix worth reading for latent reasoning researchers.

paper.title: LoRi: Low-Rank Distillation for Implicit Reasoning
paper.abstract: Implicit chain-of-thought (iCoT) methods aim to internalize reasoning in large language models, but often underperform explicit CoT prompting. We empirically find that hidden-state reasoning trajectories exhibit low-rank structure. Motivated by this observation, we propose a low-rank distillation framework that transfers reasoning by aligning teacher and student trajectories in a shared low-rank tensor subspace using first- and second-order statistics. The resulting formulation captures the glob

summary.core_problem: LoRi 解决的是隐式 CoT 蒸馏中的轨迹对齐问题：显式 CoT 的文字步骤和学生模型的 latent reasoning states 没有天然的一一对应关系，直接做局部 token-level 或中间状态监督会丢掉教师推理过程的全局结构。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train 阶段的 latent reasoning 蒸馏方法。但它有一个值得关注的观察：推理时跨 token、跨 layer 的 hidden-state trajectory 可能具有低秩结构。如果这个观察稳定成立，它对隐式推理、短 latent step 推理、以及 pretrain 阶段是否需要显式学习某类低维推理流形都有启发。贡献量级属于方法增量偏实用，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把教师模型在显式 rationale tokens 上的 hidden states 看成一个三维张量，维度大致是 rationale token 数 N、layer 数 L、hidden size H。学生模型则有 K 个隐式推理步，对应 hidden-state 张量。LoRi 不要求第 i 个显式 CoT token 对齐第 i 个 latent step，而是用 Tucker-style 低秩表示把两者投到共享低秩子空间，再匹配一阶和二阶统计量。训练目标由两部分组成：普通 CE loss 保持学生生成显式解答和答案的能力；低秩对齐 loss 负责迁移教师推理轨迹的主结构。低秩 loss 又分成 rationale-level alignment 和 anchor-level alignment。前者对齐完整推理轨迹的全局几何，后者对齐答案预测位置的表示，用来稳定从 latent reasoning 到最终答案生成的过渡。相比逐步模仿 CoT，LoRi 的主要取舍是放弃 token-level 对应，转而保留 trajectory 的主方向，因此可以把长 CoT 压缩到较短的 latent steps，并且训练上可通过预计算教师低秩表示降低开销。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaMA 和 Qwen 等模型族、不同模型规模，以及数学推理任务。论文报告 LoRi 相比已有 iCoT 方法有稳定提升，整体最高约提升 12%，在 GSM8K-Hard 上最高约提升 10%。更大规模模型上，LoRi 能缩小隐式 CoT 与显式 CoT 的差距。关键实验证据包括：教师推理 hidden states 的累计奇异值随 rank 增长很快，支持低秩假设；低秩轨迹对齐比局部状态监督更适合处理长 rationale 到短 latent trajectory 的蒸馏。完整表格细节需要看实验章节，尤其是不同 rank、latent step 数 K、以及 anchor loss 权重的消融。
