paper.title: On Training in Imagination
paper.abstract: State-of-the-art model-based reinforcement learning methods train policies on imagined rollouts. These rollouts are trajectories generated by a learned dynamics model and are scored by a learned reward model, but without querying the true environment during policy updates. We study this training paradigm by quantifying how errors in learned dynamics and reward models affect returns and policy optimization. First, we extend the analysis of Asadi et al. (2018) to MDPs with learned reward models, a

summary.core_problem: 训练在想象中依赖 learned dynamics 和 learned reward 生成并打分 rollout，但两类模型误差如何分别影响 return、样本预算如何在 transition 与 reward annotation 之间分配，此前缺少清晰刻画。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 model-based RL、RLHF/RLAIF 中的 reward model 采样成本、以及用 learned world model 产生训练信号有参考意义。关键启发是把 dynamics error 和 reward error 拆成两个可控来源，而不是把环境模型误差混在一个项里。这个视角适合迁移到需要合成轨迹、偏好标注、过程奖励或 verifier 信号的训练系统中。
summary.technical_approach: 方法以 deterministic MDP 为对象，扩展 Asadi et al. 的 simulation-lemma 类分析。返回差距被分解为 dynamics error 与 reward error 两项，二者有不同的 Lipschitz 系数。Corollary 1 指出 learned dynamics、reward、policy 的 Lipschitz 常数越低，误差放大越弱，因此好的 latent representation 不只是预测准确，还应让系统在 latent space 中更平滑。Theorem 1 在误差满足 power-law scaling 的假设下，给出 dynamics samples 与 reward samples 的最优比例，比例由误差下降指数、单位样本成本、以及 Lipschitz 放大系数共同决定。Theorem 2 讨论 additive zero-mean reward noise 下 REINFORCE estimator 的无偏性与方差膨胀；systematic reward bias 会形成梯度偏差，不能靠多 trajectory 平均消除。
summary.experiments: 实验部分主要用于检查理论假设与预测，包括 power-law error scaling、Lipschitz 系数对 return bound 的影响、以及 reward annotation fidelity 与样本数量之间的取舍。给出的全文片段没有暴露具体数值表和曲线细节，因此不宜补造性能数字。可确认的实验定位是 Sections 3.1、4.1、4.2，分别对应假设验证、预算分配预测、reward noise/fidelity 分析。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Lemma 1、Corollary 1、Theorem 1、Theorem 2 的表述和假设，不必逐行推导证明。对预训练研究更有用的是两个问题：第一，reward model 的误差项是否可以在训练系统中单独建模和监控；第二，power-law 采样分配能否用于决定人类偏好、AI feedback、process reward、environment transition 数据的采集比例。

summary_en.core_problem: Training in imagination uses learned dynamics and learned reward models to generate and score rollouts, but the separate effects of dynamics error and reward error on return, and the optimal split between transition data and reward annotations, are not well characterized.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to model-based RL and to training pipelines that rely on learned reward signals. Its useful contribution is the separation of dynamics error and reward error as two controllable sources of training-signal degradation. That framing can inform RLHF/RLAIF systems, verifier-based training, process reward modeling, and synthetic trajectory generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis extends simulation-lemma-style bounds from Asadi et al. to MDPs with a learned reward model. The return gap is decomposed into a dynamics-error term and a reward-error term, each with its own coefficient. The coefficients depend on Lipschitz constants of the dynamics, reward, and policy, which turns smooth latent representations into a concrete desideratum rather than a qualitative preference. Under power-law error scaling, the paper derives a closed-form optimal allocation between dynamics samples and reward samples as a function of scaling exponents, per-sample costs, and the Lipschitz-derived coefficients. It also analyzes REINFORCE under additive zero-mean reward noise, showing unbiasedness with variance inflation, while systematic reward bias induces a gradient bias that trajectory averaging cannot remove.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical sections are designed to test the assumptions and predictions of the theory: whether model errors follow power-law scaling, whether lower Lipschitz constants tighten the observed return-error behavior, and how reward annotation fidelity trades off against sample count. The provided full-text excerpt identifies Sections 3.1, 4.1, and 4.2 as the relevant experimental locations, but does not expose the numerical tables or plots. Exact performance numbers should therefore be checked in the original PDF.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on Lemma 1, Corollary 1, Theorem 1, and Theorem 2. The most transferable ideas are the separate accounting of reward-model error and the power-law allocation rule for expensive labels versus cheaper transition data. The proofs are less important unless one wants to adapt the bounds to stochastic dynamics, token-level reward models, or verifier-guided language model training.

recommendation.zh: 看误差界和 sample allocation；它不会给 LLM recipe，但会校准“用想象轨迹训练”能信到什么程度。
recommendation.en: Read the error bound and sample-allocation rule; it will not give an LLM recipe, but it calibrates how much to trust imagined rollouts.

paper.title: LatentRAG: Latent Reasoning and Retrieval for Efficient Agentic RAG
paper.abstract: Single-step retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides an efficient way to incorporate external information for simple question answering tasks but struggles with complex questions. Agentic RAG extends this paradigm by replacing single-step retrieval with a multi-step process, in which the large language model (LLM) acts as a search agent that generates intermediate thoughts and subqueries to iteratively interact with the retrieval system. This iterative process incurs substantial latency due

summary.core_problem: LatentRAG 解决的是 agentic RAG 的主要延迟来自显式思维链和子查询逐 token 生成的问题，并进一步尝试把“该检索什么”从自然语言子查询迁移到连续隐空间表示。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座训练本身，而在 latent reasoning 与检索接口的结合。它把连续 latent token 从“只用于内部推理”推进到“可驱动外部检索”的位置。这个方向值得泛读，因为它触及两个更基础的问题：第一，模型能否用非文本中间表示完成可控的信息交互；第二，检索信号能否通过可微接口反向约束 LLM 的中间状态。对未来的 latent reasoning、工具调用、RAG 训练目标设计都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的核心是用特殊 thought token 和 subquery token 替代显式自然语言思维和子查询。模型前向时，这些特殊 token 对应位置的最后一层 hidden state 被视为 latent thought 和 latent subquery。由于这些位置可以一次 prefill 得到，避免了多轮自回归生成长 thought 和长 query 的串行开销。

难点在于 latent subquery 不能直接作为传统检索器的文本输入。论文采用对齐策略：用预训练 dense retriever 处理自然语言子查询，得到其在文档集合上的相似度分布；再把 LLM 产生的 latent subquery 输入检索模块，得到 latent 查询对应的文档相似度分布；训练时最小化两者的 KL divergence。这样做的好处是，不需要大规模人工标注的中间 query-document 对，也不需要为每个中间子查询构造显式监督。

另一个设计点是可解释性。纯 latent 中间步骤会让 agentic RAG 的证据链变得不透明。论文引入并行的 latent semantic alignment，让 latent token 承载更接近自然语言中间步骤的语义。这个设计不是为了恢复完整 CoT，而是为了约束 latent 表示不要退化成难以控制的检索捷径。
summary.experiments:
论文在引言中给出的延迟分析很关键：代表性 agentic RAG 方法 Search-R1 在多跳问答数据集上的总推理时间约为 naive single-step RAG 的 16–22 倍；其中 thought generation 和 subquery generation 合计占总延迟约 90%。这说明瓶颈主要不是检索本身，也不是最终答案生成，而是中间自然语言轨迹的自回归生成。

由于提供的正文片段未包含完整实验表，具体数据集、最终准确率、延迟下降幅度、消融结果和模型规模无法可靠确认。可确认的实验逻辑包括：比较 naive RAG、显式 agentic RAG 与 LatentRAG 的端到端 QA 表现和延迟；验证 latent subquery 是否能保持检索质量；消融 KL 分布对齐、latent semantic alignment、联合优化等组件对准确率、检索召回和可解释性的影响。
summary.reading_guide:
建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看三部分：第一，看 Fig. 1 的延迟分解，判断问题设定是否成立；第二，看 latent subquery 与 dense retriever 的接口设计，尤其是 KL divergence 对齐的是文档相似度分布而不是单个正例文档；第三，看可解释性相关的 latent semantic alignment，以及它是否只是辅助 loss，还是会影响主检索路径。

如果只关心预训练方向，可以重点关注“连续中间状态如何承接外部工具/检索接口”这一点。它比普通 RAG 工程优化更接近建模范式问题。

summary_en.core_problem: LatentRAG targets the main latency bottleneck in agentic RAG: explicit autoregressive generation of intermediate thoughts and subqueries. It asks whether both reasoning and retrieval decisions can be moved from natural language tokens into continuous latent states.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it connects latent reasoning with an external retrieval interface. The main signal is that latent tokens are not only used as private computation states; they are trained to drive retrieval. This matters for future work on latent reasoning, tool use, and differentiable retrieval, where intermediate supervision may come from external systems rather than text trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method replaces explicit thoughts and subqueries with special thought and subquery tokens. The last hidden states at these token positions are treated as latent thoughts and latent subqueries. Since these states are produced in a single forward pass, the model avoids the sequential cost of generating long intermediate text.

The central technical issue is retrieval. A latent subquery cannot be directly fed into a standard text retriever. The paper aligns the LLM-generated latent subquery with a pretrained dense retriever in embedding space. A natural-language subquery induces a similarity distribution over documents through the retriever. The latent subquery induces another distribution. Training minimizes the KL divergence between these two distributions. This avoids requiring large-scale supervised query-document pairs for intermediate subqueries, which are usually unavailable in agentic RAG training setups.

The paper also addresses transparency. Pure latent reasoning hides intermediate decisions. To reduce this problem, it adds a parallel semantic alignment objective so that latent tokens retain meaningful semantics instead of becoming opaque retrieval triggers.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important reported observation in the provided text is the latency breakdown. On multi-hop QA datasets, a representative agentic RAG system, Search-R1, takes about 16–22× the inference time of naive single-step RAG. Thought generation and subquery generation together account for roughly 90% of total latency. This supports the paper’s claim that the bottleneck is not retrieval or final answer generation, but autoregressive generation of intermediate trajectories.

The supplied full-text excerpt does not include the complete experimental tables, so exact accuracy, latency reduction, model scale, dataset list, and ablation numbers cannot be verified. The expected key experiments are comparisons against naive RAG and explicit agentic RAG, retrieval-quality evaluation for latent subqueries, and ablations on KL distribution alignment, semantic alignment, and joint optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the latency decomposition in Fig. 1 to check whether the motivation is quantitatively supported. Then read the latent retrieval section carefully, especially the choice to align document-similarity distributions rather than supervise individual retrieved documents. Finally, inspect the semantic-alignment component and the ablations, if available, to see whether the latent states remain controllable.

For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful part is the interface between continuous intermediate states and an external retrieval system. That is closer to a modeling question than to ordinary RAG engineering.

recommendation.zh: 读 latent-query 对齐和延迟表即可；思路有用，但若只在小 QA 集上赢，不能外推到通用 agent。
recommendation.en: Skim the latent-query alignment and latency tables; useful idea, but small-QA wins should not be extrapolated to general agents.

summary.core_problem: 讨论“latent reasoning（隐空间思考）”在 SFT 与 RL 两阶段如何打通训练链路：用隐式/连续的 latent token 替代显式 CoT 文本，从而在保持效果的同时显著压缩推理链长度，并解决 latent RL 的训练不稳定。
summary.key_insights: 1) Latent-SFT：用词表 token embedding 的线性组合来定义 latent token，使模型在 SFT 阶段获得接近显式 SFT 的能力，同时减少显式 reasoning chain 依赖与长度。2) Latent-GRPO：针对 latent reasoning 做 RL 的三类不稳定来源给出工程化修复思路：需要更好的 latent 初始化；修复 Gumbel exploration 下的优化错位（optimization misalignment）；避免多条正确路径在同时拟合多条正优势轨迹时被“平均”成无效状态。3) 经验结果：在数学任务上报告稳定增益（低/高难度分别较 Latent-SFT 初始化 +7.86/+14.77 Pass@1），高难度上较显式 GRPO +4.27 Pass@1；推理长度较显式 GRPO 缩短约 3-4 倍，同时在 Gumbel exploration 下仍保持较强 pass@k。
summary.limits: 信息来自小红书笔记级摘要，缺少关键细节（latent token 具体参数化/约束、训练超参、对照组与统计显著性、失败案例）；实验主要集中在数学任务，泛化到开放域推理与工具使用场景尚未验证；“优化错位/平均成无效状态”的机制解释需要更严格的消融与可复现实验支撑。

summary_en.core_problem: The post argues for a practical training pipeline for latent reasoning across SFT and RL: represent reasoning as latent tokens (instead of explicit CoT text) to compress reasoning length while retaining performance, and address instability when doing RL over latent trajectories.
summary_en.key_insights: 1) Latent-SFT: defines latent tokens as linear combinations of vocabulary token embeddings, aiming to match explicit SFT performance while substantially shortening the visible reasoning chain. 2) Latent-GRPO: proposes fixes for three RL instability sources in latent reasoning—stronger latent initialization, correcting optimization misalignment under Gumbel-based exploration, and preventing multiple valid positive-advantage paths from being averaged into a degenerate state. 3) Reported results on math tasks show consistent gains (+7.86/+14.77 Pass@1 over Latent-SFT init on easier/harder sets; +4.27 Pass@1 over explicit GRPO on harder sets), with ~3–4× shorter reasoning length and preserved pass@k under Gumbel exploration.
summary_en.limits: This is a short social post without enough methodological detail for reproduction (latent parameterization, losses, hyperparameters, baselines, variance). Evidence is mainly math-focused; generalization to broader reasoning and tool-use is unclear. Mechanistic claims (misalignment/averaging collapse) would benefit from tighter ablations and diagnostics.

paper.title: Visual Latents Know More Than They Say: Unsilencing Latent Reasoning in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Continuous latent-space reasoning offers a compact alternative to textual chain-of-thought for multimodal models, enabling high-dimensional visual evidence to be integrated without explicit reasoning tokens. However, we identify a previously overlooked optimization pathology in existing latent visual reasoning methods: although visual latents become semantically enriched during training, their contribution to final answer prediction is systematically suppressed. Within the shared parameter space

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解 MLLM 中连续视觉 latent reasoning token 被训练成语义丰富但对最终答案贡献很小的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态推理机制分析和方法改进。它把视觉 latent reasoning 的失败模式从“latent 是否学到语义”推进到“学到的 latent 是否被解码器使用”，这对 native multimodal 预训练和 latent reasoning 目标设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Silenced Visual Latents 现象：共享参数空间内，自回归答案目标更容易依赖直接视觉输入形成 shortcut，使 latent token 变成类似过渡状态，而不是承载可用推理内容。方法上不更新 backbone，而是在推理时直接优化 latent reasoning；第一阶段用 query-guided contrastive latent-visual alignment 预热视觉 latent，使其更贴近问题相关视觉证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM backbone、参数量、数据集、任务列表或提升数字。可确认的是方法以冻结 backbone 的推理时 latent 优化为主，需要正文核查其计算开销、是否依赖答案泄漏式目标、以及对 VQA/图文推理任务的稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why continuous visual latent reasoning tokens in MLLMs can become semantically enriched yet contribute little to final answer prediction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is both a multimodal reasoning analysis and a method proposal. It shifts the question from whether visual latents contain semantics to whether the decoder actually uses them, which matters for native multimodal pretraining and latent-reasoning objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It identifies Silenced Visual Latents: under a shared parameter space, the autoregressive answer objective favors shortcuts through direct visual inputs, pushing latent tokens toward transition-like states instead of useful reasoning states. The proposed remedy keeps the backbone frozen and optimizes latent reasoning at inference time; Stage I warms up visual latents with query-guided contrastive latent-visual alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the MLLM backbone, parameter count, datasets, task suite, or numerical gains. The key experimental checks should be inference-time compute cost, whether the optimization objective leaks answer information, and robustness across VQA and multimodal reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 只看现象验证和消融；若 latent 被“学会但不用”成立，MLLM 预训练目标要显式约束信息流。
recommendation.en: Read the evidence and ablations; if “learned but unused” latents are real, MLLM pretraining objectives need explicit constraints on information flow.

paper.title: Latent-GRPO: Group Relative Policy Optimization for Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Latent reasoning offers a more efficient alternative to explicit reasoning by compressing intermediate reasoning into continuous representations and substantially shortening reasoning chains. However, existing latent reasoning methods mainly focus on supervised learning, and reinforcement learning in latent space remains highly unstable. We study this problem through the lens of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and show that directly adapting GRPO to latent reasoning is fundamentally n

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 latent reasoning 的 RL 稳定性问题。已有 Latent-SFT 能把中间推理压到连续 latent token 中，缩短推理链，但把 GRPO 直接搬到 latent 空间会失效：连续探索容易离开有效 latent 流形，Gumbel 扰动下的概率更新方向可能和轨迹优势不一致，多条正确路径的 latent 平均还可能落到不能继续正确推理的位置。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发主要在 pretrain/posttrain 接口和新型语言建模训练目标上。它没有提出新的基座预训练目标，但清楚指出 latent token 不是普通 token 的平滑版本，RL 优化时会改变动作空间、概率密度估计和采样机制。对做 latent reasoning、soft token LM、any-order 或 diffusion-like LM 的研究者来说，关键价值在于：连续动作空间的探索需要先有有效流形，不能指望 RL 从显式 CoT 模型中自动长出稳定 latent 推理结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法建立在 vocabulary-superposition latent token 上，即每一步用 top-K 词表分布的线性组合表示 latent token，而不是采样一个离散词。作者先用 Latent-SFT 初始化，确保模型已经学到可用的 latent 推理轨迹。随后改造 GRPO。第一，Invalid Sample Advantage Masking 丢弃超长或不终止的 rollout，把这些样本视为离开有效 latent 流形后的异常轨迹，避免它们污染优势估计。第二，One-sided Noise Sampling 把 Gumbel 扰动限制为正向扰动，减少正优势轨迹中某些 latent 分量被压低、负优势轨迹中某些分量被抬高的问题。第三，Optimal Correct Path First Token Selection 针对同一 prefix 下多条正确路径的 mode averaging 问题，只选择轨迹级 surrogate log-probability 最优的正确路径来更新首个 latent token，同时保留后续 token 的其他正确路径更新。这个设计把最容易发生 latent 混合失真的位置限制在一个明确选择上，而不是把多个正确首步平均成一个未必有效的连续状态。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-Math-7B，任务包含低难度和高难度数学推理。低难度设置下，Latent-GRPO 相比 Latent-SFT 平均提升 7.86 Pass@1，同时推理链比显式 GRPO 短 4.44 倍。高难度设置下，平均提升 Latent-SFT 14.77 个点，超过显式 GRPO 4 个以上 Pass@1，推理链短 3.31 倍，并在 Math500、AIME24、AIME25 上取得最高 Pass@1。Gumbel sampling 下仍保留较好的 pass@k 能力，在 AIME 系列上 pass@64 超过 50。消融的核心信息是三项设计分别对应三个失稳源：没有 Latent-SFT 冷启动会缺少有效 latent 流形；普通 Gumbel 噪声会引入优势方向错配；不处理多正确路径首步选择会导致 latent 混合后的状态不可继续。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 35–45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中三类失败模式的定义和 Figure 1，它们比最终算法更有迁移价值。Method 部分重点看 One-sided Noise Sampling 和 Optimal Correct Path First Token Selection 的目标函数，尤其是它如何把轨迹级优势映射到 latent 分量更新。实验部分优先看高难度数学任务、链长统计和消融表。若关注预训练方向，可深挖 latent manifold 这一点：它暗示 latent 推理能力可能需要在 SFT 或 mid-training 阶段注入，单靠后期 RL 不稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why reinforcement learning for latent reasoning is unstable. Latent-SFT can compress intermediate reasoning into continuous latent tokens, but directly applying GRPO to this space breaks several assumptions of token-level RL: exploration can leave the valid latent manifold, Gumbel-based density updates can disagree with trajectory-level advantages, and averaging several correct latent paths can create a state that supports no correct continuation.
summary_en.importance: The main value is for researchers working on latent reasoning and non-standard language modeling objectives. The paper makes a useful point: a latent token is not just a softened discrete token. Once reasoning moves into a continuous action space, the sampling process, density estimation, and optimization geometry all change. This matters for latent reasoning, soft-token LMs, masked/any-order LMs, and diffusion-like language models where training stability depends on whether the model stays on a valid representation manifold.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses vocabulary-superposition latent tokens, where each latent action is represented as a linear combination over the top-K vocabulary candidates. The model is first initialized from Latent-SFT, which provides a valid latent reasoning manifold before RL. The proposed Latent-GRPO then adds three targeted changes. Invalid Sample Advantage Masking removes over-length or non-terminating rollouts, which are treated as likely off-manifold samples. One-sided Noise Sampling restricts Gumbel perturbations to be positive, reducing cases where components from positive-advantage trajectories are pushed down or components from negative-advantage trajectories are pushed up. Optimal Correct Path First Token Selection addresses mode averaging at the first latent step under a shared prefix: among correct trajectories, it selects the one with the best trajectory-level surrogate log probability for the first-token update, while keeping later-token updates from other correct paths active.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use LLaMA-3.2-1B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Math-7B on mathematical reasoning tasks. On lower-difficulty tasks, Latent-GRPO improves over Latent-SFT by 7.86 Pass@1 points on average while using a reasoning chain 4.44 times shorter than explicit GRPO. On harder tasks, it improves over Latent-SFT by 14.77 points on average, exceeds explicit GRPO by more than 4 Pass@1 points, and uses a chain 3.31 times shorter. It reports the best Pass@1 among compared methods on Math500, AIME24, and AIME25. With Gumbel sampling, pass@64 on AIME benchmarks exceeds 50. The ablations are important because each proposed component maps to a specific failure mode: missing latent structure, advantage-noise mismatch, and harmful mixing across correct paths.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 35–45 minutes. Start with the three failure modes in the introduction and Figure 1, since they are more reusable than the benchmark numbers. In the method section, focus on One-sided Noise Sampling and Optimal Correct Path First Token Selection, especially how trajectory-level advantages are translated into latent component updates. In the experiments, prioritize hard math tasks, reasoning-chain length, and ablations. For pretraining-oriented work, the most relevant thread is the need to inject a latent reasoning manifold before RL rather than expecting RL to discover it from an explicit-CoT model.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它把 latent reasoning 做 RL 时最麻烦的三个失稳源拆开了；先读问题定义和消融，若 setup 干净，应立刻在内部 latent-policy 实验里复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it decomposes the three real failure modes of RL in latent reasoning; read the problem formulation and ablations first, and if the setup is clean, reproduce it in any internal latent-policy stack.

paper.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Action via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning for VLA Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have increasingly incorporated reasoning mechanisms for complex robotic manipulation. However, existing approaches share a critical limitation: whether employing explicit linguistic reasoning that suffers from latency and discretization, or utilizing more expressive continuous latent reasoning, they are predominantly confined to static imitation learning that limits adaptability and generalization. While online reinforcement learning (RL) has been introduced t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 VLA 中一个很具体但重要的缺口：已有带 reasoning 的机器人策略，要么依赖显式语言推理，延迟高且难表达连续物理过程；要么做 latent reasoning，但训练方式仍主要是 imitation learning，缺少在线交互带来的适应性。与此同时，已有 VLA 的 RL post-training 又大多只优化 action space，没有把“先形成物理推理，再执行动作”这一内部过程纳入优化目标。作者的问题设定因此很明确：能否让 RL 直接作用于 latent physical reasoning 与 action generation 的耦合过程，而不是只在动作层面做 policy improvement。
summary.importance: 它对纯 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，因为主要是机器人 VLA post-training；但对“latent reasoning 是否能被训练信号显式塑形”这个更一般的问题有启发。尤其是两点。第一，作者把 latent CoT 当作隐式决策变量，而不是中间副产物，这和近来语言模型里对 latent reasoning、hidden scratchpad、continuous thought 的兴趣是同一方向。第二，LAPO 的核心思想是把环境奖励通过联合 likelihood ratio 传回 reasoning token 与 action token，这提供了一种 credit assignment 视角：如果中间推理不可见，仍然可以通过策略梯度间接塑造它。对研究 RL-pretrain、reasoning token、或 post-train 反哺内部表征的人，这个思路值得记一下。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 LaST-R1 架构。模型以预训练 Qwen3-VL-4B 为初始化，在机器人数据上继续预训练。执行时先自回归地产生 latent reasoning tokens，再以这些 latent token 为条件并行解码动作。这里 latent token 不是语言解释，而是连续或离散化后的内部推理表征，用来编码物理动态、未来状态和操作意图。作者还用 vision foundation model 的 global future representations 去 anchor 这些 latent token，目的是给 latent reasoning 一个稳定的语义/空间先验，避免它在训练中退化成无意义隐变量。第二部分是 LAPO。与只对动作概率做 PPO 式优化不同，LAPO 把 latent reasoning 和 action generation 放进统一的 step-level likelihood ratio 中，让环境奖励同时影响两者。直观上，策略不只是学“哪个动作回报高”，还学“哪种内部物理表征更有助于产生高回报动作”。这解决的是 credit assignment：奖励来自环境终局，但更新要能传到中间 reasoning。第三部分是 adaptive latent CoT。作者不固定 reasoning horizon，而是让模型根据任务复杂度动态调整 latent reasoning 长度。复杂任务多想几步，反应型任务少想甚至近似跳过，以平衡性能和时延。训练流程上，先做大规模机器人预训练，再对具体任务做 SFT warm-up，最后进入在线 RL post-training。
summary.experiments: 从引言可确认的关键结果包括：模型以 Qwen3-VL-4B 为底座，在多个机器人操作数据集上预训练；在 LIBERO benchmark 上，one-shot warm-up 后平均成功率达到 99.8%，高于已有基线；在四个真实世界复杂任务上，LAPO 相比 warm-up 初始策略最高带来 44% 提升，单臂和双臂场景平均成功率达到 90%；RL 后训练后还能对未见物体、背景、光照实现 zero-shot generalization。实验主线大致有三类。第一，和 vanilla action-only RL policy 比较，证明联合优化 latent reasoning + action 比只优化动作更稳、更能泛化。第二，验证 adaptive latent CoT 的收益，说明固定推理长度不是最优折中。第三，真实机器人实验说明改进不只存在于仿真。由于给出的全文片段主要是引言，具体消融数字、训练步数、rollout 配置、奖励设计细节还需要看实验章节原文才能完整确认；但从问题设定和结果摘要看，作者想证明的核心命题已经很清楚：latent reasoning 不是只能靠 imitation 学，也可以被在线 RL 直接塑形。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Figure 1 对比 action-only RL 与 reasoning-before-acting RL 的差异，这是整篇工作的主轴。然后重点读方法部分里 LaST-R1 的生成顺序：latent token 如何产生、如何条件化动作解码、future representation 如何做 anchor。接着读 LAPO 的目标函数，尤其是联合 likelihood ratio 怎么写、与 PPO 的差别在哪里、奖励如何分配到 reasoning token。若你关心语言模型里的 latent reasoning，这部分最值得细看。实验部分优先看三组对比：有无 latent reasoning、有无 LAPO、固定与自适应 reasoning horizon。真实机器人结果也建议看，因为它决定这类方法是不是只在仿真里成立。若时间有限，可以先跳过具体任务描述和视觉展示，保留算法公式、训练流程图、主表和关键消融表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific gap in VLA training. Existing reasoning-enabled robot policies either rely on explicit language reasoning, which is slow and poorly matched to continuous physical dynamics, or use latent reasoning but still train mostly with imitation learning, limiting adaptation. Meanwhile, online RL for VLA usually optimizes only the action space and ignores the internal reasoning process. The central question here is whether RL can optimize the coupled process of latent physical reasoning and action generation, rather than improving actions alone.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to core LLM pretraining is modest, since this is primarily a robotics VLA post-training paper. Still, it is useful for a broader line of work around latent reasoning. Two aspects stand out. First, latent CoT is treated as an actual decision variable rather than an incidental hidden state. That connects naturally to current interest in hidden scratchpads, continuous thought, and latent reasoning in language models. Second, LAPO offers a concrete credit-assignment mechanism: even when intermediate reasoning is not externally supervised, environmental reward can still shape it through a joint policy objective over reasoning and action tokens. That idea is relevant to anyone thinking about RL-pretrain, internal reasoning representations, or how post-training can sculpt hidden computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three main components. First, the LaST-R1 architecture. It is initialized from Qwen3-VL-4B and further pretrained on large-scale robotic manipulation datasets. At inference time, the model autoregressively generates latent reasoning tokens before producing actions, and those latent tokens condition a parallel action decoder. These tokens are not natural-language explanations; they are internal reasoning representations intended to capture physical dynamics, future state structure, and manipulation intent. To stabilize them, the authors anchor the latent reasoning space to global future representations from a vision foundation model, providing semantic and spatial priors so the latent variables do not drift into arbitrary hidden codes. Second, LAPO, or Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization. Instead of applying PPO-style optimization only to action probabilities, LAPO defines a joint step-level likelihood ratio over latent reasoning and action generation. This allows environmental reward to influence both the internal reasoning trajectory and the final action policy. The key benefit is better credit assignment: the reward arrives from interaction outcomes, but the update can still reach the intermediate reasoning process. Third, the adaptive latent CoT mechanism. Rather than fixing a constant reasoning horizon, the model adjusts the amount of latent reasoning based on task demands. Harder tasks can allocate more internal computation, while reactive tasks can use shorter reasoning for lower latency. The overall training recipe is pretraining on robotic data, task-specific SFT warm-up, and then online RL post-training.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text excerpt, the main confirmed results are as follows: the model is built on Qwen3-VL-4B and pretrained on multiple robotic manipulation datasets; on LIBERO, it reaches a 99.8% average success rate with one-shot warm-up, outperforming prior baselines; on four real-world complex tasks, LAPO improves over the warm-up policy by up to 44%, reaching a 90% average success rate across single-arm and dual-arm settings; after RL post-training, the system also shows zero-shot generalization to unseen objects, backgrounds, and lighting conditions. The experimental story appears to have three pillars. First, comparisons against vanilla action-only RL policies show that jointly optimizing latent reasoning and actions improves robustness and generalization. Second, adaptive latent CoT is evaluated against fixed reasoning horizons, supporting the claim that reasoning depth should be task-dependent. Third, real-robot experiments indicate the gains are not confined to simulation. Since the provided text is mostly the introduction, exact ablation numbers, rollout settings, reward definitions, and training budgets still need to be checked in the full experimental section. Even so, the intended claim is already clear: latent reasoning does not have to be learned only through imitation; it can be directly shaped by online RL.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 40 minutes. Start with Figure 1, which contrasts action-only RL with reasoning-before-acting RL; that figure captures the paper’s main thesis. Then read the method section for the generation order in LaST-R1: how latent tokens are produced, how they condition action decoding, and how future representations are used as anchors. After that, focus on the LAPO objective, especially how the joint likelihood ratio is defined and how it differs from standard PPO. If your interest is latent reasoning in language models, this is the most transferable part. In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: with versus without latent reasoning, with versus without LAPO, and fixed versus adaptive reasoning horizon. The real-world robot section is also worth reading because it tests whether the method survives outside simulation. If time is limited, skip detailed task descriptions and visual examples, and keep the algorithm equations, training pipeline figure, main result tables, and key ablations.

recommendation.zh: 多模态VLA模型RL后训练的创新方法，仅需读方法部分§3的LAPO算法设计即可
recommendation.en: Innovative RL post-training method for VLA models, only need to read §3 for LAPO algorithm design

paper.title: Distributional Alignment Games for Answer-Level Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: We focus on the problem of \emph{Answer-Level Fine-Tuning} (ALFT), where the goal is to optimize a language model based on the correctness or properties of its final answers, rather than the specific reasoning traces used to produce them. Directly optimizing answer-level objectives is computationally intractable due to the need to marginalize over the vast space of latent reasoning paths. To overcome this, we propose a general game-theoretical framework that lifts the problem to a \emph{Distribu

summary.core_problem: 答案级微调（ALFT）需要优化模型生成正确最终答案的边际概率，但推理轨迹到答案的映射通常不可微，且推理轨迹的组合空间过大，直接计算边际概率梯度不可行，现有REINFORCE类梯度估计器方差过高，训练难以稳定。
summary.importance: 为答案级对齐提供了统一的博弈论框架，将此前多种启发式推理对齐方法（如逆频率奖励、共识自改进）统一到凸对偶理论下，无需人工设计奖励函数即可导出可扩展的训练算法，为RL对齐、推理增强预训练提供了理论支撑和落地路径。
summary.technical_approach: 将答案级微调建模为双人分布对齐博弈，其中策略模块是生成推理轨迹的模型，目标模块是辅助变分分布，二者构成极小极大博弈，其纳什均衡等价于原ALFT问题的最优解。基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）导出可扩展的训练算法，包括面向离散答案域的Coherence-GRPO和面向开放生成域的Pairwise-GRPO，直接从同输入的多组输出统计量计算优势信号，无需显式边际化推理轨迹空间。
summary.experiments: 在3个3B参数级指令微调模型（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Phi-3-mini-4k-Instruct、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct）上测试：GSM8K数学数据集上准确率绝对提升3.18~9.18个百分点（相对提升4.80%~12.46%）；TriviaQA问答数据集上Pairwise-GRPO的精确匹配相对提升最高42.06%，F1值相对提升18.12%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读推荐重点看博弈框架的核心推导、GRPO变体的实现逻辑、核心实验结果，预计阅读时间20分钟，适合从事模型对齐、推理增强预训练的团队参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Answer-level fine-tuning (ALFT) requires optimizing the marginal probability of the model generating correct final answers. However, the mapping from reasoning traces to answers is usually non-differentiable, and the combinatorial space of reasoning traces is too large to directly compute gradients of marginal probability. Existing REINFORCE-style gradient estimators suffer from excessively high variance, making training unstable.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a unified game-theoretic framework for answer-level alignment, unifying multiple previous heuristic reasoning alignment methods (such as inverse frequency reward, consensus-based self-improvement) under convex duality theory. Scalable training algorithms can be derived without manual reward engineering, offering theoretical support and implementation paths for RL alignment and reasoning-enhanced pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ALFT is formulated as a two-player distributional alignment game, where the policy is the trace-generating model and the target is an auxiliary variational distribution. The min-max game's Nash Equivalence is equivalent to the optimal solution of the original ALFT problem. Scalable training algorithms are derived based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), including Coherence-GRPO for discrete answer domains and Pairwise-GRPO for open-ended generation domains. Advantage signals are computed directly from statistics of multiple outputs for the same input, without explicit marginalization over the reasoning trace space.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three 3B-parameter instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Phi-3-mini-4k-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct): on GSM8K math dataset, accuracy gains 3.18~9.18 absolute percentage points (4.80%~12.46% relative improvement); on TriviaQA QA dataset, Pairwise-GRPO achieves up to 42.06% relative improvement in exact match and 18.12% relative improvement in F1 score.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the core derivation of the game framework, implementation logic of GRPO variants, and key experimental results. Expected reading time is 20 minutes. It is suitable for teams working on model alignment and reasoning-enhanced pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该当作“目标函数论文”来读，不必先信它能立刻提分；先看博弈等价是否真的把 answer-only 训练讲清了，若成立，会直接影响你对 latent reasoning 后训练接口的设计。
recommendation.en: Read this as an objective-design paper, not a benchmark paper; if the game-theoretic equivalence is clean, it changes how you should formulate answer-only training with latent reasoning.

paper.title: The Thinking Pixel: Recursive Sparse Reasoning in Multimodal Diffusion Latents
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved success in high-fidelity data synthesis, yet their capacity for more complex, structured reasoning like text following tasks remains constrained. While advances in language models have leveraged strategies such as latent reasoning and recursion to enhance text understanding capabilities, extending these to multimodal text-to-image generation tasks is challenging due to the continuous and non-discrete nature of visual tokens. To tackle this problem, we draw inspirat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何把扩散模型做得更大”，而是一个更具体的问题：扩散式文生图模型在复杂文本约束下，往往缺少类似语言模型那种可递归、可分步的内部推理过程，因此对结构布局、对象关系和细粒度文本跟随的处理不稳定。作者关注的是 joint attention 这一层里视觉 token 与文本 token 对齐的关键位置，试图让模型在一次去噪步内部再做多次轻量递归更新，而不是只靠单次前向把跨模态对齐一次性做完。难点在于视觉 latent 是连续表示，不像离散文本 token 那样容易做显式 reasoning；如果直接堆更多层或更多 denoising steps，计算代价又很高，且不一定把额外算力用在真正需要推敲的局部结构上。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不算强，因为主体仍是文生图扩散模型，而不是语言模型预训练范式本身。但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把“latent reasoning / recursive computation”从文本域迁到连续视觉 latent，并且不是简单加深网络，而是在条件对齐最关键的模块里做稀疏递归，这对研究非 AR 建模、diffusion LM、以及 test-time / train-time adaptive compute 有参考意义。第二，它把 MoE 路由、Gumbel-Softmax 稀疏选择、adapter 化轻量递归三者结合，展示了一种在大 backbone 上插入可控额外计算的方式。贡献量级更像方法探索而不是范式改写，适合把它当成“连续 latent 上如何做稀疏递归推理”的案例来读。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把一个递归稀疏模块插入到 diffusion transformer，尤其是 SD3 这类 MMDiT block 的 joint attention 部分。作者的判断是：joint attention 负责文本-视觉结构对齐，若要提升复杂 prompt 的遵循能力，最值得加计算的地方不是所有层平均加深，而是这些负责跨模态结构建模的层。

具体做法分三层。第一层是 recursive sparse reasoning。给定当前视觉 token、扩散 timestep、以及条件信息（类别标签或文本 embedding），模型在一个 block 内执行多个 latent recursion steps。每一步并不启用完整新子网络，而是从一组共享 neural modules 中稀疏选出少量模块，对视觉 token 做迭代细化。这样做的目的，是让不同递归步或不同 token 区域可以调用不同“功能模块”，形成某种分工，而不是所有样本都走同一条固定计算路径。

第二层是 sparse routing 与可学习专家分化。作者没有用普通 soft mixture，而是引入 Gumbel-Softmax 近似离散选择，并采用 winner-takes-all 式梯度分配，让被选中的模块得到更明确的训练信号。这样做是为了避免软路由下所有模块都学成平均化残差修正器，难以形成真正 specialization。路由条件不仅看视觉 token，还看 diffusion timestep 和文本条件，这意味着专家选择既依赖当前图像状态，也依赖生成阶段和语义约束。

第三层是 mixture-of-adapters 与 recursive adapter updates。作者没有为每个递归步复制完整 attention/MLP，而是用 adapter 形式承载递归更新，并在多步递归中累积这些 adapter 输出。这样把额外参数和计算压到较低水平，适合在已有 DiT/SD3 上做微调式改造，而不是从头训练一个大得多的模型。

从设计取舍看，这套方法和“直接增加 denoising steps”不同，后者把更多计算平均分配到整个采样轨迹；这里则是在单步内部、在跨模态对齐关键层、按条件稀疏分配计算。它也不同于标准 MoE FFN，因为这里的专家调用带有递归时间维度，目标不是单层容量扩展，而是多次内部状态修正。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验主要分三块。第一块是 class-conditioned ImageNet generation，在 DiT 设置下用 FID、sFID、IS、precision、recall 评估。作者声称递归稀疏模块在相近或更低额外计算下优于常规基线，说明收益不只是来自参数增加，而是来自把计算放在更合适的位置。第二块是 text-to-image，对 SD3 类模型在 GenEval 上评估文本-图像对齐，重点看复杂 prompt 的遵循。文中还提到 DPG 等文本跟随评测，结论是递归细化能改善结构布局和语义一致性。第三块是分析实验，包括 token trajectory visualization，用来展示不同模块在递归过程中出现功能分化，这部分是理解方法是否真的学到 specialization 的关键证据。

不过，从给出的全文片段看，具体数字、参数规模、递归步数、专家数、训练 token / 图像规模等细节没有完整展开，至少当前材料里无法可靠复述精确提升幅度。能确认的是：作者先在较简单的 class-conditioned DiT 上验证，再扩展到更复杂的 SD3；并且强调 sparse activation of lightweight shared modules 带来更好的计算-效果折中。若要判断方法是否扎实，必须去看主表里相对基线的绝对提升是否稳定，以及消融里“递归本身”“稀疏路由”“Gumbel winner-take-all”“adapter 累积”各自贡献多少。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不建议投入精读级时间。优先看三处。第一，看方法图和 joint attention 改造公式，确认递归到底发生在 block 内、denoising step 内，还是采样轨迹层面；这是理解它和普通多步采样区别的关键。第二，看消融表，重点找四个问题：不用递归只加 adapter 是否还能提升；不用稀疏路由是否退化；Gumbel-Softmax 是否真的让专家更分化；递归步数增加后收益是否饱和。第三，看可视化部分，判断所谓“thinking pixel”是否只是命名包装，还是确实出现了与布局、对象关系、文本属性相关的模块专门化。

如果只从预训练研究角度取材，阅读时间控制在 20 到 30 分钟即可。重点不是记住具体架构细节，而是抓住一个思路：在连续 latent 生成模型里，如何把额外计算做成条件化、稀疏化、递归化，而不是简单堆深度或堆采样步数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of diffusion-based text-to-image models: they generate high-quality images, but their internal computation is still weak at structured, multi-step reasoning under complex textual constraints. In practice, text-image alignment inside diffusion transformers is often handled in a single forward pass per denoising step, which makes object relations, layout constraints, and fine-grained prompt following brittle. The authors ask whether diffusion models can benefit from an internal recursive reasoning process, similar in spirit to latent reasoning in language models, but adapted to continuous visual latents rather than discrete text tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core LLM pretraining paper, so its direct relevance to foundation-language-model pretraining is limited. Still, it is useful for two reasons. First, it explores recursive latent computation in a continuous multimodal setting, which is relevant to diffusion LM, non-AR modeling, and adaptive compute research. Second, it combines sparse routing, Gumbel-based hard selection, and lightweight adapter-style recursion in a way that may transfer to other foundation-model settings. The contribution is better viewed as a design pattern for inserting targeted extra computation into a large pretrained backbone, rather than a broad shift in modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method inserts a recursive sparse reasoning module into diffusion transformers, with particular focus on the joint attention blocks of MMDiT-style architectures such as SD3. The key design choice is to spend extra computation where text and visual latents are structurally aligned, instead of uniformly deepening the whole network.

The first component is recursive latent refinement. Within a block, the model performs multiple latent recursion steps. At each step, it updates visual tokens using a small set of shared neural modules rather than a full new transformer block. The routing decision depends on the current visual tokens, the diffusion timestep, and the conditioning signal such as class labels or text embeddings. This gives the model a conditional internal computation path instead of a fixed one.

The second component is sparse expert routing. Rather than using a soft mixture over all modules, the paper uses Gumbel-Softmax to approximate discrete selection and allocates gradients in a winner-takes-all manner. The motivation is clear: soft routing often leads to averaged experts with weak specialization, while harder selection encourages distinct module roles to emerge.

The third component is a mixture-of-adapters design with recursive adapter updates. Instead of duplicating full attention or MLP layers for each recursion step, the recursive computation is carried by lightweight adapters whose outputs are accumulated across steps. This keeps parameter and compute overhead manageable and makes the method suitable for adaptation on top of existing DiT or SD3 backbones.

Conceptually, this differs from simply increasing denoising steps. More denoising steps spread compute across the whole sampling trajectory, while this method concentrates extra compute inside alignment-critical layers and allocates it sparsely. It also differs from standard MoE FFNs, because the experts here are used across recursive latent steps, not just as a wider feed-forward layer.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around three settings. First, class-conditional ImageNet generation with DiT-style models, evaluated by FID, sFID, IS, precision, and recall. The claimed result is that recursive sparse reasoning improves generation quality under a favorable compute trade-off, suggesting the gain is not just from adding parameters. Second, text-to-image evaluation on SD3-like models using GenEval and related prompt-following benchmarks such as DPG, where the method is reported to improve semantic alignment and structural consistency under complex prompts. Third, the paper includes analysis experiments such as token trajectory visualizations, intended to show that different modules specialize during recursive refinement.

That said, the provided full-text excerpt does not expose enough reliable numeric detail to restate exact gains, model sizes, recursion depth, number of experts, or training scale. What can be stated safely is that the paper validates the idea first on simpler class-conditioned DiTs and then extends it to SD3, while emphasizing sparse activation of lightweight shared modules as the main efficiency mechanism. The most important thing to verify in the actual tables is whether the gains remain stable after controlling for added compute, and how much each ingredient contributes in ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, not a must-read. Focus on three parts. First, inspect the architecture figure and the equations around the modified joint attention block. You want to pin down exactly where recursion happens: inside a block, inside a denoising step, or across the sampling trajectory. Second, read the ablations with four questions in mind: does recursion help beyond simply adding adapters; does sparse routing matter; does Gumbel hard selection actually improve specialization; and where do returns saturate as recursion depth increases. Third, check the visualization section carefully. The paper’s central claim is not just better scores, but that recursive sparse modules develop differentiated roles tied to layout and prompt semantics.

For a pretraining-oriented reader, 20 to 30 minutes is enough. The main takeaway is a modeling idea: in continuous latent generative models, extra compute can be made conditional, sparse, and recursive instead of being spent through uniform depth or more sampling steps.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和 ablation；若递归步数带来真实组合泛化，而非只加算力，这是视觉 latent reasoning 的有用信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations; if recursive steps improve compositional generalization beyond extra compute, it is a useful signal for visual latent reasoning.

institutions: Shanghai Academy of AI for Science

paper.title: Thinking Without Words: Efficient Latent Reasoning with Abstract Chain-of-Thought
paper.abstract: While long, explicit chains-of-thought (CoT) have proven effective on complex reasoning tasks, they are costly to generate during inference. Non-verbal reasoning methods have emerged with shorter generation lengths by leveraging continuous representations, yet their performance lags behind verbalized CoT. We propose $\textbf{Abstract Chain-of-Thought}$, a discrete latent reasoning post-training mechanism in which the language model produces a short sequence of tokens from a reserved vocabulary i

summary.core_problem: 论文想解决显式长 CoT 的推理成本问题：能否用一小段不可读的离散“抽象 token”替代自然语言推理轨迹，同时保留 CoT 对答案生成的帮助。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，因为主要是 post-training 机制，不是新的基座预训练目标。但它对“latent reasoning”和“非自然语言中间表示”有启发：作者没有走连续 latent recurrence 路线，而是把 latent scratchpad 做成可生成、可 RL 优化的离散 token 序列。这使得训练、采样、约束解码和后续 RL 都能复用现有 decoder-only LM 框架。对基座研究更有价值的问题是：如果这些抽象 token 在 post-training 中能形成稳定复用模式，那么预训练阶段是否可以预留或学习类似的非语言计算通道。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Abstract Chain-of-Thought。模型在回答前先生成一段由保留词表构成的抽象序列，格式上用 begin/end delimiter 包起来，抽象 token 来自新增 codebook。难点是这些 token 初始没有语义，embedding 随机初始化，直接训练会冷启动失败。作者用两阶段方案处理。第一阶段是 policy-iteration 风格 warm-up：先利用已有 verbal CoT，把自然语言 CoT 作为教师信号，但在答案生成时让模型只能 attend 到抽象 token，而不是完整 CoT，迫使抽象 token 承载中间信息；随后丢掉 verbal CoT，用模型自己生成的抽象序列做 self-distillation，让模型学会从输入直接提出抽象 trace。这个过程迭代进行。第二阶段用 GRPO 做强化学习，约束模型只在抽象词表内生成 reasoning trace，再根据答案质量优化抽象序列策略。与 Coconut 这类连续 latent 方法相比，它不需要改模型结构，也不需要把 hidden state 作为显式 recurrent computation 传递；与 pause/filler token 方法相比，它给 filler token 一个受限词表和显式训练目标，而不是只增加空白计算步。
summary.experiments: 作者报告 Abstract-CoT 在 MATH-500、AlpacaEval 和 HotpotQA 上能在明显缩短 reasoning token 的情况下匹配或超过 verbal CoT，最高减少约 11.6 倍 reasoning token。实验重点不只是最终分数，还包括抽象词表使用行为：抽象 token 出现频率呈现类似 power-law 的分布，说明模型不是均匀随机使用这些 token，而是在形成可复用的离散模式。全文给出的消融重点应包括 warm-up 的必要性、bottleneck SFT 与 self-distillation 的作用、抽象序列长度上限、codebook 大小、以及 RL warm-start 相比直接 RL 的稳定性。由于给定全文片段未包含完整表格，具体逐项分数和模型规模不应过度推断。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分中 abstract token 定义、bottleneck SFT 和 self-distillation 的训练流程；再看 RL 阶段如何约束抽象词表采样。实验部分重点找三类结果：一是 token reduction 与任务性能的折中曲线，二是 warm-up/RL/长度/codebook 的消融，三是抽象 token 分布和复用模式分析。最值得深挖的是冷启动解决方案：作者把不可解释 token 变成有用 latent 的关键，不在 token 名称，而在“答案只能通过抽象 bottleneck 读取教师 CoT 信息”的训练约束。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the inference cost of long verbal chain-of-thought reasoning. It asks whether a model can replace natural-language rationales with a short sequence of non-verbal discrete tokens while preserving the performance benefits of CoT.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly a post-training method rather than a pretraining objective, so its direct impact on foundation-model pretraining is limited. Its value for pretraining researchers is the design of a discrete latent reasoning channel that remains compatible with standard decoder-only generation and RL. Unlike continuous latent reasoning, the intermediate representation can be sampled, constrained, distilled, and optimized with existing LM machinery. A useful follow-up question is whether such abstract reasoning channels should be introduced earlier, during pretraining or mid-training, instead of being added only after instruction tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Abstract-CoT extends the tokenizer with a reserved abstract vocabulary and delimiter tokens. At inference time, the model generates a bounded abstract trace before producing the final answer. The main obstacle is cold start: the newly added tokens have random embeddings and no learned function. The training recipe has two stages. The first stage is a policy-iteration-style warm-up. It uses verbal CoT as supervision, but forces the answer to attend only to the abstract tokens rather than the full verbal rationale, making the abstract sequence an information bottleneck. The model is then self-distilled on its own generated abstract traces without access to the verbal CoT, and the process is repeated. The second stage applies GRPO with decoding constrained to the abstract vocabulary, refining the policy over abstract traces. Compared with Coconut-style continuous latent reasoning, this approach avoids architectural changes. Compared with pause or filler tokens, it gives the non-verbal tokens an explicit codebook and a training procedure that makes them carry task-relevant information.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports results on MATH-500, AlpacaEval, and HotpotQA. Abstract-CoT matches or improves over verbal CoT while reducing reasoning-token usage by up to 11.6x. The analysis also shows power-law-like usage patterns over the abstract vocabulary, suggesting that the model learns reusable token patterns instead of treating the abstract codebook as noise. The most relevant ablations are expected around warm-up, bottlenecked SFT, self-distillation, GRPO warm start, abstract sequence length, and codebook size. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact per-task scores and model-scale details should be checked in the experimental section before citing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Read the method sections on abstract-token construction, bottlenecked SFT, self-distillation, and constrained GRPO. In the experiments, focus on the performance-versus-token curves, ablations over the warm-up loop and RL stage, and the analysis of abstract-token frequency and reuse. The key mechanism to inspect is the bottleneck: the abstract tokens become useful because the final answer is trained to recover information through them, not because the tokens have any prior semantic meaning.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它在试探“推理是否需要自然语言”这个接口问题；先看 warm-up 设计和长度-精度曲线，若成立会影响 reasoning token 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it directly probes whether reasoning really needs natural language; read the warm-up recipe and the length-vs-accuracy curves first, because that could change how we think about reasoning tokens.

paper.title: Scaling Latent Reasoning via Looped Language Models
paper.abstract: Modern LLMs are trained to "think" primarily via explicit text generation, such as chain-of-thought (CoT), which defers reasoning to post-training and under-leverages pre-training data. We present and open-source Ouro, named after the recursive Ouroboros, a family of pre-trained Looped Language Models (LoopLM) that instead build reasoning into the pre-training phase through (i) iterative computation in latent space, (ii) an entropy-regularized objective for learned depth allocation, and (iii) sc

summary.core_problem: 在不增加参数量的前提下，把“推理所需的额外计算”从后训练阶段的显式 CoT 文本生成，前移到预训练阶段的隐空间迭代计算里；同时解决循环/早退式动态深度在训练中容易塌缩（总是浅层退出或总是跑满循环）的问题，并验证这种“第三条 scaling 轴（loop depth）”在多万亿 token 规模下是否仍然带来稳定收益。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献是：把“推理 compute”做成架构内生的、可学习分配的训练目标，而不是依赖推理时多吐 token。它提供了一条参数效率路线：在 1–3B 量级用更深的隐计算去逼近 4–8B 甚至更大模型的能力，并给出较系统的机制证据（知识存储不变、知识操控增强）。如果结论可复现，这会影响三类决策：小模型/端侧的 pretrain 架构选择；训练预算在参数 vs 深度循环 vs 数据之间的配比；以及“faithful reasoning”是否能通过预训练目标而非对齐/提示工程获得。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是 Looped Language Model（LoopLM）：把一段包含 L 层的 transformer block 作为一个“可复用模块”，在前向中重复应用 t 次（权重共享），形成更深的计算图但不增加参数。每个 loop step 都接一个 LM head 产生预测，从而可以定义多步监督。

为实现自适应计算，论文引入“可学习早退”的训练方案：模型对每个 token/样本选择在第几步退出（或等价地，对各步的损失加权），目标是在保证最大步数性能的同时，让简单输入用更少循环。难点是早退训练很容易出现模式塌缩：要么几乎都在最浅步退出（省算但性能差），要么几乎都跑满（性能好但失去自适应）。作者用熵正则来对抗塌缩：对退出步分布施加接近均匀先验的熵正则，强制训练早期“无偏探索”不同深度；随后再进入一个 focused 阶段，调节 compute–quality trade-off，让退出策略按输入难度分配步数。

机制层面，作者把收益拆成两部分：知识存储（memorization / capacity）与知识操控（composition / multi-hop manipulation）。通过受控实验（借鉴 physics-of-LMs 的思路）论证循环带来的主要是后者：权重共享的迭代更新更像在隐空间做多步推断/修正，而不是把更多事实塞进参数。
summary.experiments:
规模：预训练到 7.7T tokens，并开源 Ouro 系列（1.4B、2.6B）。对比对象是同数据/同训练设定下的标准非循环 transformer（等价于 t=1）。

参数效率：作者报告 1.4B/2.6B 的 LoopLM 在多数基准上分别匹配约 4B/8B 的标准模型，给出约 2–3× 的参数效率提升（以“达到同等能力所需参数量”口径）。

循环步数与收益：论文强调收益随 loop steps 增加总体单调，但存在训练稳定性与退出策略塌缩风险；熵正则 + 两阶段训练能显著改善“要么全浅要么全深”的失败模式，使得在固定最大步数下既保住峰值性能，又能在简单样本上早退省算。

机制验证：作者声称两类模型的“知识存储密度”接近（文中给出约 2 bits/parameter 的量级结论），但 LoopLM 在需要事实组合、多跳推理的任务上提升更明显，支持“操控能力增强”的解释。

安全与可解释性：在 HEx-PHI 上 harmfulness 更低，并且随着循环步数增加安全性继续改善（包括外推到更大步数）。此外，相比显式 CoT，隐空间迭代产生的 reasoning traces 与最终输出更一致，作者将其解读为更高的因果忠实性（减少事后编造式 rationalization）。

注：题面提供的全文片段未包含所有表格数字与具体基准分项；精读时需要回到主文 Figure 1/2/相关表格核对“匹配 12B”这类更强表述的评测设置与口径。
summary.reading_guide:
优先读三块：
1) 架构与目标（Learning Adaptive Latent Reasoning with LoopLM）：看清楚 loop 的实现（权重共享的 L 层堆叠重复）、每步 head 的损失怎么定义、退出分布/加权是 per-token 还是 per-sequence，以及熵正则具体作用在哪个随机变量上。
2) 训练配方与稳定性：重点找“塌缩案例”与两阶段训练的对照曲线（退出步分布、训练 loss、不同 loop 的收敛速度）。这部分决定它是不是一个可工程化的 pretrain recipe。
3) 机制实验：把“2 bits/parameter 的知识存储”是怎么测的、操控能力用哪些合成/对照任务刻画、以及与深度不共享（真正加层）相比的差异读透。这里直接影响你是否相信它是在做‘隐推理’而不是别的正则化效应。

如果时间有限：先看 Figure 1/2（参数效率与 scaling 轨迹）、自适应计算的关键图（退出分布/compute-accuracy 曲线）、以及机制实验的主表；预计 60–90 分钟可建立可靠判断。

summary_en.core_problem: Move reasoning compute from post-training (explicit chain-of-thought token generation) into pretraining by adding iterative latent-space computation with weight-tied loops, while preventing adaptive early-exit policies from collapsing to trivial shallow or always-deep behavior; then test whether “loop depth” is a real scaling axis at multi-trillion-token scale.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining-centric attempt to buy reasoning capability with internal compute rather than more parameters or longer outputs. If the reported curves hold, it changes how one might allocate budgets among parameters, data, and depth/recurrence—especially for small-to-mid models where deployment cost matters. The paper also tries to separate memorization from manipulation, arguing recurrence mainly improves compositional/multi-hop use of knowledge, which is a useful framing for scaling discussions beyond pure loss/perplexity.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LoopLM reuses a stack of L transformer layers for t recurrent steps (shared weights), effectively deepening the computation graph without increasing parameter count. A prediction head is attached at each step, enabling multi-step supervision.

Adaptive compute is implemented via a learned early-exit (or equivalently, a learned weighting over step-wise losses). The key training issue is collapse: without constraints, the model either exits too early (cheap but weak) or always runs the maximum steps (strong but no adaptivity). The proposed fix is an entropy-regularized objective with a uniform prior over exit steps to force unbiased exploration of depths early in training, followed by a focused stage that tunes the compute–quality trade-off and lets the model allocate steps based on input difficulty.

For interpretation, the paper positions recurrence as iterative refinement in latent space, and backs it with controlled studies that aim to disentangle “knowledge storage” from “knowledge manipulation” (composition, multi-hop reasoning).
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: pretraining up to 7.7T tokens; open-sourced Ouro models at 1.4B and 2.6B parameters.

Efficiency claim: 1.4B/2.6B LoopLMs reportedly match roughly 4B/8B standard (non-looped) transformers on many benchmarks, implying ~2–3× parameter efficiency under their evaluation protocol.

Ablations: varying loop steps shows generally increasing capability with more steps, but training can be unstable due to exit-policy collapse; entropy regularization plus the two-stage schedule stabilizes depth usage and preserves peak performance while enabling early exit on easier inputs.

Mechanistic results: the paper reports similar “knowledge storage density” between looped and non-looped models (on the order of ~2 bits/parameter), while showing larger gains on tasks requiring fact composition and multi-hop reasoning—supporting the “manipulation over storage” explanation.

Safety/faithfulness: lower harmfulness on HEx-PHI, improving with more recurrent steps (including extrapolated steps). It also argues latent iterative traces align better with final answers than explicit CoT, suggesting less post-hoc rationalization.

Caveat: to validate the strongest headline comparisons (e.g., matching much larger models), one should check the exact benchmark suite, prompting, and aggregation in the main figures/tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
1) The formal LoopLM definition and step-wise loss/exit mechanism: confirm whether exit is per-token or per-sequence and how gradients flow through the exit distribution.
2) The entropy-regularized training recipe and the focused stage: look for plots of exit-step histograms over training and compute–accuracy trade-off curves.
3) The controlled “storage vs manipulation” section: inspect how bits/parameter is estimated and what synthetic/diagnostic tasks are used.

If you only skim: Figure 1/2 for scaling/efficiency, the main adaptive-compute figure (depth usage), and the primary mechanism table. ~60–90 minutes should be enough for a solid take.

recommendation.zh: 这是少数会直接改你 pretrain prior 的工作：如果 7.7T token 下小模型真能稳定打到大模型区间，就该立刻复查 internal shared-depth/latent-reasoning 方案，先盯控制实验是否真把“知识量”和“知识操作”分开了。
recommendation.en: This is one of the few papers that can actually change your pretraining priors: if small looped models really hold up at 7.7T tokens against much larger baselines, you should immediately revisit internal shared-depth and latent-reasoning plans—starting with whether the controls truly separate knowledge from manipulation.

paper.title: Visual Enhanced Depth Scaling for Multimodal Latent Reasoning

summary.core_problem:
论文研究多模态“潜在推理”（latent reasoning）训练中的两个优化瓶颈：
(1) 视觉-文本优化失衡：视觉token的梯度范数显著更高且更不稳定，反映语言偏置导致视觉表征在联合训练中被系统性欠优化/难对齐；
(2) 固定深度困境：不同难度样本/不同语义复杂度token的收敛行为差异巨大，简单token很快稳定，而复杂token长期梯度震荡；固定层数的Transformer缺乏按需迭代精炼的能力，导致难样本被困在不稳定轨迹中。
summary.importance: 潜在推理试图用连续隐变量替代显式CoT，从而降低推理延迟、减少标注依赖并提升表示密度。但如果训练阶段就存在视觉欠优化与深度不足两类结构性问题，模型会在需要细粒度视觉扎根与长程组合推理的任务上表现不稳。本文从“梯度动力学”角度给出可观测证据，并提出面向训练与架构路由的改法，为高效多模态推理提供更可扩展的工程路径。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出一个统一框架，核心由三块组成：
1) 梯度动力学诊断：在latent reasoning训练中做token级梯度分析，比较视觉token与文本token的梯度范数与波动；并将数据按早期验证表现划分easy/hard，跟踪注意力层QKV与输出投影O等矩阵的梯度核范数（nuclear norm）演化，用以刻画“难样本长期不稳定”。
2) Visual Replay Module（视觉回放）：在“思考latent”序列中动态重放/插入聚焦的视觉线索，使关键视觉上下文跨推理步骤反复暴露与传播；并引入自蒸馏监督以约束视觉latent的空间一致性，减少细节丢失、强化细粒度对齐。
3) Routing Depth Scaling（路由式深度扩展）：设计逐层token router，根据token复杂度/信息密度为部分token分配额外推理步数（可理解为对高难token进行层复用/迭代精炼），从而突破固定深度对难例的限制。
此外，训练策略采用课程学习（curriculum），逐步引入latent tokens，而非依赖外部教师的直接latent蒸馏。
summary.experiments:
论文报告在12个多模态推理基准上进行实验，强调两点：
- 效果：方法可与多种主流MLLM骨干组合，取得SOTA或显著提升。
- 效率：相较显式CoT或工具增强推理，保持较满意的推理延迟；潜在推理的优势（少解码、少冗余步骤）得以保留。
从摘要与引言可知，关键实证还包括：Fig.1(a)展示视觉token梯度更高更波动；Fig.1(b)(c)展示easy/hard在梯度核范数上的分化，支撑“固定深度困境”的论断。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction中两大观察的证据链与归因；Method部分的两项关键模块（visual replay + self-distillation空间一致性约束；token router与depth scaling的具体实现与训练/推理开销）；curriculum如何逐步引入latent tokens。
- 重点图表：Fig.1(a)（视觉/文本梯度范数对比，理解“视觉欠优化”）；Fig.1(b)(c)（easy/hard梯度核范数分化，理解“深度不足”）；任何展示router触发率、额外深度分配分布、以及延迟-性能权衡的表。
- 创新点抓手：①用梯度动力学把多模态latent训练问题“可测量化”；②visual replay把视觉证据跨步传播并用自蒸馏保空间细节；③按token复杂度做深度路由，给难token更多迭代精炼。

skim（泛读）：
- 先看Introduction与Fig.1把两大瓶颈记住；
- 再看Method的模块框图/伪代码（visual replay与router的接口位置）；
- 最后看实验总表与消融（分别去掉replay、去掉depth scaling、去掉自蒸馏/课程学习）来确认每个组件的边际贡献与对延迟的影响。
summary.authors_note: 作者将多模态latent reasoning的失败归因于“优化动力学与架构弹性”而非单纯数据不足：语言偏置使视觉token更新剧烈且不稳定；固定深度无法为复杂token提供足够迭代。对应地，他们用visual replay稳定并强化视觉线索传播，用token级深度路由为难token提供额外计算，并用课程学习降低训练难度与不稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two optimization bottlenecks in multimodal latent reasoning training: (1) visual–text optimization disparity, where visual tokens have much larger and more volatile gradient norms due to language bias, leading to systematic under-optimization/misalignment of visual representations; and (2) a fixed-depth dilemma, where simple tokens converge quickly but complex tokens remain gradient-unstable, and a fixed-depth Transformer lacks the ability to allocate extra iterative refinement to hard cases.
summary_en.importance: Latent reasoning aims to replace explicit Chain-of-Thought decoding with implicit latent feature propagation, improving representation density and reducing inference latency. However, if training suffers from visual under-optimization and insufficient depth for hard tokens, models will remain brittle on tasks requiring fine-grained grounding and compositional reasoning. By grounding the diagnosis in token-level gradient dynamics and proposing depth-adaptive mechanisms, the work offers a scalable path toward efficient yet robust multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed unified framework includes:
1) Gradient-dynamics diagnosis: token-level gradient analysis comparing visual vs textual tokens; and easy/hard partitioning based on early validation accuracy, tracking gradient nuclear norms over attention matrices (QKV) and output projections (O) to characterize persistent instability on hard samples.
2) Visual Replay Module: dynamically replays focused visual clues interleaved with thinking latents so key visual context is repeatedly exposed and propagated across reasoning steps; augmented with self-distillation to enforce spatial coherence and preserve fine-grained visual details in visual latents.
3) Routing Depth Scaling: a per-layer token router that allocates additional reasoning steps to tokens with higher complexity/information density (layer reuse / iterative refinement), overcoming the limitations of fixed architectural depth.
Training uses curriculum learning to progressively introduce latent tokens, rather than relying on direct latent supervision via teacher distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports extensive experiments on 12 multimodal reasoning benchmarks, emphasizing: (i) performance gains that reach SOTA or strong improvements across multiple MLLM backbones, and (ii) maintained inference efficiency/latency advantages relative to explicit CoT or tool-augmented reasoning. Key empirical evidence also includes Fig.1(a) showing higher/volatile visual-token gradients and Fig.1(b)(c) showing divergent gradient nuclear-norm dynamics between easy and hard samples.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Key sections: Introduction for the two observations and their evidence/interpretation; Method for the exact design of visual replay + spatial self-distillation, the token router and depth-scaling mechanism, and the curriculum schedule for latent tokens.
- Key figures/tables: Fig.1(a) (visual vs text gradient norms), Fig.1(b)(c) (easy/hard nuclear-norm divergence), and any latency–accuracy trade-off tables plus ablations (remove replay, remove depth scaling, remove self-distillation/curriculum).
- Innovation checklist: (i) making latent-training issues measurable via gradient dynamics, (ii) replaying visual evidence across latent steps with spatial coherence constraints, (iii) token-wise adaptive depth allocation.

skim (high level):
- Read Introduction + Fig.1 to capture the two bottlenecks;
- Skim the method overview/diagrams for where replay and routing plug in;
- Jump to the main results and ablations to understand component contributions and efficiency impact.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue the main obstacles for multimodal latent reasoning are optimization dynamics and architectural rigidity: language bias destabilizes visual-token updates, and fixed depth is insufficient for complex tokens. They respond with visual replay to stabilize and propagate visual evidence, token-wise depth routing to give hard tokens more computation, and curriculum learning to reduce training instability.

recommendation.zh: 读梯度范数/深度收敛分析那几张图就够：它把“视觉被语言压制”和“固定深度不够”变成可监控信号。
recommendation.en: Only read the gradient-norm and depth/convergence plots: it turns “vision gets dominated by language” and “fixed depth is insufficient” into monitorable signals.
